title: Growth & Acquisition Manager
description:
**Growth \& Acquisition Manager** 




**Experience \- 3\-5 years of experience** 




  





**About the Role \-** 




 We are looking for someone to
 **own and scale the student acquisition engine at The LIT School** 
 . This role sits at the intersection of growth strategy, performance marketing, consumer behaviour, data, and business outcomes, with ownership across the student acquisition funnel — from generating demand and qualified leads to driving applications, admissions, and ultimately enrolments.
 



 The ideal candidate will be highly data\-driven, commercially oriented, and comfortable operating in a high\-growth environment. They should be able to move beyond campaign execution to understand what drives student and parent demand, which audiences convert, where the funnel breaks, and how marketing investments translate into measurable enrolment outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities \-** 




**Student Acquisition \& Funnel Ownership** 



* Own the complete acquisition funnel from
 **Lead → Qualified Lead → Application → Interview → Offer → Enrolment** 
 .
* Identify opportunities to improve conversion and reduce drop\-offs at every stage of the funnel.
* Own and maintain the
 **CRM\-based acquisition funnel** 
 , ensuring accurate tracking of leads from initial enquiry through enrolment.
* Use CRM data and insights to identify opportunities to improve lead quality, follow\-up efficiency, and overall conversion.
* Develop strategies to drive qualified demand and improve overall enrolment outcomes.
* Partner closely with Admissions and Outreach to optimise marketing beyond lead volumes.



  





**Growth Strategy \& Performance Marketing** 



* Develop and execute acquisition strategies across paid and organic channels.
* Identify new acquisition channels, partnerships, and growth opportunities beyond traditional paid marketing.
* Manage channel strategy, campaign planning, budget allocation, and scaling.
* Continuously evaluate channel performance and identify opportunities for growth and optimisation.



  





**Data, Analytics \& Growth Metrics** 



* Define, track, and improve key growth metrics including
 **CAC, CPL, CPQL, application conversion, offer\-to\-enrolment conversion, and acquisition ROI** 
 .
* Use data, cohort analysis, and attribution to understand which audiences, channels, campaigns, and geographies drive the highest\-quality outcomes.
* Build robust dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide clear visibility into campaign, channel, and funnel performance.
* Establish strong attribution and ROI frameworks to guide marketing investments and channel strategy.



  





**Experimentation \& Conversion Optimisation** 



* Drive a structured culture of experimentation across audiences, creatives, messaging, landing pages, campaigns, and acquisition channels.
* Identify funnel gaps and develop experiments to improve conversion at each stage.
* Analyse experiment outcomes and scale initiatives that demonstrate measurable impact.
* Continuously optimise campaigns based on performance and downstream enrolment outcomes.



  





**Brand, Content \& Creative Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Brand, Content, and Creative teams to develop and scale high\-performing campaigns.
* Translate student and parent insights into effective messaging, creative concepts, and campaign strategies.
* Ensure communication is aligned with student aspirations, parent decision\-making, and LIT School's positioning.
* Develop a strong understanding of the education landscape and competitive environment.



  





**Admissions \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Build continuous feedback loops between Marketing, Admissions, and Outreach teams.
* Work closely with Admissions to improve lead quality, application rates, and downstream conversion.
* Identify insights from admissions and outreach teams to improve targeting, messaging, and acquisition strategy.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure marketing efforts are aligned with overall business and enrollment goals.



  





**Leadership, Insights \& Business Impact** 



* Work closely with senior leadership to translate growth data and market insights into acquisition strategy and business decisions.
* Present regular performance updates, insights, challenges, and growth opportunities to leadership.
* Use commercial and customer insights to guide marketing investments and prioritisation.
* Take ownership of acquisition outcomes and continuously identify opportunities to improve growth efficiency and enrollment performance.

title: Account Manager - Digital
description:
**Role: Account Manager \- Digital** 




  





**Position Overview:** 




 We are seeking a talented Social Media Manager to join our dynamic marketing team. As a Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for developing and executing our social media strategies, managing our online presence, and driving engagement across various social media platforms. This role requires a creative and strategic thinker with a deep understanding of social media trends and best practices. The successful candidate will have a passion for storytelling and possess excellent communication and analytical skills.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and implement comprehensive social media strategies aligned with our brand objectives to increase brand awareness, engagement, and drive website traffic.
* Create and curate compelling and shareable content for various social media platforms, including but not limited to Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
* Manage and maintain our social media accounts, ensuring consistent brand voice and visual identity across all channels.
* Lead the planning, execution, and optimization of social media projects from start to finish.
* Develop detailed project timelines, budgets, and milestones to ensure projects are completed on time and within scope.
* Provide regular updates and reports to stakeholders on project progress, key deliverables, and any adjustments to the plan.
* Monitor and analyze social media performance metrics, generate reports, and provide insights to optimize strategies and campaigns.
* Develop and maintain a project timeline with clear milestones and deadlines for each phase of the campaign.
* Engage with our online community by responding to comments, messages, and inquiries promptly and in a professional manner.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align social media efforts with broader marketing initiatives, product launches, and campaigns.
* Stay up\-to\-date with social media trends, emerging platforms, and industry best practices, and proactively identify new opportunities for growth and engagement.
* Research and identify key influencers, partners, and communities to foster strategic collaborations and amplify our brand presence.
* Monitor industry conversations and competitor activities to inform our social media strategies and identify areas for differentiation.
* Stay informed about relevant legal and regulatory requirements pertaining to social media, ensuring compliance in all activities.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* **2\-3 years experience working on medium or large brands only.**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* Proven work experience as a Social Media Manager or similar role, with a strong portfolio showcasing successful social media campaigns.
* **Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.**
* Deep understanding of various social media platforms, their respective strengths, and best practices for content creation, engagement, and growth.
* Proficiency in social media management tools and analytics platforms to measure and track performance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft engaging and persuasive content.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and draw actionable insights.
* Creative thinker with a keen eye for visual aesthetics and storytelling.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines.
* Up\-to\-date knowledge of current trends, tools, and innovations in social media marketing.
* Familiarity with the alcoholic beverage industry or a passion for spirits is a plus.



  





 If you are a self\-driven and passionate social media enthusiast who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and play a pivotal role in shaping our brand's digital presence and engagement across social media platforms.

title: AI Business Strategy Manager

title: B2B Content Marketer

 At Hakimo, we are transforming the physical security industry with AI\-powered solutions that help organizations seamlessly monitor, manage, and respond to security events. Our platform integrates advanced machine learning and analytics to modernize traditional security operations into intelligent, proactive systems.
 



 Backed by $32M in total funding from Vertex Ventures, Zigg Capital, Neotribe Ventures, Rocketship.vc, and Carrier Ventures, Hakimo has tripled its customer base across multifamily apartments, car dealerships, construction sites, and Fortune 500 enterprises.

 We are looking for a Content Marketer to own the words that move buyers. You will write across the funnel, from SEO blog posts that pull in demand to sales enablement assets that help close it. This is a hands\-on writing role on a small marketing team, which means you will ship a lot, own your outcomes, and see your work show up in the pipeline.
 



 You will work closely with the marketing lead to turn technical capability into content that security directors, CXOs, and asset managers actually want to read.

* Own the content calendar across blog, LinkedIn, email, and web.
* Write SEO\-driven blog posts and landing pages that rank and convert.
* Build sales enablement assets: one\-pagers, case studies, battlecards, and outbound sequences.

* Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and how content drives the pipeline.

* Self\-direction. You can take a rough brief and return a finished asset.
* Excellent written English with a plain, direct style.

**Nice To Have:** 




  




* Experience in marketing to real estate, security, facilities, or operations buyers.

**What We Offer:** 




  




* Competitive salary with professional development and growth opportunities.

 Send your resume and 2\-3 writing samples to careers@hakimo.ai.

title: Search Engine Optimization Executive
description:
Job Title: Search Engine Optimization Executive
 



 Location: Ahmedabad
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



 Experiences: 3\-5 Years
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Social Sherpa is looking for an SEO Executive who can drive rankings end\-to\-end from optimizing pages to building authority across international markets. This role requires someone who understands modern SEO across on\-page, off\-page, and international dimensions, and can translate strategy into consistent execution.
 



 We work with clients across multiple industries and geographies, so you'll need to be comfortable managing multiple sites and campaigns simultaneously.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**On\-Page SEO** 




 •     Optimize website pages for target keywords, search intent, and content structure
 



 •     Implement and audit meta tags, header hierarchy, internal linking, and schema markup
 



 •     Align page content with both ranking goals and conversion objectives
 



 •     Collaborate with content and design teams to improve page\-level performance
 



 •     Conduct regular content audits and recommend updates or consolidations
 



**Off\-Page SEO** 




 •     Plan and execute link\-building strategies aligned with client goals
 



 •     Manage outreach for guest posts, citations, digital PR, and backlink acquisition
 



 •     Prioritize high\-quality, topically relevant links over volume
 



 •     Monitor and analyse backlink profiles using tools like Ahrefs or SEMrush
 



 •     Track competitor link strategies and identify gap opportunities
 



**International SEO** 




 •     Implement hreflang tags correctly across multilingual and multiregional pages
 



 •     Advise on URL structure — ccTLD, subdomain, or subdirectory — based on client goals
 



 •     Conduct geo\-specific keyword research for priority international markets
 



 •     Audit and resolve international indexing issues via Google Search Console
 



 •     Coordinate with content teams on localization vs. translation strategy
 



 •     Monitor international SERP performance and flag geo\-targeting issues
 



  





**Reporting \& Analysis** 




 •     Track KPIs: organic traffic, rankings, backlink growth, and click\-through rates
 



 •     Prepare monthly performance reports for clients with actionable insights
 



 •     Use Google Search Console, Analytics, and rank tracking tools for ongoing monitoring
 



  





**Requirements** 




 •     3–5 years of hands\-on SEO experience, ideally within a digital agency
 



 •     Proven experience with international SEO — hreflang, geo\-targeting, multilingual content
 



 •     Proficient in tools: Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Google Analytics
 



 •     Solid understanding of technical SEO: crawlability, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, site structure
 



 •     Experience running link\-building campaigns with measurable results
 



 •     Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with data and drawing insights
 



 •     Good written communication in English; multilingual skills are a bonus
 



 •     Ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously
 



  





 We give strong preference to candidates with experience working on internal client projects within an agency environment — someone comfortable owning deliverables across multiple accounts.
 



  





**Tools You'll Work With** 




 •     Ahrefs / SEMrush — backlink analysis, keyword research, competitor tracking
 



 •     Google Search Console \+ Analytics — performance monitoring and issue diagnosis
 



 •     Screaming Frog — technical crawls and on\-page audits
 



 •     Notion / Google Sheets — reporting and workflow management
 



 •     WordPress / common CMS platforms — content and metadata implementation
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your CV and a brief note on your most impactful SEO result to:
 



**contact@socialsherpa.in** 




 Please include links to any relevant case studies or portfolios where available.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
 As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k\+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward\-thinking consultants provide analytically\-informed, issue\-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
   

  

**What You Would Do In This Role**
 A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day\-to\-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.
   

  

 As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.
   

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities: (GCP CDP)**
* Architect \& Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise\-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Build Production\-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability.
* Model for Insight \& Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360\-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics.

title: Senior UX Researcher
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 


**Senior UX Researcher** 

**Role Located out of:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
 



  

**The Overview** 




 At Okta, we’re building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we’re specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our workforce and users but to ask, “what more can we make possible?”
 



 As a Senior UX Researcher at Okta India, you will join a globally distributed research and design team, shaping customer experiences across the Access Management ecosystem. Your mission is to secure workforce access right from physical device bootup delivering frictionless, phishing resistant, and passwordless authentication across macOS, Windows,Linux, iOS, and Android platforms.
 



 In this role, you will lead end to end research initiatives, translating ambiguous product questions into actionable insights that directly influence long term strategy and near term product decisions across global Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams.
 


**Finer Print** 

 You will join an AI first team of researchers and designers supported by leadership who fosters high autonomy, deep ownership, and a strong culture of craft. As part of Okta’s centralized Design \& Research organization in Bengaluru, you will act as a key research anchor, working closely with cross functional partners in both India and the US to define problems, explore solutions, and drive impact.
 



 You will balance functional, foundational research with generative explorations that help frame new security and identity paradigms in an evolving, technical problem space.
 


**What You Will Do** 

 As the dedicated User Researcher for Access Management in India, you will own the UX research strategy along with an opportunity to act as a foundational builder for our regional research operations.
 


* **Own Access Management Research in India:** 
 Scope, prioritize, and execute generative and evaluative research and aligning cross border roadmaps with high priority business goals across multiple OS platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).
* **Build an Exclusive User Panel:** 
 Go beyond standard recruiting by proactively building and managing a dedicated panel of user personas, ensuring a direct pipeline to our most critical users and cultivating deep customer empathy.
* **Pioneer AI\-Driven Efficiency:** 
 Champion the secure use of AI tools to automate operationalise recurring work such as transcript synthesis, feedback classification, and qualitative coding, freeing up time for deep strategic thinking.
* **Make Research a "Team Sport":** 
 Empower cross functional partners in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own high quality evaluative studies through training frameworks, templates, workflows, etc while mentoring cross function partners to raise the overall research mindset.
* **Exercise Methodological Rigor:** 
 Flexibly apply mixed methodologies including contextual inquiry, usability testing, surveys, and quantitative analysis suited to fast paced product timelines and complex security domains.
* **Drive Global Alignment \& Storytelling:** 
 Collaborate deeply with EPD teams across time zones, synthesizing complex data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for executive stakeholders.


**What We Are Looking For** 
* **Technical Research Expertise:** 
 Demonstrated track record of conducting user research within complex, highly technical B2B, enterprise, security, or developer\-facing domains.
* **Strategic \& Autonomous Thinker:** 
 Ability to translate business goals and technical ambiguity into structured research plans independently while managing competing priorities across multiple product streams.
* **AI Tooling \& Practice:** 
 Curiosity and active experience incorporating AI tools into your research workflow (e.g., automated transcript synthesis, qualitative coding, prompt engineering) to accelerate time\-to\-insight without compromising rigor.
* **Global Collaboration:** 
 Proven success working effectively within globally distributed teams, displaying exceptional written and asynchronous communication skills across overlapping US/APAC working hours.
* **Systems \& Strategic Thinking:** 
 Ability to connect user insights directly to business metrics, product adoption, and technical feasibility.
* **Growth Mindset \& Empathy:**

title: Head - Voice of Customer
description:
At Swish, we want to build a strong understanding of what customers want, what they love, and what makes them unhappy — and use that understanding to continuously improve the food and experience we offer.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head – Voice of Customer to build this function from the ground up.
 



 You will own Swish's Voice of Customer program end\-to\-end — from understanding what customers want before we launch a product, to capturing feedback after launch, identifying recurring problems, and working with Category, Culinary, Operations and Quality teams to fix them.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




  





**Build Swish's Voice of Customer Engine** 




  





 Design and run an always\-on customer feedback system across the customer journey, covering pre\-launch research, new product feedback, negative\-rating triage, customer immersions, interviews, targeted outreach and surprise audits. Decide what we need to learn, from whom, how frequently and through which channel, using the right mix of qualitative and quantitative research.
 



  





**Turn Feedback Into Action** 




  





 Go beyond collecting feedback to identify the actual problem, understand its root cause and determine whether it is a one\-off, product or category\-level issue. Work closely with Category, Culinary, Operations and Quality teams to turn customer feedback → root cause → action → measurable improvement. The role will be measured on issues resolved and outcomes improved, not the number of calls or insights generated.
 



  





**Prioritise Research \& Drive Decisions** 




  





 Build the framework to determine which categories and SKUs need deeper research, when to trigger audits, when patterns need escalation and where the VoC team's time and resources should be invested. Bring customer evidence into decisions around new launches, recipe changes, relaunches, taste, quality, portioning, pricing, packaging and assortment.
 



  





**Build \& Lead the VoC Team** 




  





 Hire, coach and manage the initial VoC team, set clear goals and operating cadences, and build strong capabilities in customer conversations, probing, research and root\-cause identification. Create a team that is accountable for outcomes rather than activity.
 



  





**Continuously Improve the System** 




  





 Own and improve the questionnaires, interview frameworks, sampling, feedback channels, tracking, reporting, escalation mechanisms and research methodology as the business grows.
 



  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 8\+ years of overall experience, with 3–4\+ years of people management experience.
* Experience building and running customer research, insights or CX programs in\-house, rather than only managing external agencies.
* Experience in consumer internet, food\-tech, FMCG or another high\-frequency consumer business.
* Experience running customer research or feedback programs at operational scale — not just occasional market research projects.
* Someone who has owned a business/customer metric end\-to\-end, rather than only producing reports or insights for another team.
* Experience working closely with Operations, Category/Product, Quality and other cross\-functional teams to drive changes based on customer feedback.



  





**We Particularly Value** 




  




* Someone who has built a function from scratch — team, processes, tools and operating cadence.
* Experience with both qualitative and quantitative research.
* Strong understanding of customer interviews, surveys, ratings/reviews and customer feedback analysis.
* Experience managing calling or field teams and understanding operational metrics such as connect rates, response rates, call fatigue and script adherence.
* Experience in food, FMCG, QSR or other categories where taste, freshness, quality, portioning and value directly influence customer satisfaction.



  





**What Good Looks Like** 




  





**In the first 6–12 months, you should have:** 




  




* Built a functioning VoC team and operating cadence.
* Created a reliable system to capture and prioritise customer feedback.
* Established clear feedback loops across categories and products.
* Identified recurring customer problems and driven them to resolution.
* Built a strong mechanism for feeding customer insights into launches, product changes and category decisions.
* Demonstrated measurable improvement in relevant customer metrics such as ratings, complaints, repeat issues or product\-level satisfaction.

title: Senior Advanced Analyst, Fraud & Safety Investigations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

**Description**
 Airbnb was born in 2007 when two Hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 4 million Hosts who have welcomed more than 1 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, Hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

 The Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACOE) at Airbnb, based in India, is a hub of knowledge and expertise that aims to provide data\-driven decision\-making, enabling Airbnb's business goals. The ACOE's vision is to build a world\-class analytics organization that provides scalable analytics. We work with various business functions such as payments, trust, digital, customer support, hosting, sales, social, compliance, risk, platforms and partnership \& economics.
   

  

 The ACOE's delivery framework is designed to provide relevant and contextual insights for data\-driven decisions. This includes a one\-stop solution for metrics, dashboards driving actionable insights, optimization of performance, measuring pre/post feature impact, sizing the ROI of opportunities, prioritization of opportunities, anomaly\-driven alerting mechanisms, root cause analysis of metric deviation, and exploratory hypothesis testing.
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 We are looking for a senior advanced analyst in our India Analytics team who works with the Fraud \& Safety Delivery team. The analyst must have functional expertise in building analytical solutions and be a trusted partner to product teams and business leaders, across marketplace teams through providing insights, recommendations, and enabling data driven decisions. This role will sit under the Advanced Analytics family and support Product and Business leaders within our Fraud \& Safety organization.
   

  

**The Difference You Will Make**
* Work with technical and business teams to develop robust insights, create data narratives and leverage Airbnb’s rich data to define metrics.
* Build advanced analytical capabilities and tools, passionate about solving complex problems with data; adding a new perspective to existing solutions and making business decisions based on careful and thoughtful analysis.
* Leverage Airbnb’s state\-of\-art machine learning infrastructure, and other central data science tools to build and collaborate with a strong team of engineers, product managers, designers and operation agents to achieve shared, cross\-functional goals.
* You have a strong sense of urgency for and commitment to Airbnb’s mission of belonging.
* Develop a deep understanding of how guests and hosts interact with our Fraud \& Safety frictions and how we can manage our risk while meeting our regulatory compliance requirements, through structured and unstructured data sources.


**A Typical Day**
* Execute projects with regular direction; Set a roadmap for projects up to a quarter ahead providing constant updates to business stakeholders, analytics management and deliver against agreed timelines.
* Ensure the availability of data quality and data integrity for analysis and reporting, by blending external and internal data, working closely with global operations and India analytics functions.
* Perform data modeling for the various entities involved in Airbnb including customers, hosts, cases, agents, and others using modern data modeling tools and frameworks to provide the analytical foundation.
* Execute ad\-hoc reporting, data investigations, and root cause analysis into various operational areas including policy incubation, enforcement efficacy, prevalence, efficiency, agent tooling, agent staffing \& optimization, and agent quality \& efficiency to identify and solve for operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies.
* Devise business metric frameworks and optimization models to make optimal business decisions that support arguments for Airbnb’s product, operations and policy issues
* Influence data\-driven decisions across global sites and business verticals in day\-to\-day via business reviews, self\-serve portal, planning scorecards, and impact analyses among others.
* Experiment with new Airbnb policy / product features to help deter and mitigate risk
* Influence machine learning models in partnership with DS / Engg teams to automate policy enforcement decisions, while enqueueing the most complex cases for manual review by agents


**Your Expertise**
* 6\+ years of industry experience and an Advanced degree in Business Analytics or other (Masters or PhD is a plus) in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research).
* Good communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with internal teams in a cross\-cultural and cross\-functional environment. Ability to conduct rigorous analysis and communicate conclusions to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Proven track record of delivering full stack data projects from inception to business impact.
* Advanced level proficiency in SQL/NoSQL, programming languages such as Python, R, SAS and Intermediate level knowledge of data foundations and databases like Presto, Hive, Teradata, Spark.
* Advanced level proficiency in statistical and machine learning techniques, Tableau or similar BI platform to develop reports and dashboards
* Familiarity with EDA, hypothesis testing, significance testing, linear regression, logistic regression, SVM, ridge regression, lasso regression, random forest, basic concepts of NLP, KNN, K\-Means, A/B testing, multivariate testing, and digital funnel testing.
* Have a positive and solution\-oriented mindset with an ability to maintain confidentiality and objectivity.
* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities, self\-motivation and ability to work autonomously, strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Knowledge and experience in Fraud \& Safety operations, systems and tools would be a plus


**Our Commitment To Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively\-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**How We'll Take Care Of You**
 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
   

  

 India Annual Pay Range
   

  

 ₹1,960,000—₹2,800,000 INR
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodations:** 
 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
   

  

**A Note on Recruiting Scams:** 
 Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work\-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

 Required Qualifications \& Experience

title: Fenergo / Actimize / Pega  or Any KYC platform QA/Test Resource
description:
**We are hiring a Fenergo / Actimize / Pega or Any KYC platform QA/Test Resource** 




**Experience: 5\-7 Years** 




**Mode: Hybrid** 




**Location: Bangalore,Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune,Noida,** 




**Notice Period: Immediate to 15 Days** 




**Shift Timing – 11 AM to 8 PM,** 




  





  





  





 The QA/Test resource is accountable for validating that the Fenergo platform configuration including client lifecycle management (CLM), onboarding workflows, KYC/AML rules, product/entity data models, workflow orchestration, and integrations meets business, regulatory, and technical requirements before it reaches production. This role bridges Business Analysts, Configuration/Development teams, and Compliance/Operations stakeholders to ensure the solution is fit for purpose, accurate, and audit\-ready.
 



  





**Required Skills** 




 Fenergo / Actimize / Pega or Any KYC platform
 



 FUNCTIONAL TESTING,
 



 INTEGRATION TESTING,
 



 AUTOMATED TESTING,
 



 TEST DESIGN,
 



 ANTI\-MONEY LAUNDERING (AML),
 



 KYC REGULATORY COMPLIANCE,
 



 RISK ASSESSMENT,
 



 FINANCIAL CRIME,
 



 QA TESTING,
 



 REGRESSION TESTING,
 



 MANUAL TESTING TEST,
 



 CASE DEVELOPMENT,
 



 TEST REPORTING.
 



  





**Preferred Skills** 




 USER TESTING,
 



 WEB TESTING,
 



 VALIDATION TESTING,
 



 DATA QUALITY
 



  





**1\. Test Strategy \& Planning** 




 • Define the overall test strategy for the Fenergo implementation, covering unit, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression, performance, and data migration testing.
 



 • Develop the Master Test Plan aligned to the project delivery phases, including Discovery, Design, Build, SIT, UAT, Go\-Live, and Hypercare. • Identify test entry and exit criteria, environments, tooling, and resourcing needs.
 



 • Align the test scope to the Fenergo modules in use, such as Entity Data Management, Risk Assessment, Regulatory Rules Engine, Workflow, Document Management, Case Management, and Client Outreach/Portal.
 



  





**2\. Requirements \& Design Review** 




 • Review Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, and configuration workbooks, including product, entity, and jurisdiction matrices, risk rules, and workflow designs, for testability and completeness.
 



 • Raise ambiguities or gaps in requirements before the build begins.
 



 • Map regulatory requirements, including AML, KYC, CDD, EDD, FATCA/CRS, and sanctions screening where applicable, to expected system behavior.
 



  





**3\. Test Case Design** 




 • Design test scenarios and detailed test cases or scripts covering:
 



 • Client and entity onboarding journeys across products and jurisdictions.
 



 • Workflow routing, task assignment, and escalation logic.
 



 • Risk scoring and rule engine outcomes.
 



 • Document collection, generation, and e\-signature integration.
 



 • Data mapping and integration touchpoints, such as core banking, screening providers, CRM, and DMS.
 



 • Periodic review, remediation, and event\-driven review triggers.
 



 • Reporting and management information (MI) extracts.
 



 • Maintain a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) linking test cases to requirements and rules.
 



  





**4\. Test Execution** 




 • Execute SIT to validate configuration, workflow logic, and integrations end to end.
 



 • Coordinate and support UAT with business and compliance stakeholders, including facilitation, triage, and sign\-off tracking.
 



 • Perform regression testing after configuration changes, patches, or Fenergo version upgrades.
 



 • Validate data migration accuracy for legacy client and entity data moved into Fenergo, where applicable.
 



 • Document test evidence to a standard suitable for internal audit and regulatory review.
 



  





**5\. Defect Management** 




 • Log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution using the agreed tool, such as JIRA or Azure DevOps (ADO).
 



 • Run defect triage sessions with configuration and development teams and business stakeholders.
 



 • Verify fixes and manage regression cycles.
 



 • Maintain defect metrics and status reporting for governance forums.
 



  





 6\.
 **Environment \& Data Management** 




 • Coordinate test data setup using mock or anonymized client and entity data that covers the required product, jurisdiction, and risk combinations.
 



  





**7\. Reporting \& Governance** 




 • Provide regular test progress reports, including execution percentage, pass/fail rates, defect burn\-down, and risk log, to the Project or Program Manager.
 



 • Present go/no\-go readiness assessments before each release or Go\-Live milestone.
 



 • Proactively escalate risks relating to resourcing, scope, environment instability, or the defect backlog.

 **build, test, deploy, monitor** 
 agents and multi‑agent workflows with strong
 **observability, evaluation, guardrails and RBAC** 
 across any cloud or LLM framework. It includes a
 **no/low‑code development console** 
 ,
 **Agent \& MCP Gateways** 
 , and an enterprise marketplace for reusable
 **agents, tools, connections and guardrails** 
 .
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for
 **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** 
 to join the founding Cogentiq team. As an FDE, you will work at the intersection of
 **software engineering, AI, enterprise integration, and customer success** 
 .
   

  

 You will partner closely with enterprise customers to understand their business challenges, design AI\-powered solutions, build production\-grade integrations, and deploy Cogentiq into complex enterprise environments. Beyond customer implementations, you'll help shape the evolution of the Cogentiq platform by transforming deployment learnings into reusable platform capabilities, connectors, and best practices.
   

  

 This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving ambiguous, real\-world problems, thrive in fast\-paced environments, and are excited to build the next generation of Enterprise AI.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and develop production\-grade AI applications using the Cogentiq platform.
* Deploy enterprise AI solutions from proof of concept to production.
* Build integrations with enterprise applications such as SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Snowflake, Databricks, and other business systems.
* Develop reusable connectors, APIs, SDKs, MCP servers, and automation components.
* Design secure, scalable, cloud\-native architectures and build reliable backend services and microservices.
* Collaborate directly with customer engineering and business teams to understand requirements, conduct technical workshops, and deliver successful AI solutions.
* Troubleshoot production deployments, optimize system performance, and ensure reliability and security.
* Capture learnings from customer deployments and contribute reusable capabilities back to the Cogentiq platform.
* Work closely with AI engineers, platform engineers, product managers, and solution architects to continuously improve the platform.


**What We're Looking For**
* Strong Software Engineering: You have strong software engineering fundamentals and are proficient in Python, with experience in Java or TypeScript being a plus. You have built production\-grade backend applications, REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems, and are comfortable working with databases, Git, and modern software development practices.
* AI Engineering: You have hands\-on experience building AI\-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation techniques. Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and modern AI orchestration frameworks is highly desirable.
* Enterprise Integration: You have experience integrating enterprise applications and platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Snowflake, Databricks, and other business systems. You understand enterprise integration patterns, API\-first architectures, authentication mechanisms such as OAuth, JWT, and SAML, and are comfortable working with SQL, REST, and GraphQL APIs.
* Cloud \& Platform Engineering: You have experience building and deploying cloud\-native applications on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud using Docker and Kubernetes. You understand CI/CD pipelines, event\-driven architectures, messaging platforms, observability, monitoring, and security best practices required to build reliable enterprise platforms.
* Customer \& Product Mindset: You enjoy working directly with customers to understand their business challenges and translate them into elegant technical solutions. You communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders, are comfortable leading architecture discussions and technical workshops, and thrive in environments where requirements evolve rapidly. You take ownership of outcomes, learn quickly, prototype rapidly, and continuously look for opportunities to transform customer\-specific solutions into reusable platform capabilities.


**Why Join Cogentiq?**
* Join the founding engineering team building Fractal's flagship Enterprise AI platform.
* Work on cutting\-edge technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, Enterprise Context, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Knowledge Graphs, and AI Governance.
* Solve complex enterprise challenges for some of the world's leading organizations.
* Influence both customer success and the future direction of the Cogentiq platform.
* Build reusable capabilities that will power enterprise AI deployments across industries.
* Collaborate with a team passionate about redefining how enterprises adopt and scale AI.


**Our Ideal Candidate**
 We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving
 **real customer problems** 
 , not just implementing predefined tickets. You should be equally comfortable writing production\-grade code, designing enterprise integrations, collaborating with customer teams, and shaping the future of the Cogentiq platform. If you're excited about building enterprise\-grade AI systems that create meaningful business impact, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

**Standardization \& Best Practices**
* Establish monitoring standards, observability patterns, and dashboard blueprints
* Implement structured logging, correlation IDs, and traceability across distributed systems
* Contribute to observability maturity including automated alerts, runbooks, and analytics


**Qualifications**

* Strong experience with Grafana and Prometheus
* Experience setting up monitoring dashboards, alerts, and observability pipelines

description:

 : Consultant
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 5\-7 years
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Data Scientist** 
 with strong hands\-on experience in
 **Machine Learning, Generative AI, and AWS services** 
 . The ideal candidate should be able to translate business problems into data science solutions, develop and deploy AI/ML models, and work with AWS\-based data and AI services.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Principal Engineer**

* **Opportunity to be one of our first team members in Woolworths Group India in Bangalore.**



  





***Woolworths Group India is partnering exclusively with Zinnov Group to recruit for this position.***




  





**About this role** 




 As an established member of a Hosting team, the
 **Principle** 
**Engineer** 
 independently delivers, operates, and improves the team's services, with a focused emphasis on designing, building, managing, delivering and influencing those services through code and automation. The role takes ownership of well\-defined pieces of work end\-to\-end and contributes to the reliability, security, and continuous improvement of the team's service domain.

title: Senior Manager-Operations & Customer Experience
description:
**About Company:** 




 Blissclub is one of India’s fastest\-growing apparel brands, built with a singular mission: to build comfortable and functional apparel for India. We are reimagining the apparel space not just designing products, but building a movement. What started as a community\-first D2C brand has expanded into experience\-led retail destinations where our Blissqueens don’t just shop, they connect, discover, and belong.
 



 Founded in 2020 by ISB alum Minu Margeret, Blissclub raised its Series A of $15 million in May 2022, led by Eight Roads Ventures and Elevation Capital. This was followed by a Pre\-Series B round of ₹33 crore and a Series B round of ₹160 crore, led by Singularity.
 



 Featured on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list in 2022 and 2025, we’re one of India’s fastest\-growing D2C brands redefining comfortable apparel for India.
 



  





**Job Location** 
 : HSR Layout, Bangalore (on\-site)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're hiring a Senior Manager Operations \& Customer Experience: someone who can hold two things at once the rigour to run tight backend operations, and the empathy to obsess over every customer interaction.This role spans two interconnected charters. First, you'll own the operational engine that powers BlissClub's fulfillment warehousing, logistics, and systems across D2C, retail, and marketplaces. Second, and equally important, you'll own the end\-to\-end Customer Experience from the moment someone lands on our website or walks into a store, to what happens after they've placed an order, received it, and reached out for help.You'll work directly with the founding and leadership team as a strategic thought partner helping shape how BlissClub scales intelligently, not just fast. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, builds for the long term, and holds themselves accountable to measurable outcomes.
 



  





**Key ResponsibilitiesOperations Strategy \& Fulfillment** 



* Manage warehouse operations end\-to\-end: inventory accuracy, replenishment planning, ageing, and loss prevention across channels.
* Optimize dispatch and logistics across D2C, marketplaces, retail, and quick commerce managing SLAs, reducing RTOs, and improving delivery TATs through strong vendor partnerships.
* Ensure seamless order flow, packaging standards, and post\-order experience across all fulfillment formats.
* Lead sourcing and procurement for packaging and operational materials.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Sourcing, Finance, Category, and Growth on demand planning and cost control.



  





**Customer Experience** 



* Own BlissClub's end\-to\-end customer experience across our website, retail stores, and all post\-purchase touchpoints with customer NPS as your north star metric.
* Design and implement the CX strategy: mapping the full customer journey, identifying friction points, and building interventions that measurably improve satisfaction and loyalty.
* Lead and scale the customer support function building team capacity, processes, and tooling to handle growing query volumes across channels (email, chat, social, in\-store).
* Own the voice of the customer inside BlissClub: synthesize support data, CSAT signals, return patterns, and NPS feedback into actionable insights for product, marketing, and ops teams.
* Define and track CX metrics across the funnel from pre\-purchase (website and store experience) to post\-purchase (delivery, returns, support).



  





**Qualifications** 



* 7–10 years of experience, with meaningful time in consumer brands D2C, retail, or both. You've run operations
 *and* 
 thought seriously about customer experience, not just one or the other.
* Strong analytical ability: comfortable building frameworks, working with data, and translating insight into action.
* Experience with multi\-channel fulfilment including Q\-commerce, retail, and marketplaces.
* A deep understanding of inventory systems, warehousing workflows, and logistics SLAs. You should be adept at optimizing these processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Experience leading cross\-functional work you know how to align teams around a shared goal without formal authority.
* A founder mindset: you don't wait to be asked, you don't hand problems upward, and you raise the standard of whatever you touch.
* Excellent communication written and verbal. You can present a strategic recommendation as clearly as you can write a customer\-facing SOP.



  





**Why Join Blissclub** 



* A seat at the table: you'll work directly with the founding team and have genuine influence over how this company is built.
* Real ownership: this role shapes Blissclub's operational future you'll see the impact of your decisions every day.
* Competitive compensation and ESOPs.
* A brand people love, a product that's genuinely differentiated, and a team that cares deeply about doing things right.
* The chance to build something meaningful for a community of women who show up for themselves every day.



  






 https://blissclub.com/

title: SW Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Identity and Access Management (IAM)** 
 team is responsible for securing employee access to our core applications in the most efficient, compliant, and user\-friendly manner, leveraging the latest industry standards and tools.
   

  

 Visa's IAM eco\-system includes a highly customized, feature\-rich Identity Management platform. The team has successfully implemented many core components, and as the security landscape evolves, we continuously explore new processes and technology to expand security coverage and enhance the end\-user experience.
   

  

 With new features and broader coverage comes increased complexity, criticality, and dependency on the environment.
   

  

 We are seeking a motivated Software Engineer – whether an aspiring IAM Specialist or an experienced IAM Engineer with development background \- to join our Global team of IAM experts. In this role, you will contribute to the ongoing development, operations and support of our IAM environment while collaborating with IT teams and Cybersecurity stakeholders across Visa.
   

  

 As one of the leaders in AI adoption, we are particularly interested in talent who can harness advanced technologies for automation and process optimization.
   

  

**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**
* An understanding of Identity and Access Management and core security concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one programming language.
* The ability to develop integrated solutions and troubleshoot challenging issues.
* A proactive mindset and a willingness to take on complex challenges.


**Essential Functions**
 The Software Engineer will:
   

  

 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

* Take ownership of assigned initiatives—assessing existing solutions, eliciting and refining requirements, and contributing to technical design discussions to promote best\-practice architectures.
* Design, develop, and implement new capabilities using appropriate technologies and tools, following Scrum/Agile methodologies to meet project milestones and deliverables.
* Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities, execute disaster\-recovery protocols, and maintain high solution availability in accordance with SLAs.
* Apply Generative AI capabilities to:
+ Deploy AI agents to autonomously execute operational workflows, coordinate multi\-step tasks, and assist teams with proactive issue resolution.
+ Leverage MCP servers to securely connect AI applications with enterprise tools, data sources, and infrastructure for context\-aware automation and decision support.
+ Automate log analysis and detect anomalies in access events.
+ Generate and optimize system code for performance and security.
+ Create AI\-assisted documentation and troubleshooting guides for faster onboarding and support.
+ Enable natural language interfaces for administrative tooling to simplify complex operational tasks.

* Collaborate with global service teams to capture business needs and ensure alignment with agreed design strategies.
* As an Engineering team, Partner with Platform teams, Access Management team, Auditing team, Infrastructure team throughout the implementation life cycle to enable efficient, timely rollouts.
* Coordinate with team leads and international colleagues to keep projects on schedule and achieve defined business objectives.
* Remain self\-driven and eager to learn the IAM technology stack, adapting quickly to new tools and approaches.
* Champion the use of data\-science and AI techniques to innovate, automate, and streamline processes, reducing manual effort for end users.


**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2 or more years of work experience.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or equivalent with 2\+ years of relevant work experience.
* 1\+ years of hands\-on programming experience in Java, Spring Boot, Web services, Rest API, SOAP, Python, Node.js, Data Structures, Angular.js \+. Good UI development skills is a big plus and experience in at least 3 skills/ programming languages/ scripting/ frameworks is mandatory. Preferred to have any IAM tool experience like SailPoint, OIM, OKTA etc..
* Knowledge of Linux ecosystem and experience with bash scripting.
* Hands\-on development experience with the following IAM tool – SailPoint, is highly desirable.
* Exposure to AI/ML techniques, AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and GenAI\-assisted development platforms (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cline, Claude code), with an interest in applying AI to code generation, log analysis, anomaly detection, and security automation.
* Understanding of security principles, including zero trust architecture and privileged access management.
* Familiarity with web\-service technologies (REST), Application programming interfaces (APIs), JavaScript frameworks, and SQL/relational databases.
* Experience troubleshooting applications and services in complex, distributed network environments, strong analytical skills for diagnosing and resolving multifaceted technical issues.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery, DevOps practices, and test automation, experience with tools such as Jira, Git/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and Linux\-based monitoring/logging solutions (e.g., Splunk).
* Demonstrated aptitude for quickly learning new programming languages, security tools, and infrastructure technologies, with a keen interest in emerging fields such as AI, ML, and cybersecurity automation.
* The candidate should have the ability and proven skills to solve business problems in the IAM/ Security Domain.
* Adopt AI tools and capabilities and be able to conceptualize and build new solutions leveraging AI.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Software Testing Engineer - Medical Devices
description:
About the job
 



**Company Description:** 




 At Capla, we are redefining the future of surgery through intelligent, connected, and data\-driven medical technologies. Our mission is to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human\-centered by combining AI, machine learning, cloud computing, and advanced visualization systems.
 



 We are developing next\-generation surgical navigation and OR integration platforms that empower surgeons with precision, real\-time insights, and intuitive control—ultimately improving patient outcomes worldwide.
 



 Capla’s strength comes from its multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, surgeons, robotic and biomedical engineers, AI and ML specialists, quality experts, and data scientists. Together, we are building technologies that bring intelligence, accuracy, and trust to every step of the surgical workflow.
 



 As an early and rapidly growing healthcare startup, Capla offers an exciting environment for those who want to contribute directly to products shaping the future of modern surgery.
 



**Job ID:** 
 CV26003
 



**Department:** 
 R\&D – Verification \& Validation
 



**Reports to:** 
 R\&D / System Engineering Lead
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Hybrid
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time (100%)
 



**Position Summary** 




 As a
 **Testing Engineer** 
 , you will be responsible for verification and validation of Capla’s surgical navigation and medical technology platforms, ensuring that software, hardware, and integrated system functionality meet defined product, clinical, safety, performance, quality, and regulatory requirements.
 



 You will work closely with software, hardware, systems, clinical, and Quality \& Regulatory teams to develop and execute structured testing throughout the medical device development lifecycle.
 



 The role requires a strong understanding of medical device testing protocols, verification and validation, regulatory requirements, traceability, risk management, and controlled documentation.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Verification \& Validation** 



* Develop, review, and execute verification and validation plans, protocols, test cases, and reports
* Perform testing according to approved procedures, acceptance criteria, and Capla’s Quality Management System
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, performance, reliability, accuracy, and safety\-related testing
* Verify product functionality against approved user, system, software, and product requirements
* Conduct end\-to\-end testing of surgical navigation workflows and clinical use cases
* Support verification of software, hardware, imaging, tracking, instruments, and peripheral integrations
* Perform negative, edge\-case, fault\-condition, and abnormal\-use testing
* Support simulated\-use and clinically representative system testing



**Software \& System Testing** 



* Test applications running on Linux / Embedded Linux platforms
* Validate integration between software modules, hardware components, sensors, tracking systems, imaging systems, and external devices
* Perform interface, API, connectivity, and data\-flow testing
* Conduct installation, configuration, upgrade, recovery, and restart testing
* Test system alerts, logging, data integrity, error handling, and failure\-recovery mechanisms
* Support accuracy, repeatability, latency, calibration, registration, and system\-performance testing where applicable



**Medical Device Testing Protocols** 



* Translate product and system requirements into structured, measurable test cases
* Define test prerequisites, methods, expected results, acceptance criteria, and objective evidence
* Execute approved test protocols and document deviations according to QMS procedures
* Maintain complete test records, logs, measurements, screenshots, and supporting evidence
* Ensure testing is repeatable, traceable, and suitable for regulatory review
* Document failed tests, anomalies, and deviations and ensure appropriate investigation and re\-testing



**Test Automation \& Defect Management** 



* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and functional testing
* Use tools such as Python for test automation, data analysis, and test utilities
* Support CI/CD and automated testing environments
* Analyse logs, test outputs, and performance data to identify root causes of failures
* Identify, document, reproduce, classify, and track software and system defects
* Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing
* Support root cause analysis and corrective actions



**Regulatory, Quality \& QMS** 



* Work according to Capla’s ISO 13485\-based Quality Management System
* Support compliance with applicable standards including IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366\-1, IEC 60601 series, EU MDR 2017/745, and FDA Quality System requirements
* Understand the relationship between user needs, system requirements, software requirements, identified risks, verification activities, and regulatory evidence
* Support verification of risk\-control measures defined through risk\-management activities
* Participate in design reviews, risk reviews, verification reviews, and release\-readiness reviews
* Support Quality \& Regulatory teams during audits, inspections, regulatory submissions, and technical documentation preparation
* Follow applicable design\-control, document\-control, change\-control, non\-conformance, and CAPA processes



**Documentation \& Traceability** 



* Prepare and maintain test protocols, test reports, verification evidence, and deviation reports
* Maintain end\-to\-end requirement\-to\-test traceability
* Support maintenance of Requirements Traceability Matrices
* Ensure testing documentation is complete, version\-controlled, reviewed, approved, and audit\-ready
* Support software and system release documentation
* Provide verification evidence required for Design History Files and regulatory technical documentation



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, Mechatronics, Medical Technology, or related field
* 3\+ years of experience in software testing, system testing, verification, validation, or medical device testing
* Strong understanding of software and system testing methodologies
* Experience developing and executing structured test protocols and test cases
* Experience with functional, integration, regression, system\-level, and performance testing
* Experience working with Linux\-based systems
* Ability to analyse logs, reproduce defects, and troubleshoot complex systems
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem\-solving skills



**Preferred** 



* Experience in medical device verification and validation
* Understanding of ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366\-1, IEC 60601, EU MDR, and FDA medical device requirements
* Experience working within an ISO 13485 Quality Management System
* Experience preparing regulatory or audit\-ready verification documentation
* Experience with requirement management and traceability tools
* Experience with Python or other test automation frameworks
* Familiarity with Jira, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and test management tools
* Experience testing hardware\-software integrated products
* Exposure to surgical navigation, medical imaging, robotics, tracking systems, computer vision, DICOM, or 3D visualization
* Experience with design controls, risk management, CAPA, and change\-control processes
* If interested, please reply with the Job ID in the subject line, along with your updated CV, current notice period, and expected compensation to
 **jobs@caplagroup.com** 
 .

title: Technology Architect
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Technology Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Discrete Event Simulation
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Simulation Engineer specializing in Warehouse Operations, you will drive operational excellence by developing and analyzing discrete event simulation models using tools like Simio, Flexsim, and Anylogic. Your work will focus on optimizing warehouse processes such as order picking, packing, shipping, receiving, and inventory management to address challenges like e\-commerce demand surges, automation integration, and space constraints. By performing throughput analysis, bottleneck identification, and material flow optimization, you will deliver actionable insights to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Design and develop discrete event simulation models for warehouse operations, including order fulfillment, inventory management, and material handling processes.
* Analyze warehouse layouts, staffing levels, and equipment utilization to optimize throughput and minimize bottlenecks.
* Conduct material flow analysis to streamline operations, reduce handling times, and optimize storage configurations.

title: Mathematics Teacher
description:
**who we are** 




  





 Openhouse is building a new\-age learning ecosystem for children, bringing high\-quality learning experiences across academics, sports and extracurriculars closer to where children live. Backed by leading investors including Accel, Matrix Partners and GSV, Openhouse has grown to 12 learning centres across Bangalore, reaching 10,000\+ children through our centres and programs. We are now taking this experience beyond our centres and into the communities where families live.
 



  





 Over the last three months, we have already gone live in 12\+ apartments, bringing Openhouse's learning experiences directly into residential communities. This is just the beginning. Our ambition is to build a significant At Apartment and At Home presence across Bangalore, making high\-quality learning accessible without children having to travel across the city.
 



  





**what you will do** 




  





**Teach maths to children, one child at a time this is a teaching role You will be in children's homes, teaching maths.** 




  




* **Teach** 
 : Deliver 1:1 Maths sessions in children's homes through our At Home programme, for children aged 5–12\.
* **Understand the child** 
 : Work out where each child actually is and what they have not understood, and teach to that.
* Make it click: Explain ideas so a child understands them, rather than memorises a rule.
* **Advise** 
 on our curriculum: We are building the Maths curriculum in\-house. You will not be writing it. We will come to you for a maths teacher's view—does this make sense, is the order right, will a child of this age follow it.
* **Improve** 
 : Bring back what you see in sessions so what we build keeps getting better.



  





**who we’re looking** 



* 4–6 years of experience teaching Maths to children aged 5–12\.
* Strong command of school\-level Maths—and someone who genuinely enjoys the subject.
* Comfortable teaching 1:1 in a child's home, travelling to homes across Bangalore.
* Patient and clear, able to read a child's level and adjust on the spot.
* Based in Bangalore and available full\-time.



  





 You do not need curriculum design experience. If you have it, that is a bonus, not a requirement.
 



  





**the opportunity** 




**Teaching that is actually one\-on\-one.** 




 No class of forty, no syllabus to rush through. One child at a time, taught at the pace that child needs, with the time to find out what they have really understood. You will be among the first maths teachers in our At Home programme, and the person whose view we ask for as we build the maths curriculum behind it.
 



  





**Teach. Explore. Build. Lead.** 




  





**the practical bits** 



* Location: Bangalore
* Experience: 2\-6 years
* Function: Maths teacher
* Reporting to: Academics LxD Lead
* CTC: Rs 4,00,000 \- 6,00,000 per year

title: Senior Software Development Engineer Test
description:
**About Resillion** 




  





 Resillion is a global provider of digital assurance, cybersecurity, and testing services. We help organisations strengthen their security posture, protect critical assets, and deliver high\-quality digital solutions. Our teams operate across multiple specialist disciplines, including Digital Forensics, Incident Response, SOC Operations, Quality \& Compliance, and Technical Consultancy. We are committed to excellence, continuous improvement, and delivering trusted, customer\-focused services that meet the highest professional and accreditation standards.
 



  





**Job title \-** 
 Senior SDET
 



**Experience:** 
 8\+ Years
 



**Reports to:** 
 Global Solution Architect
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
 



**Direct Reports:** 
 No
 



**Department:** 
 QE
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) who approaches quality as an engineering discipline.
 



 This role goes beyond writing automated tests; you will design and build systems that enable scalable, reliable testing, including tools, frameworks, and supporting services that improve how teams validate software.
 



 You will work across multiple layers of the engineering ecosystem, helping teams validate APIs, services, data flows, and user journeys, while building the supporting tooling that makes testing faster, more reliable, and more insightful.
 



 This role is well suited to engineers who enjoy building internal platforms, automation utilities, test harnesses, data tooling, and diagnostic systems, and who are building/leveraging approaches such as AI\-assisted testing and intelligent quality tooling.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Engineering for Quality** 




 Design and build engineering solutions that support quality at scale, including:
 


* Test harnesses for validating services and distributed systems
* Stubs and mocks for isolating dependencies
* Simulation frameworks for testing complex workflows
* Internal tooling that enables developers to validate their systems earlier



 Develop reusable components that allow teams to test services and integrations without relying on full environments.
 



**Test Infrastructure \& Tooling** 




 Build and maintain the technical infrastructure that enables effective testing, including:
 


* Automation frameworks for UI, API, and integration testing
* Test data generation and environment validation tools
* Diagnostics and debugging utilities
* Execution orchestration tools for CI/CD environments



 Develop internal libraries, utilities, and services that improve the reliability and speed of automated validation.
 



**AI\-Driven Quality Engineering** 




 Deisng and implement AI\-assisted approaches to improving quality engineering, such as:
 


* AI\-assisted test generation
* automated defect analysis
* intelligent test maintenance
* anomaly detection in test results



 Contribute to the development of internal AI\-enabled tooling that improves testing efficiency and insight
 



**Observability \& Quality Insights** 




 Design and build reporting and analytics capabilities that provide insight into system quality, including:
 


* Test execution reporting dashboards
* Quality metrics and trend analysis
* Integration with observability platforms
* Defect and reliability analysis tooling



 Leverage data to provide actionable insights into product stability, coverage, and risk.
 



**System\-Level Validation** 




 Work across the full system stack to validate behaviour including:
 


* APIs and service interactions
* Distributed systems and microservices
* Data pipelines and persistence layers
* Integration points between internal and external services



 Investigate failures by analysing logs, metrics, traces, and system behaviour, identifying root causes rather than simply reporting defects.
 



  





**CI/CD \& Engineering Integration** 




 Embed automated validation into development workflows by integrating testing into:
 


* CI/CD pipelines
* Pull request validation
* environment readiness checks
* deployment verification processes



 Collaborate with platform and DevOps teams to ensure quality checks are automated, scalable, and reliable.
 



**Required Skills \& Experience** 




**Software Engineering** 




 Strong development experience in one or more programming languages, such as:
 


* Java
* Python
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* C\#



 Experience designing maintainable, production\-quality code used for automation, tooling, or internal engineering platforms.
 



**Test Engineering** 




 Experience building automated validation across:
 


* APIs and service layers
* integration workflows
* user interfaces (where appropriate)



 Experience with modern automation frameworks such as:
 


* Playwright
* Selenium / WebDriverIO
* Cypress
* Pytest / JUnit / NUnit



  





**Engineering Tooling \& Test Infrastructure** 




 Experience building or maintaining engineering tools such as:
 


* test harnesses
* mock or stub services
* simulation tools
* test data generators
* environment validation utilities



 Ability to design solutions that enable developers to test systems more effectively.
 



**CI/CD \& Platform Integration** 




 Experience integrating automated testing into pipelines such as:
 


* Azure DevOps
* GitHub Actions
* Jenkins



 Familiarity with modern engineering environments including:
 


* Git\-based development workflows
* containerised environments (Docker)
* cloud platforms and distributed systems



**Data \& Diagnostics** 




 Experience working with databases such as:
 


* PostgreSQL
* MySQL
* MongoDB



 Ability to investigate issues using logs, queries, and system diagnostics.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 Experience with:
 


* Performance testing tools (k6, JMeter, Locust)
* Observability platforms (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK)
* Container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes
* Distributed system testing
* AI\-assisted development or AI\-enabled testing approaches



**What We Value** 




 We are looking for engineers who:
 


* Enjoy building tools and systems, not just writing tests
* Think about quality at a system and architecture level
* Are comfortable debugging across services, infrastructure, and data
* Take ownership of improving engineering practices
* Continuously look for ways to increase reliability and developer productivity
