title: Cartographer
description:
****Location****
****:****
 Bengaluru, India (On\-site: 5 days in office)
   

  

**About Us**
****The Firm: Data\-Driven, Real\-Asset Focused****
 Stronghold Investment Management (“Stronghold,” “SIM,” or “the Firm”) is a technology\-driven, vertically integrated investment manager focused on real\-assets and related private markets. Stronghold seeks to deliver best\-in\-class risk\-adjusted returns through an investment framework that features comparatively rapid transaction velocity, deep technical expertise, creative financial structuring, and objective and algorithmic decision making.
   

  

 Stronghold Was Founded By Ryan Turner In 2016 And Has Deployed Over $1\.6 Billion In Capital Across 10\+ Investment Vehicles. Ultimately, Stronghold Intends To Apply Its Technology\-intensive Investment Approach To a Variety Of Specialist Real Assets Verticals, Including
   

  

* Oil \& Gas
* Renewables
* Specialty Real Estate (commercial, datacenters, marinas)
* Telecommunications and Technology Infrastructure
* Billboards and Fixtures
* Mining \& other commodities
* Utilities
* Secondaries


*****Your Mission*****
 As we continue to expand our horizons, Stronghold is on the lookout for a skilled GIS Analyst to join our team. This role calls for someone who can seamlessly provide top\-tier geospatial analysis and mapping solutions to a multi\-faceted team in a dynamic setting. The ideal candidate will not only be proficient with the ArcGIS suite but should also be ready to thrive and deliver outstanding results in an entrepreneurial environment.
   

  

 As Stronghold continues to scale its geospatial operations, we are seeking a detail\-oriented Cartographer (Digitizer / Spatial Data Creator) to join our GIS team. This role focuses on the digitization, creation, and maintenance of high\-quality vector datasets and cartographic products that support Land, Engineering, and Geological teams across multiple U.S. basins. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in digital cartography, hands\-on proficiency with the ArcGIS Suite and/or QGIS, and the ability to produce accurate, publication\-ready maps on demand in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities \- What You’ll Own**
* Digitization and Vector Data Creation: Digitize spatial features from land records, plat maps, survey documents, aerial imagery, and other source materials into accurate vector datasets using QGIS and/or the ArcGIS Suite.
* Map Production on Demand: Create, design, and deliver high\-quality cartographic products—including tract maps, unit maps, deed plots, and well location maps—according to established standards and within required turnaround times.
* Cartographic Design and Standards: Apply principles of digital cartography to ensure all map outputs are clear, visually consistent, and adhere to the firm's symbology, labeling, and layout standards.
* Georeferencing: Accurately georeference scanned land records, plat images, and other raster source materials, aligning them to the appropriate coordinate reference system for downstream digitization.
* Data Accuracy and Quality Control: Perform self\-review and peer\-review checks on digitized features to ensure geometric accuracy, topological consistency, and attribute completeness before submission.
* Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with GIS Analysts, Senior GIS Analysts, and cross\-functional teams (Land, Engineering, Geology) to understand mapping requirements and deliver outputs that meet operational needs.
* Documentation: Maintain thorough records of digitization workflows, data sources, and any modifications made to spatial datasets for audit and reproducibility purposes.


**Qualifications \- What You Bring**
* A bachelor's degree in Geography, GIS, Cartography, Geomatics, Surveying, or a related discipline.
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in GIS digitization, spatial data creation, or cartographic production.
* Demonstrated proficiency with the ArcGIS Suite (ArcGIS Pro / ArcMap) and/or QGIS for digitizing, editing, and managing vector datasets.
* Solid understanding of the fundamentals of digital cartography, including map design, symbology, labeling, scale, projections, and coordinate reference systems.
* Strong attention to detail with a commitment to spatial data accuracy and quality.
* Ability to produce maps on demand under tight deadlines while maintaining high standards of quality.
* Familiarity with vector data formats (Shapefile, GeoJSON, File Geodatabase) and basic geodatabase concepts.


****Why Stronghold, Bengaluru****
 At Stronghold, you're not just another employee; you are a part of our global family. We believe in nurturing talent, fostering innovation, and celebrating successes together. With our state\-of\-the\-art technology and a team of industry experts, we offer a platform for growth, development, and unparalleled learning. We value innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence, and we provide our employees with the resources and support they need to succeed. If you’re looking for ownership, impact, and the opportunity to grow alongside a high\-performing team, we invite you to apply today!
   

  

****Our Investment in You****
* Compensation: Competitive salary aligned with industry benchmarks.
* Protection: Comprehensive Medical and Group Term Life Insurance.
* Growth: Continuous learning and professional development programs.
* Balance: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and Parental Leave policies.


****Equal Opportunity Employer****

We believe in creating a diverse and inclusive workforce, where individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. title: Manager – Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
description:
**About Company:** 




 Blissclub is one of India’s fastest\-growing apparel brands, built with a singular mission: to build comfortable and functional apparel for India. We are reimagining the apparel space not just designing products, but building a movement. What started as a community\-first D2C brand has expanded into experience\-led retail destinations where our Blissqueens don’t just shop, they connect, discover, and belong.
 



 Founded in 2020 by ISB alum Minu Margeret, Blissclub raised its Series A of $15 million in May 2022, led by Eight Roads Ventures and Elevation Capital. This was followed by a Pre\-Series B round of ₹33 crore and a Series B round of ₹160 crore, led by Singularity.
 



 Featured on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list in 2022 and 2025, we’re one of India’s fastest\-growing D2C brands redefining comfortable apparel for India.
 



  





**Job Location:** 
 HSR Layout, Bangalore (on\-site)
 



  





**Role Summary:** 




 The Manager \- FP\&A will be Blissclub’s central financial architect owning the Annual Operating Plan, rolling forecasts, and unit economics across every channel. You will take complete ownership of Central MIS design and Investor Reporting. The expectation is both: a single source of truth the whole company can rely on, and sharp, investor\-grade narratives on what the numbers mean.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Investor Reporting \& Board Management** 




 ● Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual investor updates and dashboards.
 



 ● Own end\-to\-end deck preparation for Board Meetings, Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) with CXOs and founders.
 



 ● Partner with the statutory accounting team to reconcile investor reporting metrics with audited financials (IGAAP/Ind AS) every quarter.
 



  





**2\. Central MIS \& Financial Systems Automation** 




 ● Own Central MIS build and maintain a single source of truth for revenue, gross margin, fulfillment, and OpEx metrics across the organization.
 



 ● Define and standardize financial and non\-financial KPIs across departments so every team tracks performance the same way.
 



  





**3\. Financial Planning, Budgeting \& Forecasting** 




 ● Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and multi\-year financial modelling across all channels D2C app/web, marketplaces, and brand retail stores.
 



 ● Maintain a dynamic 12\-month rolling P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow model.
 



 ● Own quarterly reforecasting and publish a clear bridge between original plan, revised forecast, and actuals.
 



  





**4\. Business Partnering \& Commercial Unit Economics** 




 ● Drive granular contribution margin (CM1/CM2/CM3\) analysis by category, SKU, marketplace, and store; assess discounting and promo ROI.
 



 ● Partner with Supply Chain and Sourcing on COGS variance, inventory days of supply, ageing, and deadstock write\-offs.
 



  





**Required Qualification:** 




 ● CA or MBA Finance from a top\-tier institute.
 



 ● 4–7 years of experience in FP\&A, Business Finance, or Corporate Finance, preferably in D2C, e\-commerce, retail, or consumer tech.

title: Assistant to the Chief of Staff
description:
The founder's day generates far more than it converts. Meetings that were never minuted. Commitments made in a room and never registered. Questions that needed an answer by evening and got one three days later, by which time the decision had already been taken without it.
 



  





 This seat converts. Meetings into briefs and action registers. Questions into research. Half\-formed arguments into first drafts. It is the throughput seat in the founder's office, and it is built for somebody who wants to learn how a business is actually run by sitting inside the room where it is run.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 – Run the pre\-read. Every meeting the founder walks into has a one\-page brief in front of him, prepared the night before, covering who is in the room, what was last agreed and what has to come out of it.
 



 – Own the action register. Capture every commitment made in every room, chase it, and close it. Nothing dies quietly.
 



 – Produce research on demand: markets, counterparties, sectors, regulation, people. Turned around in hours rather than weeks, and accurate enough to act on.
 



 – Draft. Notes, memos, letters, board material, and the raw material for pieces published under the founder's name, handed to brand and communications to finish.
 



 – Keep the founder's office filed and current inside the system the AI Engineer builds, and say loudly and early where that system breaks.
 



 – Attend meetings the founder cannot, and represent what happened accurately rather than flatteringly.
 



 – Verify everything. Every figure, citation and claim leaving this desk is checked against a real source. A fabricated number must never reach the founder or a counterparty.
 



  





 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 – 1\.5 to 3 years in consulting, investment banking, a founder's office, or a strategy or product seat at a startup.
 



 – You use AI tools every day and can show what you have produced with them. Familiarity with ChatGPT is not the same thing.
 



 – You write well, fast and clean. This is the most tested skill in the seat.
 



 – You are comfortable being the most junior person in a senior room, and comfortable telling the founder he is wrong while you are in it.
 



 – Mumbai, on site, long days.
 



 – Discretion. You will see land transactions, capital conversations and board material in your first week.
 



  





 ADVANTAGEOUS
 



 – Exposure to real estate, infrastructure or financial services
 



 – Hindi
 



 – Basic scripting or automation, enough to build small things yourself
 



 – You have built or run something of your own, however small
 



 – Experience preparing material that went to a board or an investment committee
 



  





 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



 – It is not an executive assistant seat. Calendar and inbox sit with a separate seat.
 



 – It is not a research\-only seat. Half the value here is chasing things to closure.
 



 – It is not a seat with a fixed scope. What you own in month nine will not be what you owned in month one.
 



  





 THE HOURS, SAID PLAINLY
 



 The founder works a 12 to 16 hour day. Not everyone wants that, and we do not pretend otherwise. What we will not do is waste it. This seat carries a stated arc: roughly 24 months in the founder's office, then a seat in the business on performance.
 



  





 ABOUT VANTROCK
 



 Vantrock is an India\-focused industrial real assets platform covering warehousing, industrial and plotted development across NCR, MMR, Pune and Bengaluru. It builds on its own balance sheet, is backed by global institutional capital, and is working toward a 10 million sq ft pipeline.
 



 The hiring thesis: we hire number twos who want to become number one.
 



  





 CULTURAL FIT
 



 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



  





 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every seat at Vantrock. You use AI tools daily as force multipliers, and you judge their output rather than forwarding it. This is tested for every appointment through a supervised assessment. There are no exceptions by seniority.
 



  





 Partner command is the second standing requirement. Vantrock runs on outsourced partners, so every person here must be able to scope, brief, hold to an SLA, score and commercially discipline a partner, and must know what should never be delegated.

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* SAP Landscape \& Platform Administration: Lead administration, monitoring, maintenance, and technical governance of complex SAP landscapes including S/4HANA, BW/4HANA, SAP CAR, SLT and associated SAP HANA systems across production and non\-production environments.
* RISE with SAP Operations: Manage SAP systems hosted under RISE with SAP, coordinating closely with SAP Enterprise Cloud Services and internal teams for incidents, service requests, maintenance activities, infrastructure changes, upgrades, backups, restores, certificates, connectivity and operational issues.
* S/4HANA \& HANA Technical Operations: Own Basis activities for S/4HANA environments including system health monitoring, HANA administration, performance analysis, parameter management, transports, client administration, job management, kernel updates and technical troubleshooting.
* BW/4HANA \& CAR Support: Provide Basis and platform support for BW/4HANA and SAP CAR landscapes, including system performance, interfaces, batch processing, HANA resource utilization, availability, connectivity and integration dependencies.
* SAP SLT Administration: Manage and troubleshoot SAP Landscape Transformation Replication Server (SLT) configurations, RFC connectivity, replication health, latency, table replication issues and integrations between SAP source systems and HANA/BW platforms.
* SAP BTP Administration \& Integration: Support SAP BTP environments including subaccounts, entitlements, destinations, connectivity, Cloud Connector, certificates, trust configuration, identity integration and connectivity between BTP and on\-premise/RISE SAP applications.
* System Upgrades, Patching \& Lifecycle Management: Plan and execute SAP technical upgrades, SPS/FPS updates, kernel upgrades, HANA revisions, support\-pack activities and maintenance cycles while coordinating downtime, testing, validation and rollback strategies.
* Transport \& Change Management: Govern SAP transport processes across development, quality and production landscapes, ensuring proper approvals, segregation of duties, traceability and adherence to enterprise change\-management controls.
* Performance \& Availability Management: Proactively monitor SAP application and HANA database performance, identify bottlenecks, perform root\-cause analysis and drive optimization for memory, CPU, expensive SQL, background jobs, interfaces and application workloads.
* Security, Compliance \& Audit Readiness: Maintain strong SAP technical controls aligned with corporate security and compliance requirements, including user administration controls, privileged access, password policies, RFC security, system parameters, audit logging, transport controls and segregation of duties.
* Audit \& Evidence Management: Act as a key Basis SME for internal audits, external audits, SOX/ITGC reviews and compliance assessments, providing system\-generated evidence, control documentation, change records, access reviews, configuration details and remediation responses.
* SOX / ITGC Control Execution: Support and periodically validate controls covering logical access, privileged access, change management, system operations, backup/restore, batch jobs, interface monitoring and production access, ensuring identified gaps are remediated within agreed timelines.
* Disaster Recovery \& Business Continuity: Participate in DR strategy, system recovery planning and periodic DR exercises for critical SAP environments, validating backup integrity, recovery procedures, dependencies, RTO/RPO objectives and documenting test outcomes.
* Incident \& Problem Management: Lead resolution of high\-priority SAP technical incidents, perform detailed RCA, coordinate across SAP, infrastructure, network, security, application and vendor teams, and implement preventive corrective actions.
* Technical Architecture \& Governance: Provide technical recommendations for SAP landscape design, sizing, scalability, high availability, interfaces, cloud connectivity and lifecycle strategy while ensuring alignment with SAP best practices and enterprise architecture standards.
* Vendor \& SAP Coordination: Serve as the technical focal point for SAP RISE/ECS, SAP Product Support and third\-party vendors, managing escalations, service requests, problem investigations and implementation of SAP recommendations.
* Automation \& Operational Excellence: Identify opportunities to automate Basis operational activities such as monitoring, health checks, reporting, certificate tracking, job monitoring, audit evidence collection and repetitive administration tasks.
* Documentation \& Knowledge Management: Maintain technical architecture diagrams, SOPs, operational runbooks, DR documentation, system inventories, maintenance procedures, audit\-control documentation and troubleshooting knowledge bases.
* Technical Leadership: Mentor junior Basis administrators, establish operational standards, conduct technical reviews and provide senior\-level guidance during upgrades, migrations, outages, audits and major SAP transformation initiatives.


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP and SAAS services
* Extensive experience in Managing and working with Managed services
* Experience with cloud platforms like AWS will be a plus
* Experience managing the implementation, enhancement, upgrade, and support of large ERP applications in a fast\-paced, rapidly changing environment
* Experience in leading through a transition to modern ERP platforms
* Strong troubleshooting skills, with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and system optimization
* Strong understanding of automation, auditability, and availability in cloud environments and on\-premises solutions
* Communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and drive change across global teams
* Project Management skills are a plus

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
We are looking for a ServiceNow Administrator to own the day\-to\-day health, hygiene and administration of our ServiceNow instances, so that AI workflow capability can be built and deployed on foundations that behave predictably.
 



 You will own access and configuration control, run family release upgrades, manage environments and releases, and keep platform performance, data quality and licence position under control. This role is the difference between a platform that scales and one that slowly becomes a maintenance problem — and it carries the authority to say no to changes that would take us in the wrong direction.
 



  





**Key responsibilities include, but not limited too:** 



* Administering users, groups, roles and ACLs, and maintaining a defensible access model across instances.
* Maintaining core platform configuration including assignment rules, notifications, SLAs, service catalogue and reporting.
* Supporting the planning and running ServiceNow family release upgrades end to end — skipped\-update review, regression testing, remediation planning and post\-upgrade verification.
* Supporting the management of environments and releases: update set or source control promotion, clone scheduling and clean\-up, and pre\-production data integrity.
* Monitoring platform performance and health — scheduled jobs, transaction and log analysis, system diagnostics — and acting before issues reach users.
* Supporting CMDB and data quality, including discovery data integrity and the accuracy of CI relationships used by workflow and AI capability.
* Managing the licence and subscription position, including entitlement usage tracking and flagging commercial risk.
* Building and maintaining reports, dashboards and Performance Analytics content for operational and leadership use.
* Operating and enforcing change control, and maintaining accurate platform documentation and configuration records.
* Providing second\-line platform support to the Workflow Development team and to internal users, and resolving issues to root cause.



  





**What you will have:** 



* Minimum
 **2\-4years** 
 of experience as a ServiceNow Administrator.
* Proven experience as a ServiceNow Administrator in a complex enterprise environment, with strong knowledge of platform configuration and governance.
* Strong understanding of users, groups, roles, ACLs, environments, releases and change control.
* Experience supporting ServiceNow family upgrades, including testing, remediation and post\-upgrade validation.
* Good understanding of platform health, performance, CMDB, Discovery and data quality.
* Experience with ServiceNow reporting, dashboards, Performance Analytics and licence management.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues to root cause and proactively identify platform risks.
* A disciplined approach to documentation, governance and configuration management, with the confidence to challenge changes that could compromise platform stability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with an interest in automation and AI\-enabled workflows.



  





**What We Do For You** 



* Wellbeing focused – Our people are our greatest assets, and ensuring everyone feels their best self to come to work is integral.
* Annual Leave – 20 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
* Employee Assistance Programme – Free advice, support, and confidential counselling available 24/7\.
* Personal Growth \- Regardless of where you are at in your career, we’re committed to enabling your growth personally and professionally
* Development Programmes – From Future Managers to Leadership Training, our development programmes help you get where you need to go
* Online Learning Platform: SkillsHub! \- Learning at your fingertips, anytime from anywhere. You can access our online library with relevant content for your career growth.
* Life Insurance \- 3x annual salary
* Personal Accident Insurance \- providing cover in the event of serious injury/illness.
* Performance Bonus – Our Group\-wide bonus scheme enables you to reap the rewards of your success



  





**Who We Are** 




 At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector\-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.
 



 We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.
 



 OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.
 



 Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.
 



 We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.
 



 Proud to be recognised in the Financial Times’ Best Employers 2026 list for the second\-year running , an independent and data led ranking based on employee feedback. Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.
 



 Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

title: CMS-Senior-Entra ID And MFA Controls
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 Conditional Access and MFA Management \- Senior
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 Execute end\-to\-end operations for Conditional Access (CA) and Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), including policy configuration, enforcement monitoring, exception handling, and incident/request management across onboarding and steady\-state managed services phases.
   

  

 Technical Requirements – Must Have
   

  

* Hands\-on expertise in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) with strong focus on Conditional Access policies and MFA controls.
* Experience configuring and managing Conditional Access (CAP) including monitoring enforcement, handling false positives, and tuning policies.
* Strong experience in MFA operations (user onboarding, authentication troubleshooting, lockouts, exception/bypass handling).
* Solid understanding of authentication protocols (SSO, federation), identity risk signals, and device compliance signals.
* Experience handling high\-volume L2/L3 IAM tickets (incident, request, change) in a structured ITSM environment.
* Ability to implement and manage time\-bound exceptions with audit traceability.
* Experience with policy validation, enforcement monitoring, and post\-change verification.


 Technical Requirements – Good to Have
   

  

* Experience integrating Conditional Access with device compliance tools (e.g., Intune) and identity risk\-based policies.
* Working knowledge of identity security monitoring and SIEM integrations (alerts, sign\-in logs, anomaly detection).
* Familiarity with PowerShell scripting for automation of user/admin tasks in Entra ID.
* Experience supporting SSO/federation configurations (SAML, OAuth, OIDC) across enterprise applications.
* Exposure to user awareness, onboarding, and MFA adoption campaigns in enterprise environments.
* Understanding of audit support processes (log extraction, evidence preparation, exception validation).
* Experience in policy tuning and continuous improvement to optimize enforcement and minimize false positives.


**Additional Requirements / Profile Expectation**
* Ability to independently manage high\-volume IAM operations with minimal supervision in a structured ITSM model.
* Strong analytical mindset to troubleshoot authentication issues, access failures, and policy enforcement gaps.
* High attention to detail for policy execution, exception handling, and audit traceability requirements.
* Comfortable working within strict client\-approved change and approval processes (no independent policy decisions).
* Ability to multi\-task across incidents, service requests, and change activities while maintaining SLA adherence.
* Proactive in identifying false positives, enforcement issues, and optimization opportunities.
* Good communication skills to coordinate with service desk, infra teams, and client stakeholders.
* Strong discipline in runbook\-driven execution and documentation updates.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Performance Marketer Executive
description:
Job Title: Performance Marketer Executive
 





 Experience: 2–3 years
 




  





**About the role:** 

 This is the level where you stop executing someone else's plan and start owning accounts. You run 3–5 client accounts end to end: structure, budgets, optimisation, scaling, and the client conversation around it all. Your Lead sets portfolio strategy and steps in on hard calls; everything else on your accounts is yours.
 





 You sit in the Performance Marketing department, work daily with the Creative (Paid Ads) team on what to produce next, and are the first person a client hears from when they have a question about their media.
 




  





**Key responsibilities:** 





 1\.Account ownership
 



* Own 3–5 accounts end to end on Meta and Google (plus other channels where relevant): campaign structure, budget allocation, bids, optimisation, and scaling decisions.
* Own spend pacing daily. Flag anomalies the day they appear, not in the monthly report.
* Handle first\-level client questions directly, without escalation.



  






 2\.Testing and optimisation
 



* Build and run a monthly testing roadmap per account: audiences, creatives, offers, placements, landing pages.
* Document learnings so wins compound across accounts instead of living in your head.
* Detect creative fatigue early and act before performance decays.



  






 3\.Reporting and client communication
 



* Own the reporting narrative for your accounts: what happened, why, and what we are doing next. Numbers without a story do not count as a report.
* Present results on client calls and defend media decisions with data.



  






 4\.Creative collaboration
 



* Brief the Creative team on what to produce based on performance data: which angles are winning, what to iterate, what to kill.
* Close the loop: report creative performance back so the next batch is better than the last.



  






 5\.Team
 





 Review launches by interns and executives on your accounts; catch errors before clients do.
 





 Mentor juniors informally. At this level, making others better is part of the job, not extra credit.
 




  





**Must have** 



* 2–3 years running paid campaigns hands\-on, with at least one account you scaled profitably and can walk us through in detail.
* Advanced Meta Ads and Google Ads; working knowledge of at least one more channel (TikTok, Snap, Amazon, or LinkedIn).
* Measurement fluency: GA4, pixel and Conversions API setup, UTM discipline, and a working grasp of CAC, ROAS, AOV, and LTV.
* Creative analysis: you can explain why an ad works (hook, angle, format) and spot fatigue in the data before it shows in results.
* Landing page and CRO fundamentals: you know when the problem is not the ads.
* Client\-ready communication, written and on calls.



  





**Good to have** 



* D2C experience across India, GCC, UK, or US markets.

title: Marketplace Manager - Amazon
description:

 We are looking for a highly driven Marketplace Manager to own and scale our Amazon business. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, improving product visibility, managing marketplace operations, optimizing advertising campaigns, and ensuring a seamless customer experience. This role requires a strong analytical mindset, hands\-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, and a deep understanding of marketplace growth strategies.

**Marketplace Management** 



* Own end\-to\-end management of the Amazon Seller Central account.
* Drive revenue, profitability, and overall marketplace growth.
* Manage catalog creation, product listings, variations, A\+ Content, Brand Store, and storefront optimization.
* Ensure catalog accuracy and maintain listing hygiene.
* Monitor account health and resolve policy, compliance, and suppression issues.

* Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, and images.
* Improve organic search rankings through keyword research and Amazon SEO.

**Pricing \& Competition**

 Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E\-commerce, or a related field.

title: Affiliate & API Partnership Manager
description:
**Affiliate \& API Partnership Manager** 




**Location: Bangalore** 




  





**About NIRA** 




  





 NIRA is an exciting fintech startup which, starting with credit, is building financial services for India’s mass market.
 



  





 Today, if you were to think of the largest financial brands in India, you’d think of the banks: HDFC, ICICI, Kotak etc. They all serve the richest cohort of India’s society. Over the last few years some newer brands have emerged that target upwardly mobile millennials; think Slice, Moneyview, Uni Cards etc. The mass market, or Middle India, remains a white space. This is the gap that NIRA is looking to fill.
 



  





 Launched in 2018, NIRA has found a very strong product market fit, and has established itself as the category leader for the mass market segment. Since the passing of Covid, the company grew quickly and achieved profitability in 2023\. Last year brought some challenging headwinds, but we weathered those well and are well placed for our next phase of growth. This is a huge market, we need to go after it.
 



  





 Beyond personal loans, we’ll introduce both new credit and non\-credit products. NIRA will become the holistic provider of financial services for Middle India.
 



 NIRA was acquired by Tilt in 2025\. It continues to operate under its own band.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We’re looking for a driven and analytical Affiliate \& API Partnership Manager to boost lead generation and approvals through affiliate and API vendor channels. You’ll manage partner relationships, track performance, and help scale our growth efficiently.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Identify, onboard, and manage affiliate and API vendors.
* Optimize campaigns to improve lead\-to\-approval conversion.
* Monitor daily performance using tools like Appsflyer, and Excel.
* Negotiate payouts, track CAC, and remove fraudulent/non\-performing vendors.
* Collaborate with Tech, Risk, and Product teams for API integration and quality checks.
* Drive regular performance reviews and share actionable reports.
* Execute bulk communication campaigns to re\-engage or onboard partners.
* Share performance tracking reports with partners on a regular basis to enable transparency and iterations to campaign strategy.



  





**Requirements** 




  




* 2–5 years’ experience in Affiliate Marketing, Partnerships, or API Vendor Management.
* Strong analytical, coordination, and communication skills.
* Hands\-on experience in data tracking, campaign optimization, and reporting.
* Prior experience in fintech, NBFCs, or digital lending preferred though not essential.



  





**Performance Goals** 




  




* Increase approvals and lead quality through affiliate \& API channels.
* Maintain accurate, timely reports and improve efficiency month over month.
* Strengthen partnerships to drive consistent, high\-quality growth.



 If you’re proactive, data\-driven, and love scaling growth through smart partnerships, we’d love to connect!

title: GTM & Growth Intern
description:
**Location** 

 : Bangalore, hybrid
 




**Type** 

 : Full\-time internship
 




**Stipend** 

 : ₹25,000–₹35,000/month
 




  




**About Basenine** 


 Basenine is a branding and website studio working with B2B technology companies across the US, Europe and MENA.
 




  






 We’ve worked with 50\+ technology companies, including startups backed by
 
**a16z, Y Combinator, Peter Thiel and other leading investors** 

 .
 




  






 Until now, most of our growth has come through LinkedIn, referrals, partnerships and founder\-led outreach.
 




  






 We’re now building the next stage of our growth engine — and we’re looking for someone to help us do it.
 




  




**About the role** 


 We’re looking for someone who wants to learn
 
**how a B2B company actually grows** 

 by working on it hands\-on.
 




  






 This is not an operations or project management role.
 




  






 You’ll work directly with the founder across content, SEO, outbound, partnerships, launches and new distribution experiments.
 




  






 Some channels already have specialists working on them. Your job isn’t just to coordinate them — it’s to understand what they’re doing, research how we could do it better, and help us push things forward.
 




  






 You don’t need to already know every channel.
 





 But you should be curious enough to figure things out quickly.
 




  




**What you’ll work on** 
* Turn our client work, projects and learnings into LinkedIn posts, case studies and other content
* Help build and maintain a consistent content calendar
* Find interesting work and stories inside the company that we should be talking about publicly
* Repurpose one idea across LinkedIn, X, newsletters, video and other channels
* Work with our SEO agency to make sure the strategy and execution stay aligned with our business
* Research keywords, competitors, content opportunities and new distribution channels
* Help improve and experiment with our cold outbound campaigns
* Research prospects, partners, communities and people we should be building relationships with
* Help launch new Basenine offerings and experiments
* Track what is working and what isn’t
* Research how other B2B companies and agencies are growing
* Run small growth experiments and learn from the results
* Work with designers and technical team members whenever a campaign needs creative or automation support



  




**What we're looking for** 


 You might be a good fit if:
 



* You understand the fundamentals of marketing
* You’ve worked on content, social media, SEO, performance marketing, growth or a similar area before
* You enjoy researching why something works instead of blindly copying it
* You can write clearly
* You understand that distribution matters as much as creating something good
* You’re comfortable with tools, analytics and learning new platforms
* You take ownership instead of waiting for a detailed task list
* You’re interested in B2B marketing and technology
* You’re comfortable experimenting, failing and trying again



  




**Bonus points if you...** 
* Have worked with B2B SaaS or technology companies
* Understand SEO and keyword research
* Have managed LinkedIn or other social channels
* Have worked on landing pages
* Understand basic performance marketing
* Have used tools like Ahrefs, Search Console, GA4 or PostHog
* Have experimented with cold outbound
* Use AI regularly for research, writing or marketing workflows



  





**You don't need to know all of these already.** 




  




**What you'll learn** 


 You’ll get exposure to almost every part of growing a B2B services business:
 




**Content → SEO → outbound → partnerships → positioning → launches → analytics → distribution.** 




  






 You’ll also work alongside specialists in areas such as SEO, outbound and automation, rather than learning everything purely from theory.
 




  






 The goal is that you understand
 
**why** 

 these channels work, how they fit together and how to use them to drive actual business growth.
 




  






 We believe the fastest way to learn growth is to actually ship things, measure what happens and iterate.
 




  




**Think you'd be a good fit?** 


 If this sounds like you, fill in the application.

title: Senior Manager – Influencer, Creator & Partnerships
description:
**About Us**
 Wirality is building a creator, influencer and partnerships vertical.
   

  

 We are building it around a simple belief: as more of culture, attention and influence moves through people rather than traditional media channels, brands need a much stronger way to identify, access and work with the right creators, talent and communities.
   

  

 We will work across influencer marketing, creator partnerships, talent, brand collaborations, creator\-led IP, community\-led distribution and other opportunities that sit at the intersection of brands and people with influence.
   

  

 We are starting from zero.
   

  

 And we are looking for someone who wants to build it with us.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Manager – Influencer, Creator \& Partnerships** 
 to be part of the core team building this department.
   

  

 This is a commercial, client\-facing and execution\-focused role.
   

  

 You will be responsible for helping grow the business: identifying opportunities, contributing to new business, developing relationships with brands and creators, building solutions and independently managing large influencer and creator mandates.
   

  

 You won’t be joining an established department with a ready\-made playbook.
   

  

 You will be helping us build one.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Drive Business Growth


 Sales will be an important part of your role.
   

  

 You will be expected to identify opportunities, develop leads, participate in pitches, build proposals and help convert conversations into business.
   

  

 Opportunities can come from existing Wirality relationships as well as clients acquired independently.
   

  

 Over time, we expect you to develop and own a meaningful book of business.
   

  

 You should be comfortable speaking to marketers, understanding their problems and turning those conversations into commercially viable creator solutions.
   

  

* Build \& Manage Client Relationships


 Develop strong relationships with brands, marketing teams, agencies and other potential partners.
   

  

 You will independently manage key accounts and identify opportunities to grow those relationships through new campaigns, creators, partnerships and formats.
   

  

 We want you to understand the client’s business rather than simply execute the influencer brief handed to you.
   

  

 You should eventually become someone clients call when they are trying to understand what they should be doing with creators.
   

  

* Build the Creator \& Talent Network


 Develop and maintain a strong network across creators, influencers, celebrities, talent managers and emerging voices.
   

  

 The network should span nano and micro creators through to large creators and celebrity talent.
   

  

 You will be expected to continuously discover new creators, build relationships and understand what is happening across the Indian creator ecosystem.
   

  

 For important creators and talent relationships, we expect you to remain personally involved.
   

  

* Build \& Execute Creator Solutions


 Understand a client brief and translate it into the right creator solution.
   

  

**This Could Include**
* Influencer marketing campaigns
* Creator partnerships
* Celebrity and talent partnerships
* Brand collaborations
* Creator\-led IP
* UGC/creator ecosystems
* Community and distribution partnerships
* Long\-term creator programmes
* New formats that emerge as the creator economy evolves


 We aren’t looking for someone who responds to every brief with a spreadsheet of influencers.
   

  

 You should understand why a particular creator, community or format makes sense for a particular business problem.
   

  

* Own Campaigns End\-to\-End


 You should be capable of independently taking a campaign from brief to completion.
   

  

**That Means Understanding And Managing The Entire Lifecycle**
 Strategy; creator research and selection; creator outreach; commercials; negotiation; contracting; briefing; content approvals; execution; timelines; measurement; reporting and post\-campaign analysis.
   

  

 You will work with junior team members as the department grows, but you should understand the work well enough to step in and solve problems yourself.
   

  

* Own Campaign Economics


 Revenue alone isn’t enough.
   

  

 You will be responsible for ensuring the campaigns and accounts you manage make commercial sense.
   

  

 That means understanding budgets, negotiating effectively with creators and partners, protecting margins and identifying opportunities to improve profitability.
   

  

 You should understand the difference between generating revenue and generating good revenue.
   

  

* Help Build the Operating System


 We don’t want this to become a business dependent entirely on someone’s phonebook.
   

  

 You will help turn relationships and experience into infrastructure.
   

  

**That Includes Helping Build Systems Around**
 Creator discovery and classification; creator CRM and relationship management; historical pricing; campaign performance data; creator evaluation and scoring; briefing and shortlisting; contracting and payments; campaign measurement; and reporting.
   

  

 We want the department to become progressively smarter with every campaign it executes.
   

  

* Manage \& Develop the Team


 As the business grows, you will work with and manage junior team members across campaign management, creator relationships and partnerships.
   

  

 You will be expected to delegate effectively, build processes and help develop a team capable of independently managing campaigns.
   

  

 This is not only about getting your own work done. It is about helping build a team that can scale.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
 We are looking for someone with approximately
 **4–6 years** 
 of experience, with meaningful experience inside the influencer/creator ecosystem.
   

  

 You should ideally have worked at a leading influencer marketing agency, creator company, talent business or a similar organisation where influencer marketing was a core part of the business rather than an ancillary service.
   

  

 You should already understand how this industry works.
   

  

 That means knowing creators, understanding brands, knowing how commercials are negotiated, understanding campaign operations and having relationships you can activate.
   

  

 You should have independently managed significant influencer campaigns and be ready to take on greater commercial and business responsibility.
   

  

**Who Are We Looking For**
 This role will suit someone who is:
   

  

 Commercial.
   

  

 You like selling and don’t see new business as somebody else’s responsibility.
   

  

 Entrepreneurial.
   

  

 There isn’t an established machine waiting for you. You should be excited about helping build it.
   

  

 Networked.
   

  

 You have genuine relationships within the creator ecosystem and ideally across the brand/agency ecosystem as well.
   

  

 Hands\-on.
   

  

 You can contribute to a pitch in the morning, negotiate with creators in the afternoon and solve an execution problem in the evening.
   

  

 Organised.
   

  

 Creator campaigns involve a lot of moving parts. You can keep control of them without losing sight of the larger objective.
   

  

 Data\-oriented.
   

  

 You believe influencer marketing can become more measurable and systematic than simply choosing creators based on followers and engagement rates.
   

  

 Collaborative.
   

  

 You will work closely with teams across Wirality and should be comfortable building alongside people with different areas of expertise.
   

  

 Culturally plugged in.
   

  

 You understand Indian internet culture, creators, platforms and how influence is changing.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role will be measured by your contribution to the commercial and operational outcomes of the department.
   

  

 Revenue. Margins. Client growth. Repeat business. Creator relationships. Campaign execution.
   

  

 Over time, we expect you to build a meaningful book of business and develop a team capable of servicing it.
   

  

 Your responsibility should grow as the business grows.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Different**
 You aren’t joining an established influencer marketing department.
   

  

 You are joining the team building one.
   

  

 You will have the backing, infrastructure and client ecosystem of Wirality while getting the opportunity to help define how this vertical operates from the beginning.
   

  

 That means more ownership, more responsibility and considerably more exposure to building a business than you would typically get in an established team.
   

  

 For the right person, there is also the possibility of creating meaningful long\-term upside linked to the business they help build.
   

  

 If you’ve spent the last few years learning how the creator economy works and want your next role to be about building something rather than simply managing something, we’d like to talk.
   

  

 Skills: influencer,influencer marketing,partnerships,campaigns

description:

 With
 **50,000\+ employees,** 
 presence across

 **15 million customer orders per month**

 \- Chief Growth Officer
 



**Location \-** 
 Bangalore (Corporate Office)

 Onsite

 , responsible for shaping how the brand is defined, experienced and expressed in a high\-frequency, app\-led, quick commerce environment.
 



  





 This role goes beyond communication to ensure the brand promise is consistently delivered across app experience, delivery interactions, packaging, customer service, and communication. It balances long\-term brand equity with the speed and performance demands of a promotion\-heavy, growth\-led business. The role will establish clear brand architecture, governance, and playbooks that enable decentralized execution across cities, categories, and teams without diluting brand coherence.

 .

 **clear, consistent brand narrative** 
 across all consumer touchpoints — app experience, delivery experience, packaging, communication, and customer service.
* Balance
 **trust \& reliability** 
 with
 **speed \& convenience** 
 expected from a quick commerce brand.



  





**2\.** 
**Brand Experience \& Expression**

*3* 
**. Integrated Brand Communication**

* Performance marketing
* In app journeys
* On\-ground channels
* Own
 **campaign narratives and creative direction** 
 for key business anchors (festivals and events, sales, category pushes, new launches).
* Ensure
 **brand consistency while enabling hyper\-local, city\-specific relevance** 
 .



  





**4\. Consumer Insight \& Brand Health** 



* Build a strong
 **consumer insight and brand research engine**
* Track and improve
 **brand health metrics** 
 : awareness, consideration, trust, NPS, recall, and differentiation.
* Translate insights into
 **actionable brand, experience and communication decisions** 
 .



  





**5\. Private Labels \& Category Branding** 



* Partner closely with category and product teams build
 **strong private label brands** 
 across food \& non\-food
* Create distinctive category\-level propositions aligned with brand narrative
* Shape packaging, naming, pricing cues, and storytelling to drive
 **trial, repeat, and loyalty** 
 .



  





**6\. Market Expansion** 



* Define brand playbooks and launch frameworks for
 **new cities and micro\-markets** 
 .
* Enable regional business teams to execute launches with local relevance within brand guidelines
* Build scalable frameworks that allow
 **speed \+ local relevance** 
 without brand dilution.



  





**7\. Creative, Content \& Brand Expression** 



* Own brand identity, tone of voice, storytelling style, content principles and creative standards across all customer touchpoints.
* Ensuring
 **creative expression of the brand** 
 across campaigns, customer touchpoints and city executions remain contemporary, distinctive and suited to the speed and frequency of quick commerce
* Lead agency ecosystem across creative, media, PR, production to deliver cohesive brand expression at scale.



  





**8\. Growth \& Performance Alignment** 



* Partner with growth, CRM, and performance marketing teams to embed brand thinking into acquisition funnels, engagement journeys and retention programs.
* Ensure alignment between brand investments
 **and measurable business outcomes**
* Balance short\-term performance initiatives with long\-term brand equity.



  





**9\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 



* Act as a
 **thought partner to leadership** 
 , influencing decisions through brand lens on product and tech, customer experience \& support, operations, and expansion.



  





**Who are we looking for?**



* **13–18 years of experience** 
 in large\-scale consumer brand marketing. with exposure to building and anchoring large\-scale consumer brands, spanning brand strategy, communication, and experience.
* Strong grounding in Indian mass marketing (TV, OOH, festivals) combined with deep understanding of digital, app\-led consumer journeys.
* Experience in e\-commerce, quick commerce is strongly preferred.
* Proven leadership of complex agency ecosystems and large teams with a track record of balancing long\-term brand equity and short\-term business pressures



  





**Interested?**




 At bigbasket, you’ll have the opportunity to work at scale, solve meaningful business challenges and help shape the future of commerce in India.
 



  





 Join us and be part of the team building what’s next at bigbasket.
 



  





*Disclaimer: We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where different perspectives, experiences and ideas are valued.*

title: Founder's Office Associate
description:
**WE’RE HIRING \| FOUNDER’S OFFICE ASSOCIATE** 




  





**ROLE DETAILS** 




 Brand: Orchard Gate
 



 Employing Company: M G Resorts Private Limited
 



**Location: Kasavanahalli, Bangalore** 




**Role: Full\-time, contractual** 




**Work: 6 days/week, fully in\-office** 




**Compensation: ₹25,000/month** 




**﻿Experience:** 
 0–1 year / Freshers welcome
 



**Joining:** 
**Immediate joiners preferred** 




  





**ABOUT ORCHARD GATE** 




 Orchard Gate is a specialty coffee sourcing and export business connecting global coffee buyers with Indian coffee origins. nWe work with coffee estates and producers across India, sourcing and developing coffees across different origins, processes and quality profiles, and working with specialty coffee roasters, importers and buyers across India and international markets.
 



 The business operates at the intersection of specialty coffee, agriculture, international trade, sales and brand building.
 



  





**Learn more:** 




**🌐** 
 orchardgatellc.com
 



**💼 Orchard Gate on** 
 LinkedIn
 




  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We’re looking for a
 **smart, curious and highly driven generalist** 
 to work closely with the founder.
 



 This is not a typical “job description” where you do one function every day.
 



 One day you might be:
 



 → Finding 50 potential coffee buyers in a new country
 



 → Figuring out who the right decision\-maker is and writing to them
 



 The next day:
 



 → Researching a new market
 



 → Building a database or analysing a business opportunity
 



 → Working on an Instagram idea around an estate or coffee origin
 



 → Preparing a client presentation
 



 And another day:
 



 → Coordinating samples with a producer
 



 → Following up with an international buyer
 



 → Helping put together a new business proposal
 



 → Figuring out how to solve something that nobody has given you instructions for
 



**You’ll work directly with the founder, and your work will have a visible impact on the business.** 




  





**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON** 




  





 BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND GROWTH
 



 A significant part of your role will involve
 **finding and developing new business opportunities.** 




**→ Research domestic and international coffee buyers** 




**→ Identify potential clients and decision\-makers** 




**→ Build prospect databases and lead lists** 




**→ Conduct email, LinkedIn and other outbound outreach** 




**→ Manage follow\-ups and CRM** 




**→ Support sample requests, proposals and commercial discussions** 




**→ Identify new markets, customers and business opportunities** 




  





 RESEARCH AND PROBLEM SOLVING
 



 → Research markets, companies, competitors and industries
 



 → Turn messy information into structured insights
 



 → Build databases and research frameworks
 



 → Answer questions like
 *“Who should we sell to?”* 
 ,
 *“Which market should we explore?”* 
 and
 *“How do we reach them?”* 




  





 MARKETING AND BRAND
 



 → Develop content ideas around coffee, estates, producers and origins
 



 → Work on Instagram and other digital initiatives
 



 → Assist with presentations, proposals and brand material
 



 → Help figure out how Orchard Gate should tell its story
   





 FOUNDERS OFFICE
 


 → Coordinate samples, vendors, clients and shipments
 




 → Support events and partnerships
 



 → Work on new projects and business ideas
 



 → Take projects from
 **idea → execution** 




**→ Jump into whatever important problem needs solving that week** 




  





**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




 We're looking for
 **smart people who are curious about how businesses work.** 




 You might be a great fit if you:
 



 ● Learn quickly and enjoy figuring things out
 



 ● Are naturally curious and ask
 **“why?”** 
 and
 **“what if?”** 




 ● Can research something you've never heard of and make sense of it
 



 ● Are comfortable talking to strangers and reaching out to potential clients
 



 ● Write and communicate clearly
 



 ● Are comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, presentations and digital tools
 



 ● Can take a vague problem and turn it into an actionable plan
 



 ● Don't need someone to tell you what to do at every step
 



 ● Are organised, resourceful and detail\-oriented
 



 ● Actually enjoy startups, business and entrepreneurship
 



**You don't need to know coffee.** 




 You don't need to have done everything listed here.
 



 What matters more is
 **how quickly you learn, how you think and how much ownership you take.** 




  





 A GOOD FIT IF
 



 You see an unfamiliar problem and your first instinct is:
 



**“Okay, let me figure this out.”** 




 You enjoy going down a research rabbit hole and coming back with something useful.
 



 You're comfortable sending the first email, making the first call, finding the missing contact, building the spreadsheet, fixing the presentation or figuring out the process.
 



 And you want to understand
 **how a business actually gets built** 
 , rather than just learn one narrow function.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL GET** 




 You'll work directly with the founder and get exposure to:
 


* Specialty Coffee
* Agriculture \& Coffee Sourcing
* B2B Sales \& Business Development
* International Trade \& Exports
* Market Research \& Business Strategy
* Marketing \& Brand Building
* Entrepreneurship \& Operations



  





 You'll see the entire chain \-
 **from producer and coffee farm to international customer.** 




 And because we're a growing business,
 **good ideas don't stay ideas for long.** 




 If you come up with something that makes sense, you'll likely get the chance to actually build it.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Please email your CV to:
 



 📩
 **trade@mg\-resorts.com** 




 Please include:
 


* College \& degree
* GPA / academic percentage
* Graduation year
* Relevant internships/projects
* A short introduction about yourself and why you’re interested in a Founder’s Office role



  





**Subject: Founder’s Office Associate \- \[Your Name]** 




  





 If you're someone who likes learning fast, figuring things out and being close to the action \- we'd love to hear from you.

title: Principal Threat Researcher/ Associate Principal Threat Researcher
description:
Saviynt's AI\-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non\-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit
 

 www.saviynt.com
 

 .
 



  



 Saviynt is seeking a visionary and highly technical 
 
**Principal Threat Researcher**

 to pioneer the future of Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR). In this senior\-level role, you will be a cornerstone of our broader Threat Research Team, working in lockstep with Product Management and Engineering to architect and deliver Saviynt’s next\-generation ITDR product.
 



  



 You will lead from the front, anticipating how threat actors exploit infrastructure, and translating those insights into industry\-leading detection capabilities and thought leadership.
 



  

**What will you be doing?**
  

  
* **Spearhead Identity Threat Research:**

 Lead advanced research initiatives focused on uncovering and understanding novel identity\-centric vulnerabilities (Human Identity(HI), Non Human Identity(NHI), Agentic Identity) based attack vectors, and exploit chains across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments.
  
* **Data\-Driven Behavioral Modeling:**

 Leverage vast telemetry from multi\-cloud environments, disparate data sources, and user activity logs to conduct deep behavioral analysis. You will be a domain expert and work with an extended team to develop and refine sophisticated behavioral models to detect anomalies, uncovering stealthy, suspicious identity threat patterns that bypass traditional signature\-based detection.
  
* **Drive Product Innovation:**

 Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams to translate complex threat research into actionable product features, robust detection algorithms, and high\-fidelity telemetry for our next\-generation ITDR platform.
  
* **Execute Advanced Threat Hunting \& Intelligence:**

 Conduct proactive threat intelligence gathering and sophisticated threat hunting specifically targeting Identity vulnerabilities (e.g., Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta, PAM, and Cloud IAM misconfigurations).
  
* **Operationalize Security Frameworks:**

 Extensively utilize and map research to industry\-standard frameworks, including
 
**MITRE ATT\&CK**

 ,
 
**MITRE ATLAS**

 , and
 
**MAESTRO**

 , ensuring our detection strategies comprehensively cover modern adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs).
  
* **Pioneer Detection Engineering:**

 Architect and develop advanced detection strategies, behavioral baselines, and correlation rules to identify anomalous identity behaviors, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.
  
* **Establish Thought Leadership:**

 Serve as a highly visible ambassador for Saviynt’s research capabilities. You will regularly author and publish high\-quality blogs, and technical reports on emerging threats.
  
* **Drive Patentable Innovation:**

 Foster a culture of exemplary, bleeding\-edge innovation within the team, actively pursuing research that leads to industry publications, CVE discoveries, and patents for Saviynt.
  
* **Mentor and Guide:**

 Act as a senior technical authority, mentoring junior researchers and elevating the overall technical acumen of the Threat Research and Engineering organizations.
  

  


  


  
 


  

  


  
 


  

**What you will bring? (Mandatory Requirements)**
  

  
* **Extensive Industry Experience:**

 12\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, with a minimum of 5\+ years dedicated specifically to Threat Research, Threat Intelligence, or advanced Detection Engineering at a senior/lead level.
  
* **Technical \& Analytical Skills:**



  

	  
	+ **Threat Intelligence Pivoting:**
	
	 Tracing connections between seemingly unrelated data points (e.g., IPs, domain names, hashes) to attribute attacks to specific threat actors or Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs).
	  
	+ **Security Frameworks:**
	
	 Applying industry models to classify and map adversary behavior, such as the MITRE ATT\&CK framework, ATLAS, and MAESTRO.
	  
	+ **Attack Vectors:**
	
	 Knowledge of Identity based attacks such as Pass\-the\-Hash/Ticket, Golden/Silver Tickets, MFA Fatigue (Prompt Bombing), Token Theft, Kerberosting and Credential Stuffing.
	  
	+ **Adversary Tradecraft:**
	
	 Familiarity with tools threat actors use to map and exploit identity environments, such as Mimikatz, BloodHound, Rubeus
	  
	+ **Vulnerability \& Exploit Research:**
	
	 Assessing zero\-day flaws, evaluating proof\-of\-concept (PoC) exploits, and testing patching strategies.
	  
	+ **Programming \& Scripting:**
	
	 Familiarity with scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) to help rapidly engineer complex detection algorithms and prototype innovative feature proof\-of\-concepts (POCs).
	  
	+ **Data Mining \& OSINT:**
	
	 Gathering threat intelligence from various sources like Open Source Intelligence (OSINT), dark web forums, threat feeds, and internal telemetry.
	  
	+ **Rule/Signature Development:**
	
	 Creating custom detection logic for monitoring platforms (e.g., building YARA or Snort rules), experience writing detection logic using SIEM query languages (Splunk SPL, KQL) or universal formats like Sigma.
  

  


  

  
* **AI/ML in Threat Research:**

 Working knowledge of leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies to aid in threat research, scale threat hunting capabilities, or improve the fidelity of detection mechanisms, Agentic AI usage and understanding of the upcoming Agentic AI threats.
  
* **A Portfolio of Excellence:**

 A demonstrated track record of thought leadership, including published white papers, popular cybersecurity blogs, conference speaking engagements, patents, or acknowledged CVEs.
  
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership Skills:**

 Exceptional communication skills with the proven ability to distill complex, highly technical research into clear, actionable requirements for Product Management and Engineering teams.
  
* **Algorithmic Prototyping:**

 Good\-to\-have skills in developing and prototyping complex detection algorithms, familiarity with advanced query languages used in data analysis.
  
* **Identity Security Expertise:**

 Understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and cloud identity architectures (AWS IAM, Azure AD/Entra ID, GCP Cloud Identity, Active Directory). Understanding how identity works in AWS (IAM Roles, Policies), GCP (Cloud Identity), and Azure
  
* **Logistical Flexibility:**

   
 



  

	  
	+ Willing to work in a
	 
	**Hybrid**
	
	 model from our
	 
	**Bengaluru**
	
	 office.
	  
	+ Willingness to undertake
	 
	**some travel**
	
	 globally based on business requirements, industry conferences, and strategic team syncs.
  

  


  



 Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high\-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work that directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!
 








  




  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Alpha Nodus - Forward Deployed Engineer - Healthcare EcoSystem
description:
**About Alpha Nodus**
 Alpha Nodus builds Gravity, an AI\-powered automation platform for outpatient diagnostic imaging centers and radiology practices in the US. Gravity sits across a center's existing RIS, PACS, EHR and payer portals and takes ownership of the work a payer requires, a person has to do, and no system owns \- prior authorization, eligibility verification, document processing, scheduling and patient registration. Our engineering team is based in Bangalore, our customers are in the US, and we have been at this since 2015\.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to own the technical side of bringing new customers onto Gravity and keeping them successful after go\-live. You will sit between our customers and our product team : you scope what a new imaging center actually needs, you build the integrations and custom work that get them live, and you turn what you learn into product changes that make the next implementation easier.
   

  

 This is an engineering role, not a support or pre\-sales role. You will write production code most weeks \- integration Lambdas, HL7 and FHIR mappings, data migrations, tenant configuration \- and you will also sit on customer calls, read their workflows and explain trade\-offs to an operations director who has never seen a JSON payload. You need to be comfortable in both rooms.
   

  

 You will work from our Bangalore office on a schedule aligned to US business hours, because your customers are US imaging centers and the fastest path to a solved problem is being on the call when they are.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Discovery and implementation :
* Lead technical discovery with new customers : map their current workflow across RIS, PACS, EHR and payer portals, identify what Gravity will own, and document the integration scope.
* Own the implementation from kickoff to go\-live : tenant setup, configuration, data loads, interface testing and cutover.
* Set clear expectations with customers on scope, timeline and what "done" means, and hold both sides to them.
* Custom integrations and engineering :
* Design and build customer\-specific integrations \- HL7 over Mirth, FHIR, vendor REST APIs, SFTP feeds \- using our TypeScript, AWS and PostgreSQL stack.
* Write production\-quality code for custom work that a customer needs and the core product does not yet do, with the tests, monitoring and documentation that let someone else maintain it.
* Diagnose and fix integration and data issues end to end : read the logs, trace the message, find the line, ship the fix.
* Product feedback loop :
* Know Gravity deeply enough to solve most customer problems inside the product as it exists today \- a configuration, a workflow change, a feature they did not know they had.
* When the product falls short, write the smallest well\-scoped change that solves it, and make the case to the product team with the customer evidence behind it. Many of these you will ship yourself.
* Recognize when three customers are asking for the same custom thing and turn it into a product feature rather than a fourth custom build.
* Customer ownership :
* Act as the technical escalation point for your customers post\-go\-live; partner with customer success on anything that is not a code or configuration problem.
* Keep implementation runbooks, integration specs and tenant documentation current so the team's knowledge does not live in one head.


**Requirements**
* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3\+ years in a customer\-facing engineering role (implementation, integration, solutions or forward deployed engineering).
* Strong backend proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, hands\-on AWS experience (Lambda, ECS, RDS, S3, SQS/SNS), and working knowledge of PostgreSQL.
* Experience integrating with third\-party systems over APIs, message queues or file interfaces in a production setting.
* Ability to run a technical discovery conversation, write a clear scope, and explain a technical trade\-off to a non\-technical stakeholder in plain language.
* Comfort owning ambiguous problems end to end \- from "the customer says orders are not showing up" to a root cause and a shipped fix.
* Excellent written and spoken English; most of your customer communication will be written.
* Based in Bangalore, or willing to relocate, and able to work from our office on a schedule aligned to US Eastern or Central business hours.


**Nice To Have**
* Healthcare integration experience : HL7 v2, FHIR, Mirth Connect, or working with a RIS, PACS, EHR or practice management system.
* Familiarity with US healthcare workflows \- prior authorization, eligibility, scheduling, medical necessity, claims \- or a strong desire to learn them fast.
* Experience with event\-driven and serverless architectures (CQRS, SNS/SQS fan\-out).
* Experience building or operating LLM\-based features in production, including MCP.


**What This Role Is Not**
* Not an AI research or prompt\-engineering role. Gravity uses AI heavily, but your job is getting real imaging centers live and successful on it.
* Not pre\-sales. You will not carry a quota or run demos for prospects; you start work once a customer has signed.
* Not tier\-1 support. You are the escalation point, and you fix the root cause rather than the ticket.


**Why Join Alpha Nodus**
* You will see the direct result of your work : a center that was faxing prior authorizations on Monday is running them through Gravity by the end of the month, and you got them there.
* You will own customers and problems end to end, with real authority to change the product when it is the right answer.
* You will work with a small, senior team in Bangalore, alongside colleagues in the US, in a company that has been building in this domain for over a decade.
* You will build depth in US healthcare interoperability \- HL7, FHIR, payer systems, RIS/PACS/EHR integrations \- which is a scarce and durable skill set.

 Australia

 Managing Director / Head of Sales
