title: Lead Engineer
description:
**About Runable** 




 Runable builds software that helps small and medium businesses grow — the tooling, automation, and workflows that let a lean team operate like a much larger one. We ship fast, own our work end to end, and measure success by what our customers actually get done.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring an Engineering Lead who is a backend\-heavy full stack builder. You will own services end to end: data model, API, business logic, background jobs, and the React screens that sit on top of them. Roughly 70% of your time is backend and systems work, 30% frontend.
 



 This is a builder role, not a ticket\-taking role. You will be given a problem and the context around it, and you are expected to come back with a design, ship it, and stand behind it in production.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, build, and operate backend services and REST/JSON APIs that power customer\-facing products.
* Own data modeling and database work in PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and query optimization.
* Build asynchronous and event\-driven flows: background jobs, queues, retries, idempotency, and scheduled work.
* Integrate third\-party systems (payments, email, CRM, messaging, LLM providers) with sane error handling and rate\-limit behavior.
* Build the frontend for the features you own in React and TypeScript — clean, fast, accessible screens, not throwaway UI.
* Instrument what you ship: logging, metrics, alerts, and dashboards, so failures are visible before customers report them.
* Improve reliability and performance — find the slow query, the N\+1, the memory leak, the cache that should exist, and fix it.
* Review peers' code, write the design docs that matter, and keep the codebase something the next engineer can work in.
* Participate in on\-call rotation for the services you own, and drive incident follow\-ups to closure.



  





**Requirements** 



* 5–9 years of professional software engineering experience, with the majority of it on backend systems.
* Strong command of at least one backend language used in production at scale — TypeScript/Node.js preferred; strong Python, Go, or Java experience with willingness to work primarily in TypeScript is welcome.
* Deep, practical PostgreSQL (or comparable relational database) experience: you can explain a query plan, design a schema for a real product, and migrate it safely with live traffic.
* Proven experience designing and shipping APIs consumed by real clients — versioning, pagination, auth, error contracts.
* Working knowledge of React and modern frontend fundamentals: component structure, state management, forms, and API integration.
* Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar), containers, CI/CD, and deploying your own code.
* Solid grasp of caching, queues, and background processing (Redis, SQS/Kafka/BullMQ or equivalents).
* Testing discipline — unit and integration tests, and a clear view of what is worth testing.
* Strong debugging skills in production environments and the judgment to know when to patch versus when to fix properly.
* Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a tradeoff to a non\-engineer.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience at a startup or on a small team where you owned a service end to end.
* Multi\-tenant SaaS experience — tenancy models, per\-tenant limits, billing, and usage metering.
* Experience building with LLM APIs, agents, or workflow automation in production.
* Payments and subscription billing (Stripe or similar).
* Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Sentry, Datadog).
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small project team.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




**Timeframe** 




**Expected outcome** 




 First 30 days
 



 Environment set up, first features shipped to production, familiar with the core data model and services.
 



 First 60 days
 



 Owning a service or product area end to end, contributing to design reviews, closing reliability gaps you found yourself.
 



 First 90 days
 



 Leading delivery of a significant backend project, measurably improving performance or reliability of the area you own, and raising the bar in code review.
 



  





**Our Stack** 




 TypeScript across the stack, Node.js/Bun services, PostgreSQL, Redis, React, REST APIs, Docker, and cloud\-hosted infrastructure with CI/CD. We are pragmatic about tools — the right choice is the one the team can operate at 3am.
 



  





**Why Runable** 



* Real ownership: you pick the design, ship it, and see the customer impact within weeks.
* Small team, high leverage — your work reaches SMB customers who feel the difference immediately.
* Direct access to founders and customers; short feedback loops, minimal process.
* Compensation is benchmarked to experience and impact, and discussed openly in the first conversation.

You'll be the person behind the graphics and videos that tell the Navavedam Wellness story — designing and editing content by hand as well as using AI tools to move faster and experiment with new formats. This is a hands\-on, high\-visibility role: your work will be seen daily across our website, marketplace listings, and social channels.

title: Senior Technology Trainer – AI / ML / GenAI
description:
**About Role:** 




 Revature India is seeking an accomplished Senior Trainer to join its AI First Academy as a full\-time faculty, embedded at a flagship partner university campus in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. This is a high\-impact, institution facing role that sits at the intersection of applied technology and transformational pedagogy.
 



 The Senior Trainer will own the end\-to\-end design and delivery of Python programming, AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI programmes across student cohorts. Working as a senior trainer within the AI Lab of the university, the incumbent will build structured learning pathways — from AI Foundations to advanced AI courses for Computer Science and other departments — while delivering measurable AI literacy outcomes across the institution.
 



  





**About us:** 




 Revature trains early\-career software engineers and places them with Fortune 500 clients and IT Consultancies across the US. We’ve launched 10,000\+ engineers into technology careers in the past 10 years. Our trainers are the reason it works.
 



  





**Curriculum Design \& Delivery** 




 • Own and continuously improve the AI Foundations curriculum delivered to college students across departments, ensuring coverage of core concepts and facilitate structured assessments
 



 • Design and deliver tiered AI and ML programs — foundational, intermediate and advanced — with a focus on hands\-on practice and domain application
 



 • Deploy active learning methodologies — hackathons, workshops, case studies, and live demos — to drive learner engagement and real\-world applications.
 



 • Develop course content, lab exercises, capstone projects, and assessment of rubrics, alongside high quality slide decks and trainer\-support materials.
 



 • Design assessments aligned to university exam norms while incorporating project\-based evaluation
 



 • Review, score and provide actionable feedback for the assessments submitted by the students
 



  





**Training \& Mentorship** 




 • Deliver high\-quality instructor\-led sessions covering Python programming, AI, GenAI, ML, Data Science and Automation.
 



 • Facilitate hands\-on labs and project mentoring, guiding students through real\-world problem\-solving.
 



 • Administer project\-based assessments, exams, evaluate and share feedback.
 



 • Guide students through competitive platforms such as Kaggle, Hacker Rank, and LeetCode to build applied problem\-solving skills
 



 • Conduct doubt\-clearing sessions and remedial support for students with varying levels of expertise .
 



**Governance \& Thought Leadership** 




 • Maintain accurate records of attendance, assessments, and learning progress in line with institutional reporting requirements.
 



 • Define KPIs and a measurement framework to track AI literacy outcomes and program effectiveness.
 



 • Establish guidelines and build awareness of the ethical and responsible use of AI tools by students.
 



 • Manage the provisioning and usage monitoring of cloud resources and LLM tokens, ensuring equitable access and responsible consumption across student cohorts.
 



 • Monitor global trends in AI and education technology and regularly incorporate into the courses.
 



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




**Essential** 




 • 5 \- 8 years of hands\-on industry experience in Python, FastAPI and full stack development experience (using Django or Single Page Applications).
 



 • Min 2 years of experience in AI native development using industry framework such as Lang chain or Llama Index or similar one, using GenAI models.
 



 • Strong foundation of AI/ML concepts such as RAG, Agentic and MCP
 



 • Strong cloud experience with application deployment, cloud resource provisioning, and management.
 



 • Strong knowledge in Data Structure and Algorithms and data base (any RDBMS)
 



 • Strong experience and knowledge in System design thinking and design principles and patterns
 



 • Good experience in web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript and Angular or
 



 React or VueJs
 



 • Hands on cloud native application development experience
 



 • Proven training and facilitation experience, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
 



 • Experience creating training artifacts including course content, hands\-on labs, projects, etc.
 



 • Strong grounding in pedagogy, learning outcome design, and competency\-based assessment.
 



 • Ability to collaborate with interdisciplinary stakeholders to design academically rigorous, industry relevant curricula.
 



 • Ability to learn and adapt emerging technologies
 



  





**Preferred** 




 • Experience in a technology services or product company environment.
 



 • Handson of experience in NoSQL databases
 



 • Track record of leading AI transformation or curriculum reform initiatives.
 



 • Active certifications in AI/ML e.g., Google AI, Microsoft Azure AI, NVIDIA Deep Learning, etc.
 



  





**WHAT REVATURE OFFERS** 




 ▪ A unique mandate to build an AI learning culture from the ground up at a leading university.
 



 ▪ A high\-visibility role at the centre of a large AI\-native learning initiative, working alongside faculty,
 



 students, and senior Revature operations leadership.
 



 ▪ Competitive compensation aligned with industry norms for senior academic\-professional roles.
 



 ▪ Encouragement and support for personal research, publications, and conference participation.
 



 ▪ A collegial, mission\-driven environment committed to student success and academic excellence
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 




 Revature (“Company”) is an equal opportunity employer. We will extend equal opportunity to all individuals without regard to race, religion, color, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, benefits, compensation, and training. If you require accommodation to work, based on any of these protected factors, please notify the Human Resources Department, and the Company will evaluate the request and provide accommodation in accordance with applicable law.
 



 We seek to comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws related to discrimination and will not tolerate interference with the ability of any of the Company's employees to perform their job duties. Our policy reflects and affirms the Company's commitment to the principles of fair employment and the elimination of all discriminatory practices.

title: Sr. Principal, IT Information System & Solution Architecture
description:

 At Alcon, we are driven by the meaningful work we do to help people see brilliantly. We innovate boldly, champion progress, and act with speed as the global leader in eye care. Together, we go above and beyond to make an impact in the lives of our patients and customers.

As a Software Engineering Lead, one will be trusted to lead our team of developers in the design, development, and maintenance of software applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in multiple programming languages, web development frameworks, databases, and cloud platforms.

 At Alcon, we are driven by the meaningful work we do to help people see brilliantly. We innovate boldly, champion progress, and act with speed as the global leader in eye care. Here, you’ll be recognized for your commitment and contributions and see your career like never before.  in
 **Bangalore, India** 
 , you will be trusted to lead our team of developers in the design, development, and maintenance of software applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in multiple programming languages, web development frameworks, databases, and cloud platforms.
   

  

**In this role, a typical day will include:**
**Technical Leadership:** 
 Collaborate with the Product team and Solution Architects to release new features. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work culture. Lead the development team in designing, developing, and maintaining software applications. Participate in design and sprint reviews to remove technical barriers, shape our products' direction, and improve patient outcomes. Stay updated with the latest technologies and industry trends.
   

  

**Design and Development:** 
 Architect, design, and implement scalable software solutions using technologies like Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, and Microservices. Develop robust backend features while adhering to best practices. Design complex software systems for scalability, performance, and security. Proficient in designing and implementing microservices architecture using Spring MVC (Java Spring Boot) and Spring Cloud frameworks.
   

  

**Security:** 
 Implement design patterns and best practices for high\-performance backend services, ensuring software security and protection from breaches.
   

  

**Quality Assurance:** 
 Advocate for quality engineering practices such as unit testing, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines to deliver reliable and efficient software. Ensure thorough testing and debugging before software release.
   

  

**Cloud and Infrastructure:** 
 Expertise in AWS or other cloud platforms, using cloud\-native technologies and best practices to optimize infrastructure and application performance.
   

  

**Problem Solving:** 
 Use a programmatic approach to identify root causes and implement effective solutions to complex technical challenges.
   

  

**Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver solutions aligned with strategic objectives. Manage multiple projects concurrently, ensuring timely task completion and effective collaboration within a dynamic team.
   

  

**Key Requirements/Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school\+15 yrs; Assoc.\+11 yrs; M.S.\+4 yrs; PhD\+3 yrs)
* 10\-12 Years of relevant experience.
* Advanced proficiency in Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, Microservices, and related technologies.
* Strong understanding of software design patterns, architectural principles, and industry best practices.
* Expertise in low\-level technical documentation standards.
* Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines, particularly using Jenkins, and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, especially AWS, and cloud\-native technologies.
* Exceptional problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
* Demonstrated success in leading and mentoring engineering teams.
* Hands\-on experience with Helm Charts and API security best practices.

title: SoC PnP Architect
description:
**Key Skills:**
 SystemC/TLM, Palladium, Veloce, ZeBu, post\-silicon, Linux
 



**Roles \& Responsibilities:**



* Lead SoC performance, power, and PnP architecture analysis across pre\-silicon, emulation, and post\-silicon platforms.
* Develop and utilize SystemC/TLM, analytical, and trace\-driven models to evaluate performance, power, latency, bandwidth, utilization, and system efficiency.
* Drive performance bottleneck identification and root\-cause analysis across CPU/GPU/NPU, memory, coherent interconnect, PCIe/CXL, and IO subsystems.
* Perform pre\-silicon to post\-silicon correlation, using simulation, emulation, performance counters, PMU, telemetry, and silicon measurements to identify and resolve performance gaps.
* Evaluate architectural trade\-offs across performance, power, area, thermal, TDP, latency, bandwidth, and implementation complexity, and provide data\-driven recommendations.
* Collaborate with architecture, design, verification, firmware, OS, driver, and software teams to investigate system\-level performance and power issues across Linux and bare\-metal environments.
* Develop C/C\+\+ and Python\-based automation, profiling, and data\-analysis tools to improve performance characterization, debug efficiency, and guide SoC/platform optimization.



**Skills Required:**




 Strong expertise in
 **SoC performance architecture and pre\-silicon performance analysis** 
 , including:
 


* Hands\-on experience with simulation and hardware emulation platforms such as Palladium, Veloce, ZeBu, or equivalent
* Performance analysis using cycle\-accurate, transaction\-level, and emulation\-based environments
* Waveform\-based debug and signal\-level performance analysis
* Latency, bandwidth, throughput, QoS, and utilization characterization
* Transaction\-level tracing and protocol debug across CHI, AXI, PCIe, CXL, or equivalent system protocols
* Identification of system\-level bottlenecks across compute, interconnect, memory, and IO subsystems
* Architectural tradeoff analysis across performance, power, area, latency, bandwidth, and implementation complexity



 Strong experience with
 **SOC Performance and Power modeling methodologies** 
 , including:
 


* Development and use of
 **SystemC/TLM, analytical, trace\-driven architecture models**
* Building and calibrating models for
 **performance, power, latency, bandwidth, utilization, and efficiency analysis**
* **Model\-to\-silicon correlation** 
 , including alignment of pre\-silicon projections, emulation results, and post\-silicon measurements
* Early\-stage architecture exploration to evaluate
 **performance, power, area, thermal, TDP, and efficiency tradeoffs**
* Using models to guide
 **SoC architecture decisions, IP configuration, memory/interconnect sizing, QoS strategy, and platform\-level optimization**
* Ability to translate modeling insights into clear architectural recommendations and measurable product improvements



 Extensive experience in
 **post\-silicon performance and power characterization** 
 , including:
 


* Silicon bring\-up support from a performance and PnP perspective
* Performance counter, PMU, telemetry, and trace\-driven investigations
* Correlation of pre\-silicon projections, architectural models, and silicon measurements
* Root\-cause analysis of performance gaps, power inefficiencies, and workload\-level bottlenecks
* System\-level performance tuning under real silicon constraints
* Analysis of workload behavior under power, thermal, voltage, frequency, and TDP limits



 Strong understanding of
 **SoC system infrastructure and platform\-level PnP behavior** 
 , including:
 


* Coherent interconnect fabrics and cache\-coherency protocols
* DDR memory subsystems, memory controller behavior, scheduling, QoS, and bandwidth efficiency
* IO subsystems including PCIe, CXL
* Power management architecture, DVFS, clocking, voltage domains, power states, and throttling mechanisms



 Proven experience working in both
 **Linux and bare\-metal environments** 
 , including:
 


* Performance profiling and debug in Linux\-based systems
* Kernel\-level performance analysis and tracing using perf, ftrace, PMU\-based analysis, or equivalent tools
* Low\-level bring\-up, debug, and performance characterization in bare\-metal environments
* Understanding of boot flows, firmware interactions, BIOS/UEFI or bootloader configuration, and system initialization impacts on performance and power
* Ability to debug issues across hardware, firmware, OS, driver, and workload layers



 Strong background in
 **computer architecture and microarchitecture** 
 , including:
 


* CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP or accelerator performance behavior
* Pipelines, cache hierarchy, prefetching, coherency, memory systems, and interconnect behavior
* System\-level performance interactions across compute, memory, IO, and power\-management blocks
* Workload characterization and mapping of application behavior to architectural bottlenecks



 Proficiency in
 **C/C\+\+ and Python** 
 for developing:
 


* Performance and power analysis tools
* Automation frameworks
* Profiling and telemetry infrastructure
* Data analysis and visualization dashboards
* Correlation flows across model, emulation, and silicon data



 Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to:
 


* Clearly present complex performance and power findings to architecture, design, verification, firmware, software, and leadership teams
* Drive data\-based architectural recommendations
* Influence SoC architecture, platform configuration, and product\-level PnP decisions
* Lead investigations across multiple teams and convert debug findings into architectural improvements, tuning proposals, or product guidance



**Education:**
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering

title: Associate Director - Growth & Retention
description:
**About Snapmint:** 




 India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit\-eligible consumers, yet only 35million actively use credit cards. At Snapmint, we are building a better alternative to credit cards that lets consumers buy now and pay later for a wide variety of products, be it shoes, clothes, fashion accessories, clothes or mobile phones. We firmly believe that an enduring financial services business must be built on the bedrock of providing honest, transparent and fair terms.
 



  





 Founded in 2017, today we are the leading online zero\-cost EMI provider in India. We have served over 10M consumers across 2,200 cities and are doubling year on year. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs and alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB with over two decades of experience across leading organizations like Swiggy, Oyo, Maruti Suzuki and ZS Associates before successfully scaling and exiting businesses in patent analytics, ad\-tech and bank\-tech software services.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As Senior Manager / Associate Director – Growth \& Retention, you will own the full lifecycle P\&L—from activation to repeat behaviour to reactivation—and lead a multidisciplinary team of 12–15 across analytics, CRM, campaign operations, personalisation, and rewards. This is a function\-head role. You will set strategy, manage a significant incentive budget, and represent Growth \& Retention in leadership forums.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 ● Full Lifecycle P\&L: CLTV, contribution margin, incentive budget allocation, and ROAS across all customer segments and product lines.
 



 ● Activation: Turn new users (especially checkout\-origin) into first\-time transactors on Snapmint; drive app adoption and reduce time\-to\-first\-purchase.
 



 ● Deepening Engagement: Build the repeat flywheel—cross\-sell across marketplace, vouchers, personal loans, and recharges; increase multi\-product adoption.
 



 ● Retention \& Reactivation: Prolong active lifespan, predict and reduce churn, run winback campaigns with documented payback periods.
 



 ● Rewards \& Loyalty: Oversee the rewards programme as an integrated lifecycle lever—merchant partnerships, unit economics, and programme ROI.
 



 ● Team \& Organisational Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a high\-performing team; set quarterly priorities; be the executive stakeholder for the CRM/engagement tech stack
 



  





**Qualifications:** 




 ● 7\+ years of experience, with 4\+ years in lifecycle/CRM/growth at a consumer internet or fintech company.
 



 ● 3\+ years of people management—you’ve led and developed teams during high\-growth phases.
 



 ● Proven P\&L ownership—you’ve been accountable for a lifecycle or retention budget and its economic outcomes, not just engagement metrics.
 



 ● Strong analytical foundation: SQL, Python, CLTV/RFM modelling, A/B testing, and cohort economics.
 



 ● Hands\-on familiarity with CRM platforms (CleverTap, MoEngage, or similar) and multi\-channel campaign design (push, WhatsApp, SMS, email, IVR).
 



 ● Exposure to rewards or loyalty programme mechanics is a strong plus.
 



 ● A leader who sets the agenda, makes decisions with margin and payback in mind, and drives cross\-functional influence with Product, Credit, and Data Science.

**Some interesting facts about Murf AI:** 




 ●Customers in 100\+ countries

**Job Summary** 




 We're looking for a Content Marketer to write, edit, and scale content across Murf's organic channels. You'll be part of the organic growth team to turn keywords/topics/customer queries into original blogs, landing pages, product teardowns, and product\-led content — and you'll do it at a volume and quality bar that's only possible with AI\-native workflows.
 



 This is not a "write three blogs a month" role. We want someone who treats content production as a system: building briefs, running AI\-assisted drafting pipelines, editing for accuracy and voice, and using data to decide what gets written next. We are looking for someone who can write genuinely helpful content that’s not a summary of a few articles from the internet.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Content Production \& Scale** 




 Write and edit content across Murf's organic channels — long\-form blogs, landing pages, use\-case and comparison pages, glossary and help content — aligned to search, customer queries and search\-intent strategy.
 



 Own the throughput and quality of the content pipeline: briefs in, publish\-ready pages out, with clear turnaround times and quality gates
 



 Operate and improve AI\-native content workflows (LLM\-assisted research, brief generation, drafting, humanizing, and pre\-publish audits)
 



 Refresh and consolidate existing content based on decay, cannibalization, and ranking data
 



  





**SEO Collaboration** 




 Partner with the SEO team on keyword research, SERP analysis, and content gap identification

 Track performance in Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and analytics dashboards; use the data to prioritize what to write, update, or retire
 



  





**Product \& Brand Accuracy** 




 Work closely with product, design, and customer\-facing teams so content accurately reflects Murf's features, use cases, and positioning

* Strong portfolio of published content with demonstrable ranking or traffic results
* Excellent editorial judgment: you can tell a good draft from a mediocre one and know exactly what to fix
* Structured, systems\-minded approach to production — you think in briefs, templates, and repeatable processes



  





**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with CMS platforms (Webflow, WordPress, headless CMS) and basic HTML/Markdown

 Murf AI is revolutionizing creative workflows for businesses through the utilization of our cutting\-edge AI technology. Recognized as a consistent Leader and Momentum Leader on G2 in 2022 and 2023, we empower L\&D and creative teams to evolve into dynamic creative powerhouses. With a focus on cutting\-edge research and innovation, a positive work culture, and real impact in the AI\-driven space, Murf.ai is one of the fastest\-growing companies in the AI voice space. Join us at this pivotal moment, where your ideas matter, and your leadership can leave a lasting impact. If you're ready for a challenge and have the vision to lead from the front, Murf.ai is where your journey into the next chapter of AI innovation begins.

title: Associate Director - Category
description:
At Pocket, we’ve experienced rapid growth in both revenue and scale over the past few years, further fueling our ambition. With a long\-term vision, we are well\-positioned and well\-capitalized to drive sustained expansion.
 



  





 We operate across diverse industries and geographies, tackling complex challenges that require leaders who can navigate ambiguity and drive impact. These roles demand the ability to solve novel, first\-of\-their\-kind problems—often without precedent. Thriving at Pocket requires a mix of high IQ and EQ, analytical rigor, and an entrepreneurial mindset.
 



  





 We offer ambitious goals, complex problem\-solving, and full ownership over execution. Prior experience solving similar problems isn’t required. What matters is adaptability, a willingness to learn and reinvent, and intellectual humility.
 



  





**You’ll be solving for one of these problem statements:** 




  




* **Customer Lifecycle Growth \& Retention** 
 : Drive engagement, retention, and monetization across the user lifecycle with a deep focus on building scalable retention loops and improving lifetime value
* **Content\-Led Growth \& Expansion** 
 : Drive the content charter for retention, scaling high\-performing content to reach new audience segments while supporting launches in new markets
* **Data\-Driven Experimentation** 
 : Move beyond traditional acquisition experiments to test, iterate, and scale initiatives that deepen user engagement, taking inspiration from gaming industry retention models
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership** 
 : Partner with content, product, and analytics teams to design and execute experiments that drive sustainable growth, leveraging insights to inform scalable strategies across diverse genres
* **Scaling** 
 : Leverage AI\-native workflows to automate and personalize lifecycle interventions, enhancing retention and monetization at scale



  





**Here’s what we are looking for:** 




  




* Astute problem\-solving skills and the ability to break (seemingly) large problems into smaller, practical, solvable pieces with a data\-driven approach to decision\-making
* Someone who excels at developing and implementing a plan from concept to completion, generating measurable outcomes across retention, engagement, and monetization
* Track record of productive teamwork—starts with “why” rather than “what,” enjoys getting hands dirty, and possesses a drive for continuous learning
* A deep understanding of user needs, preferably gained in consumer\-first companies
* Comfort working with AI automation tools and exposure to LLM\-based workflows to drive scalable growth initiatives
* Action bias: solves problems, executes, and iterates as needed

title: Video Editing and AI Content Intern (Short-Form)
description:
Company Description
 



 AbhyasX is India's AI\-powered exam preparation platform for UPSC and state civil services aspirants. The platform offers AI\-curated daily current affairs, a 17,000\+ question PYQ bank spanning 31 years, AI\-driven Mains answer evaluation, and structured mind maps, along with bilingual (Kannada\-English) content for KPSC aspirants. Trusted by 1,000\+ learners across Karnataka, AbhyasX combines deep civil services expertise with cutting\-edge AI to help aspirants study smarter.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 This is an on\-site Video Editing and AI Content Intern role based in Bengaluru. You will create short\-form videos for two streams: marketing content for AbhyasX, and short\-form content for our AI courses. You will get hands\-on experience with AI video tools like Higgsfield alongside traditional editing software, and work directly with the founder on content that reaches thousands of aspirants.
 



  





 Duration: 3 months
 



 Possibility of a full\-time offer based on performance
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



 \- Create short\-form marketing videos for AbhyasX: product demos, feature highlights, exam tips, and current affairs hooks
 



 \- Produce short\-form content for AI courses: concept explainers, tool walkthroughs, and bite\-sized lessons
 



 \- Use AI video tools (Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, HeyGen, or similar) to generate visuals, B\-roll, avatars, and effects
 



 \- Edit footage into 15 to 90 second videos with strong hooks, captions, music, and transitions
 



 \- Adapt content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn
 



 \- Keep up with content trends and new AI tools, and experiment with new formats
 



 \- Help maintain a consistent AbhyasX visual style
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 \- Students or recent graduates with a passion for video and social media content
 



 \- Basic to intermediate skills in any editing tool (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar)
 



 \- Curiosity about AI tools; prior use of Higgsfield, Runway, or similar is a big plus
 



 \- A good sense of what makes short\-form content engaging
 



 \- Willingness to learn fast, take feedback, and work on multiple videos a week
 



 \- Kannada or Hindi proficiency is a plus
 



 \- Interest in edtech, AI, or civil services is an advantage
 



  





 What You Will Gain
 



 \- Real\-world experience building content for an AI startup
 



 \- Hands\-on work with the latest AI video and content tools
 



 \- Direct mentorship from the founder
 



 \- Published work for your portfolio
 



 \- Certificate of internship and letter of recommendation for strong performers
 



  





 To apply, share a few samples of videos you have edited or created (personal projects, college work, or social media content all count).

title: Visual & Creative Design Intern
description:
**Social Media, Website, Product \& Brand Design** 




  





**“We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just make things look good, but someone who can take an idea, turn it into a strong visual, and own the design from concept to final execution.”** 




  





**About the company** 




**Leadzo (** 
 www.leadzo.co.in) is building a modern lead generation and service marketplace platform designed to connect customers with verified service professionals across service industries, from Marketing \& Technology, Legal \& Business, Home Services, Health \& Wellbeing, Construction \& Trades, Lessons \& Training, Events \& Creative, and more.
 



 Our mission: to make it easier, faster, and more transparent for people to discover and hire trusted professionals online, while helping businesses grow through qualified, high\-intent leads.
 



 Our platform is live pan\-India, with active buyers and sellers across the country. We are now in a crucial scale and stabilization phase, improving the product, strengthening our brand, and building a stronger digital presence across our website, product, marketing channels, and social media.
 



 Design plays a major role in that. From a social media post and website banner to a product screen or campaign creative, we want every visual interaction with Leadzo to feel clear, modern, consistent, and purposeful.
 



  





**About the role** 




**We are looking for a** 
**Visual \& Creative Design Intern** 
 who wants to work across different areas of digital design rather than being restricted to one type of creative work.
 



 You will work on
 **social media creatives, website banners, marketing campaigns, presentations, product visuals, website screens, mobile app screens, and other digital assets** 
 .
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You won’t just receive a brief, create one design, and move on. You’ll be expected to understand the objective, explore different creative directions, execute the design, take feedback, and improve it.
 



 You will work closely with the
 **Marketing, Product, and Development teams** 
 , giving you exposure to how design is actually used inside a growing technology company.
 



 We’re looking for someone with strong creative instincts, attention to detail, curiosity, and the willingness to learn quickly.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Create
 **social media posts, carousels, infographics, promotional creatives, and campaign visuals** 
 for platforms such as Instagram and LinkedIn.
* Design
 **website banners, landing page creatives, promotional sections, pop\-ups, and other website assets** 
 .
* Create visual creatives for performance marketing and promotional campaigns.
* Work on
 **website and mobile app screens** 
 when required.
* Create wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and polished digital designs.
* Develop creative concepts and visual directions for campaigns and new initiatives.
* Maintain consistency in Leadzo’s visual identity across different platforms.
* Adapt designs into different sizes and formats for various digital channels.
* Create presentations and other marketing/design collateral when required.
* Work with the marketing team to turn campaign ideas into compelling visual communication.
* Work with the product and development teams to create clean, practical digital interfaces.
* Take feedback positively and iterate quickly.
* Maintain organised Figma files, components, templates, and design assets.
* Research current design trends and bring fresh creative ideas to the team.
* Continuously improve the quality and consistency of Leadzo's visual communication.



  





**Tools \& Skills** 




**Must have:** 



* Good working knowledge of
 **Figma**
* **Strong understanding of basic design principles**
* **Good eye for typography, spacing, composition, colours, and visual hierarchy**
* **Ability to create clean and modern digital creatives**
* **Basic understanding of responsive design**
* **Ability to work across multiple creative formats**
* **Strong attention to detail**



  





**Good to have:** 



* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Canva
* Basic motion graphics/video editing
* After Effects
* Premiere Pro
* Basic understanding of UI/UX
* Experience designing websites or mobile apps
* Experience creating social media creatives



 You do not need to know every tool listed above.
 **Strong design fundamentals and a good portfolio matter more than the number of tools you know.** 




  





**What We’re Looking For** 




**We’re looking for someone who:** 



* Thinks creatively instead of simply following templates.
* Can take a rough idea and turn it into a polished visual.
* Has a strong eye for detail.
* Understands that good design is both
 **visually appealing and purposeful** 
 .
* Is comfortable receiving feedback and improving their work.
* Can manage multiple design requirements.
* Is curious about how websites, apps, products, and marketing work.
* Takes ownership of their work instead of waiting for step\-by\-step instructions.
* Wants to build a strong portfolio through real\-world projects.



**Portfolio Is Important** 




  





**Your portfolio matters more than your degree.** 




**You can share:** 



* College projects
* Personal design projects
* Social media creatives
* Website designs
* App designs
* Branding projects
* Posters
* Illustrations
* Freelance work
* Concept designs
* Any other digital design work



 Even if you don't have professional experience, we want to see
 **how you think and what you can create** 
 .
 



  





**What Will Get You Rejected** 



* You only know how to edit existing Canva templates.
* You cannot explain the thinking behind your designs.
* You copy designs without understanding the visual structure.
* You are unwilling to take feedback or make iterations.
* You have no interest in learning beyond social media posts.
* You need detailed instructions for every small design task.
* You prioritise making something flashy over making it clear and useful.
* You have no portfolio or design samples to show.



  





**What You Get** 



* **₹20,000/month internship stipend**
* **Hands\-on experience working on a live technology platform.**
* **Exposure to** 
**social media, marketing, website, product, mobile app, and brand design** 
 .
* Opportunity to work directly with marketing, product, and development teams.
* Real\-world projects that can become part of your professional portfolio.
* Opportunity to learn how design connects with marketing, product, and business objectives.
* A fast\-paced environment where you can experiment, learn, and take ownership.
* Potential opportunity to continue with the company based on performance and business requirements.



  





**Office Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Bangalore, India
 



**Internship Type:** 
 Full\-time, Work From Office
 



**Stipend:** 
 ₹20,000 per month

title: Sr Manager | Director - Media Planning
description:
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

**Sr Manager \| Director \- Implementation Planning, GOC**
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
   

  

 At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
   

  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


****Role Summary And Impact****
 As part of our Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will partner with teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia to deliver high\-impact, integrated media planning solutions across multiple markets and channels.
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end planning operations across multiple campaigns, brands, or markets while ensuring consistency in quality, timelines, and strategic output.
* Support Associate Directors and market stakeholders in developing integrated media planning recommendations aligned with business and campaign objectives.
* Act as a key escalation point for operational and planning\-related challenges across the team.
* Drive excellence in campaign planning deliverables, including audience strategy, channel allocation, forecasting, reporting frameworks, and post\-campaign analysis.
* Collaborate closely with Activation, Ad Operations, Analytics, and Client Servicing teams to ensure seamless execution of media plans.
* Ensure planning best practices, governance standards, and documentation processes are consistently followed across the team.
* Support implementation and adoption of planning tools, automation solutions, and operational efficiencies.
* Monitor team productivity, delivery quality, and workload allocation to ensure optimal operational performance.
* Provide coaching, mentorship, and developmental guidance to Managers, Senior Executives, and Executives.
* Contribute to capability\-building initiatives, knowledge\-sharing forums, and process improvement projects.
* Foster a collaborative and high\-performing team culture focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.


****Skills And Experience****
* Media Planning teams are experts on the digital media landscape and how consumers interact with it. We architect and steward holistic media plans throughout their lifecycle, owning the creation of overall plans, cross\-channel budget allocation, in\-flight cross\-channel optimization \& reporting and post\-campaign analysis. We are our clients’ key contacts for a unified view across all aspects of their campaigns, narrating the story of the campaign from planning recommendation through to PCA.
* 6 plus years of experience in media planning, integrated communications planning, or digital strategy roles, preferably within a global agency environment.
* Strong understanding of integrated media channels including digital, social, search, commerce, video, programmatic, impact buys and other non biddable emerging media.
* Proven experience managing teams in a fast\-paced offshore/onshore delivery setup.
* Experience handling multi\-market campaigns and collaborating with global stakeholders.
* Strong operational mindset with experience managing workflows, quality standards, and process governance.
* Excellent analytical and strategic thinking capabilities with a data\-driven approach to planning and optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively.
* Experience with media planning tools, reporting dashboards, and planning frameworks.
* Strong presentation and storytelling capabilities.
* Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and drive operational efficiencies.
* Strong coaching and people management skills with experience developing high\-performing teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a dynamic environment.


****Life At WPP Media \& Benefits****
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include access to internal learning platforms, certifications, and training sessions, life insurance, wellness programs, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, employee mental health awareness day, and more.
   

  

 Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. At WPP Media, we strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested, we'd love to know how you can positively impact our team with your experience!
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we believe that diversity is vital and positively influences the environment in which we operate. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment that is free of discrimination, harassment or bullying. Race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status have no bearing on our hiring decisions, and we encourage all applicants.
   

  

 We view everyone as an individual and we understand that inclusion is more than just diversity – it’s about belonging. We celebrate the fact that everyone is unique and that’s what makes us so good at what we do. We pride ourselves on being a company that embraces difference and truly represents the global clients we work with.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice (
 **https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy\-policy** 
 ) for more information on how we process the information you provide.
   

  

 While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

 AB InBev GCC was incorporated in 2014 as a strategic partner for Anheuser\-Busch InBev. The center leverages the power of data and analytics to drive growth for critical business functions such as operations, finance, people, and technology. The teams are transforming Operations through Tech and Analytics.
   

  

 Do You Dream Big?
   

  

 We Need You
 **.**
**Job Title: Senior Analyst \- Social listening \& Consumer Insights
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Reporting to: Manager \- Digital Marketing**
* PURPOSE OF ROLE:


 We are seeking a skilled and analytical Social Listening Analyst to design, execute, and deliver custom social listening reports that inform strategic decision\-making across the organization. The role involves engaging with stakeholders to gather business requirements and translating them into structured, platform\-specific queries that monitor social conversations around internal brands, competitors, products, marketing campaigns, and key events.
   

  

 The Analyst will be responsible for conducting in\-depth analysis of unstructured social media data, identifying key themes and sentiment drivers, and synthesizing findings into concise, insight\-driven narratives. The ability to differentiate meaningful signals from noise and communicate insights in a business\-relevant context is critical.
   

  

 This role requires a high degree of independence, as assignments may lack predefined templates or processes. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem\-solving capabilities, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to manage cross\-functional collaboration effectively. Additionally, the role includes working with multilingual content, requiring the Analyst to derive culturally contextualized insights from non\-English sources.
   

  

* KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
* Consult with stakeholders to define social listening topics, metrics, and filtering criteria aligned to business objectives across standard, ad\-hoc, and industry reports.
* Design and implement social listening setups, including query parameters, keyword configurations, and dashboard creation across approved tools.
* Pull, interpret, and analyze data from social listening platforms to assess volume, sentiment, conversation drivers, influencer activity, and emerging trends.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams \- including Marketing Insights, Marketing, and Brand teams \- to integrate social media insights into broader research initiatives and campaigns.
* Champion a holistic, consumer\-centric view \- connecting the dots between what consumers say, how they engage, and what influences their perceptions and behaviors.
* Present insights and recommendations in a clear, structured manner to inform strategic and tactical decision\-making.
* Create and edit reporting deliverables in PowerPoint, Excel, and newsletter formats that effectively transform social data into actionable narratives.
* Visualize findings through charts, tables, and infographics to clearly communicate insights to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Maintain a recurring and ad\-hoc reporting calendar, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of outputs.
* Demonstrate high attention to detail and data accuracy in all reports, with strong written communication and data storytelling skills.
* Proactively refine and optimize social listening queries to ensure data relevance, minimize noise, and enhance the quality of insights.
* Monitor and share industry best practices and case studies to support capability building within the insights function.
* Adhere to global social listening collaboration protocols, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and processes.
* Apply a blend of technical proficiency, business acumen, and interpersonal skills to interpret data and influence key stakeholders.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high quality and consistency across deliverables.
* Contribute to identifying earned consumer engagement patterns, as well as analyzing campaign\-related performance across platforms.
* QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS
* 2 \- 4 years of experience in social listening, consumer insights or social media marketing roles.
* Proven experience with social listening and analytics platforms such as Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Cision, Emplifi, or equivalent tools.
* Experience in Consumer Insights tools such as GWI, CreatorIQ, MeltWater or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms and ecosystems, including Facebook, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), YouTube, blogs, forums, and emerging channels.
* Demonstrated analytical skills with experience in data gathering, interpretation, and the development of actionable, insight\-driven recommendations.
* Experience building Boolean queries and refining search logic for accuracy and relevance.
* Basic understanding of sentiment analysis and natural language processing.
* Ability to identify emerging trends within the beverage industry and broader social media landscape; culturally aware and informed on global digital conversations.
* Skilled at distilling complex datasets into clear, concise, and business\-relevant insights.
* Strong multitasking and time management abilities with a consistent track record of delivering high\-quality outputs under tight deadlines.
* Naturally curious and detail\-oriented, with a deep interest in uncovering the “why” behind social trends and behavioral shifts.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross\-functional, fast\-paced environment.


**Mandatory Skills:** 
 Digital Marketing, Social Listening, Expertise in PPT and Advanced Excel
   

  

**Preferred Skills:** 
 Power BI, Stakeholder Management
   

  

*And above all of this, an undying love for beer!
   

  

 We dream big to create future with more cheers.*

title: Director, Customers & Market Insights
description:
**Overview**
 Labcorp, a Forbes 2025 “Best Large Employer,” is looking for a visionary insights analyst to join our Global Insights team in Bangalore. As Director, Biopharma Laboratory Solutions (BLS) Insights , will lead the development and execution of comprehensive global insights, market research and competitive intelligence strategies
   

  

 Labcorp’s Global Insights team is responsible for generating data\-driven insights to inform marketing strategies, answer business questions, and help us better serve our customers. The role provides an opportunity for an insights driven mind who thrives in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven organization.
   

  

 This role reports functionally to the VP of Global Insights based in United States and is a key part of the Global Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), based in Bangalore, India.
   

  

**What You’ll Drive**
* Global Market Intelligence for our Biopharma Laboratory Solutions Business: Drive Labcorp’s data driven insights philosophy, by integrating market, product, and customer intelligence.
* Insight to Impact: Deliver actionable insights to accelerate campaign planning, performance measurement, and audience segmentation.
* AI\-Driven Innovation: Champion the use of AI tools and platforms to elevate decision\-making and personalize customer engagement.
* Proactive Executive Communications: Leverage ownership of monitoring programs (Know Our Customer, NPS, Prospect ID) to provide proactive, executive ready insights.


**Job Responsibilities**
 This person will be responsible for developing and leading the insights practice for $10B\+ industry, through, partnering closely with marketing and business leaders to deliver actionable insights that drive growth. The right individual is comfortable with making decisions when there is ambiguity. S/he is highly collaborative and can lead through influence by involving a diverse array of internal stakeholders and business leaders
   

  

* Lead the design, execution, and management of global insights surveillance for Biopharma Laboratory Services (BLS), supporting strategic decision\-making through integrated analysis of industry benchmarks, client feedback, NPS, competitor activity, and other key data sources.
* Collaborate with BLS marketing and commercial teams to proactively address organizational challenges and opportunities.
* Analyze competitive landscapes, market dynamics, and emerging trends to anticipate potential risks and market shifts.
* Oversee multiple complex projects simultaneously, ensuring strategic alignment, quality execution, and on\-time delivery.
* Continuously improve research methodologies and tools to enhance insight accuracy and relevance; leverage advanced technologies to streamline data acquisition, analysis, and reporting. Identify best practices for how to ensure leveraging AI to streamline industry reviews.
* Partner with external vendors and industry experts to extend internal capabilities.
* Own executive presentations and outputs? for BLS NPS results and provide insight analysis and reporting for internal tools such as Know Our Customer and Prospect ID.
* Distill data from internal dashboards and external sources into executive\-ready insights that inform strategic decision\-making.
* Deliver market insights and industry benchmarks for key strategic planning events, including offsites, workshops, and competitive simulations.
* Connect customer insights with market and business trends to surface cross\-functional implications and opportunities.
* Effectively manage competing priorities and deadlines across multiple high\-impact projects.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data with key industry trends for holistic market understanding.
* Collaborate with senior leadership to set priorities, evaluate opportunities in current and new markets, and recommend strategic adjustments.


**Experience/Skills**
* 10\-12\+ years of work experience in a strategic insights capacity
* Experience in one of the following : healthcare, payor, pharmaceutical, diagnostics, medical device, or drug development industry.
* Understanding of business operations and how customer data serves as the engine for various cross\-functional business decisions.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
* Experience with other analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Qualtrics).
* Strong record of team collaboration in a matrixed environment.


**Preferred**
* Advanced degree in a business\- or marketing\-specific program.
* Understanding of key industry databases (e.g., UpToDate, clinicaltrials.gov, Informa suite, Definitive Health).

title: Product Experience Lead
description:
AI can make a polished screen in seconds. Getting someone to trust an AI agent with their real work is much harder. That's the problem we're hiring for.
 



  





 At Tipstat, we build AI systems that run whole business workflows. Our two products are Ozyn.AI, a productivity assistant that works across Gmail, CRM, Calendar, Sheets and 50\+ other integrations, and Alvoff, an AI\-native B2B procurement platform. Our customers are mid\-market companies, many in regulated industries.
 



  





 You'll be our first dedicated product experience hire. You'll own how both products feel, from the first click to the hundredth workflow.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Talk to users every week, watch session recordings and dig into data to find the gap between what people say and what they actually do
* Design trust between people and AI agents: when an agent acts on its own and when it asks first, how it shows its work, and how users take back control
* Shape behavior, not just screens, using motivation, habit, cognitive load and deliberate friction
* Own the whole journey: onboarding, empty states, errors, notifications, emails and pricing
* Give our products a distinct feel instead of the generic SaaS look, and back your choices with evidence
* Tie design to activation, adoption of agent workflows and retention, and run experiments to learn what works and why
* Use Claude Design, Figma and code prototypes to explore quickly, then spend your time choosing and refining
* Work with founders and engineering to shape the roadmap
* Build our experience principles, design system and research practice



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 6\+ years in product design or UX, ideally in B2B SaaS or complex workflow tools
* Deep working knowledge of user psychology and behavioral design. You can explain why a design works, not just that it looks good
* Research skills you actually use: interviews, usability testing and product analytics
* Strong craft in interaction design, information architecture and visual design
* Clear writing. You treat microcopy as part of the design
* Comfort with ambiguity and with being the only designer in the room
* Hands\-on experience with AI design and prototyping tools



  





 Bonus points if you've designed AI or agent products, worked in a regulated industry, or can prototype in code.
 



  





 This role probably isn't for you if your best work is Dribbble shots rather than outcomes, or if you'd rather hand off mockups and move on.

title: Lead I - UX Design
description:
**Role Description**
**Job Role: Lead UX Designer**

title: Product Analyst II
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Product Analyst II at HackerRank, you will own the end\-to\-end analytics for our products and platforms, working across AI\-powered experiences, developer\-facing products, content, community growth, or platform initiatives. This is not a BI reporting role — you will own and drive analytics initiatives end\-to\-end and act as a thought partner to Product, Engineering, Content, Design, and business stakeholders, helping answer not only "what happened?" but also "what should we build, improve, prioritize, or measure next?"
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own analytics for next\-generation product(s), platform, content, AI, community, or growth areas.
* Define and evolve metrics across adoption, engagement, retention, satisfaction, usability, usage quality, and customer value.
* Analyze customer and developer journeys, segments, and feature\-level behavior to identify opportunities and friction points.
* Evaluate the quality, effectiveness, and adoption of new content and AI\-powered product experiences.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Content, Design, and Marketing teams to define measurement plans and success criteria for new initiatives.
* Drive experimentation by framing hypotheses, sizing opportunities, designing experiments, interpreting results, and recommending next steps.
* Use AI agents as part of your daily analytics workflow, and analyze AI assistants/agentic workflows including usage, outcomes, cost, and usage\-based pricing.


**Who You Are**
* You have 3\-6 years of full\-time experience in product analytics, data science, growth analytics, consumer analytics, platform analytics, or a related field.
* You have advanced SQL skills and experience working with event, session, or clickstream\-level product data.
* You are comfortable using Python for analysis and working with large, imperfect, or text\-based datasets.
* You have a strong foundation in statistics, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, statistical significance, power analysis, sampling, regression, and causal inference.
* You understand funnels, cohort analysis, segmentation, retention, experimentation, and feature adoption.
* You can turn ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, clear recommendations, and measurable outcomes.


**Even better if you have**
* Familiarity with LLM product metrics, AI quality evaluation, or agent workflow analysis.
* Experience implementing or validating clickstream instrumentation; not only defining requirements for it.
* Experience measuring content quality, learning outcomes, developer workflows, or community engagement.
* Experience working with consumer tech, developer tools, learning platforms, marketplaces, or B2B SaaS products.


**You will thrive if you**
* You enjoy owning analytics initiatives end to end, from problem framing through impact measurement.
* You thrive in fast\-paced environments where priorities evolve based on feedback and insights.
* You have a strong bias for action, experimentation, and continuous improvement in ambiguous environments.
* You enjoy working across product areas and building context quickly.
* You are great at collaborating with multiple stakeholders.


**Want to learn more about HackerRank?** 
 Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.
   

  

 HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Linkedin \| X \| Blog \| Instagram \| Life@HackerRank

* Our Recruiters use @hackerrank.com email addresses.

 Amagi is an Emmy®\-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real\-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication.
 



 Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers:
 


* 9,000\+ channels across 300\+ content distributors
* 500,000\+ hours of content processed
* 26 billion\+ monetized ad impressions



  





 We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events:
 **The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate.** 




 Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work and the impact we want to make together.
 



 Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000\+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. 
 



 To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists (Vary with Job Profile)** 




 An Employee Value Proposition is the authentic promise of what employees experience every day.
 



 Over the next three months, you will partner closely with the Internal Communications team to conduct one of the most strategic talent initiatives at Amagi. You'll engage directly with some of our high performers and business leaders to uncover what truly makes Amagi unique.
 



 Your work will directly influence how Amagi attracts, develops, and retains talent across the globe.
 



  





**What will you own (Key responsibilities)** 




  





**Research \& Employee Listening** 



* Conduct structured one\-on\-one interviews with identified employees across functions and geographies.
* Facilitate focus group discussions with high performers, promoters, and key talent segments.
* Build rapport with employees and create an environment for authentic conversations.
* Capture qualitative insights through structured notes and documentation.



**Insight Generation** 



* Analyse interview and focus group data to identify recurring themes, patterns, and employee sentiments.
* Validate emerging EVP themes against existing research and leadership hypotheses.
* Translate qualitative feedback into meaningful, actionable insights.



**Storytelling \& Recommendations** 



* Structure findings into executive\-ready presentations.
* Develop thematic frameworks and employee personas where relevant.
* Integrate findings into the pillars supported by employee evidence.
* Design a phased rollout and activation plan for embedding the EVP across the employee lifecycle.



**Project Management** 



* Coordinate interview schedules with stakeholders.
* Track project milestones and maintain research documentation.
* Present progress updates to the Internal Communications Team.


- 


**What You'll Gain :** 




 This is an opportunity to work on a high\-impact strategic initiative with direct exposure to the Chief People Officer and senior leadership.
 



 You'll gain hands\-on experience in:
 



 Qualitative research and organizational diagnostics
 



 Employer branding and EVP strategy
 



 Executive stakeholder management
 



 HR consulting and people analytics
 



 Strategic storytelling and presentation design
 



 If you're excited by the idea of discovering what makes an organization truly unique and helping shape its future talent story, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**What we are looking for (Skills \- Expertise)** 




  





 We're looking for someone who enjoys asking thoughtful questions, connecting dots, and turning conversations into insights.
 



 You would be a great fit if you are:
 


* Pursuing or recently completed an MBA (HR), Master’s in Psychology, Organizational Behaviour, Communications, or a related field.
* Curious about organizational culture, employee experience, and employer branding.
* Comfortable speaking with senior stakeholders and employees across levels.
* An excellent listener with strong interviewing and facilitation skills.
* Highly analytical with the ability to synthesize qualitative data into clear themes.
* Exceptional at PowerPoint storytelling and presenting insights visually.
* Organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple conversations simultaneously.
* Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Google Workspace.



  





**Life at Amagi** 




 Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day. 
 


* **Be Vulnerable, Be You.** 
 Authenticity is our baseline.
* **Goodness Wins.** 
 We always lead with integrity.
* **Have Fun with Challenges.** 
 We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks.
* **Think Macro, Do Micro.** 
 We dream big but execute with relentless precision.


- 


**A Place That Takes Care of You** 




 We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on\-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate.
 



 We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it. 
 



 Join a global community of innovators.
