description:
Job Posting Title
 



 Software Engineer \- Sr. Consultant Level \- Python, React, GenAI Architecture
 



  




* Job Description



 Job Description
 



 Visa’s Technology Organization is a community of problem solvers and innovators reshaping the future of commerce. We operate the world’s most sophisticated processing networks capable of handling more than 65k secure transactions a second across 80M merchants, 15k Financial Institutions, and billions of everyday people. While working with us you’ll get to work on complex distributed systems and solve massive scale problems centered on new payment flows, business and data solutions, cyber security, and B2C platforms.
 



  





 The Opportunity:
 



 We are seeking a GenAI Architect / Sr Consultant, Software Engineer (L6\.5\) who is both a hands\-on full\-stack engineer and a team leader capable of designing, developing, and deploying GenAI‑powered applications. You will manage and mentor an engineering team while delivering scalable AI systems that integrate with Visa’s product ecosystem, developer platforms, and internal operational tools.
 



  





 This role blends architecture, leadership, full\-stack development, cloud engineering, and GenAI frameworks. As a Visa Lead Engineer, you will be an integral part of a multi\-functional development team inventing, designing, building, and testing software products that reach a truly global customer base. While building components of powerful payment technology, you will get to see your efforts shaping the digital future of monetary transactions.
 



 The Work itself:
 


* Global Operations holds the responsibility of ensuring Visa’s diverse portfolio of commercial services are performing optimally, meeting stringent availability targets and exceeding our clients’ expectations.
* By architecting automation and GenAI into our operational DNA, and deeply embedding AIOps into our strategic foundation, Global Operations, the engine room of production operations, is well positioned to think big, act quickly and innovate with intention.
* Working with highly integrated, high\-throughput systems, an equally high importance must be placed on robust observability, intelligent event detection and incident management.
* Global Operations sets the operational standards to support the business demands of today and the operational needs of tomorrow as technologies continue to evolve and adjust the way we work to support the business.
* Through blame free post mortems, intellectual curiosity and problem solving we turn reactive into proactive and create an environment that provides the support and mentorship for our team members to learn and grow.



 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
 


* Qualifications



 Qualifications
 



 Basic Qualifications:
 



 8\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 11\+ years of relevant work experience.
 



  





 Preferred Qualifications:
 



 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
 



 Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science, Engineering, AI/ML, or related field.
 



 8\+ years of software engineering experience; 2\+ years leading or mentoring engineers.
 



 Worked with Agile SDLC process and SAFE agile environment in distributed teams
 



 Hands\-on experience with:
 



 LLM frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, Haystack, AWS Bedrock GenAI tools)
 



 Python backend development (FastAPI strongly preferred)
 



 Frontend development (React \+ TypeScript)
 



 Vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, etc.)
 



 Agile Frameworks like SAFE, GitHub / Bitbucket, Jira, ServiceNow, Wiki, CI/CD automation pipelines involving Jenkins
 



 Proven experience shipping products on AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, API Gateway, Bedrock, SageMaker).
 



 Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and API design.
 



 Experience implementing RAG at scale using internal or cloud\-based vector stores.
 



 Experience with Databricks/Spark pipelines, MLFlow, or modern MLOps tools.
 



 Familiarity with event\-driven messaging systems (Kafka, Kinesis).
 



 Background in payments, risk, fraud analytics, or regulated financial systems.
 



 Experience creating developer tooling or reusable frameworks for broader engineering teams.
 



 The Skills You Bring:
 



 GenAI Architecture \& Framework Development
 



 Architect and deliver GenAI\-enabled applications leveraging:
 



 LangGraph, LangChain, Haystack, or similar agent frameworks
 



 AWS GenAI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, “Strands”\-style agent pipelines, embeddings, vector stores)
 



 RAG architectures, custom LLM orchestration, model evaluation, LLMOps workflows
 



 Build reusable GenAI components, SDKs, pipelines, and abstraction layers for engineering teams.
 



 Define best practices for:
 



 Prompt engineering and evaluation
 



 LLM safety, guardrails, and content filtering
 



 Embedding generation and vector database integrations
 



 Model lifecycle governance and deployment optimization
 



 Full‑Stack Engineering (Hands\-on Development)
 



 Develop end‑to‑end AI applications using:
 



 Backend: Python, FastAPI, Flask, Node.js
 



 Frontend: React \+ TypeScript, UI component frameworks, REST/GraphQL integration
 



 Build secure APIs, microservices, event\-driven components, and backend integrations for AI systems.
 



 Design intuitive, responsive, production\-grade user interfaces for GenAI\-powered tools.
 



 Data Pipelines \& CI/CD Engineering
 



 Design and build data workflows supporting AI systems, including:
 



 ETL/ELT pipelines
 



 Data preparation for LLM training/fine\-tuning
 



 Embedding pipelines and retrieval data stores
 



 Implement CI/CD automation leveraging:
 



 Jenkins, GitHub/Bitbucket, Jira, Wiki, GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, Artifactory or similar systems
 



 Automated testing, containerization, deployment, quality gates
 



 Infrastructure\-as\-code (CloudFormation, Terraform)
 



 Ensure automated monitoring, logging, observability, and rollback strategies.
 



 Governance, Security \& Responsible AI
 



 Apply Visa’s standards for:
 



 Model explainability
 



 Data governance and redaction
 



 Security boundaries, access control, encryption
 



 Responsible AI guidelines and compliance expectations
 



 Work with cybersecurity teams to ensure secure production deployments.
 



 Soft Skills
 



 Excellent communication, ability to simplify complex AI concepts.
 



 Leadership presence with hands\-on technical credibility.
 



 Ability to collaborate in a matrixed global organization.
 



 Passion for innovation and continuous exploration of emerging GenAI capabilities.
 



 We do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have exciting team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa

title: Participant Recruitment Team Lead
description:
**Job Title: Participant Recruitment Manager – Clinical Studies** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka
 



**Department:** 
 Clinical Operations / Participant Recruitment
 



**Team Size:** 
 5 Recruiters
 



**Experience:** 
 1–6 years
 



**Education:** 
 MBA/PGDM preferred; candidates with relevant experience in clinical study participant recruitment will also be considered.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a dynamic and highly communicative
 **Participant Recruitment Manager** 
 to lead and manage a team of 5 participant recruiters involved in clinical studies.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for both
 **hands\-on participant recruitment and team management** 
 . The role involves identifying potential participants, making calls, explaining study requirements clearly, addressing queries, motivating eligible participants to enroll, and ensuring timely follow\-up for scheduled study visits.
 



 The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and persuasion skills, strong people\-management abilities, and the confidence to interact with participants from diverse backgrounds.
 **Fluency in Kannada is mandatory.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Participant Recruitment \& Engagement
 


* Identify and connect with potential participants for ongoing clinical studies through available recruitment channels.
* Make outbound calls and communicate with prospective participants to understand their interest and suitability.
* Explain the clinical study, visit requirements, timelines, procedures, and other relevant information in a clear and participant\-friendly manner.
* Build rapport with participants and address their queries and concerns professionally.
* Motivate and guide interested participants through the recruitment and enrollment process while maintaining ethical recruitment practices.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with participants regarding upcoming visits and appointments.
* Maintain regular communication with enrolled participants to support visit adherence and reduce dropouts.
* Maintain accurate records of participant interactions, follow\-ups, and recruitment status.



 Team Management
 


* Lead, supervise, and manage a team of 5 Participant Recruiters.
* Allocate recruitment targets and responsibilities among team members.
* Monitor daily recruitment calls, leads, conversions, follow\-ups, and enrollment numbers.
* Track individual and team performance and provide regular feedback and coaching.
* Train recruiters on participant communication, study explanation, follow\-up techniques, and handling participant queries.
* Support team members in resolving difficult participant situations and improving conversion rates.
* Ensure the team follows approved study recruitment processes and communication guidelines.



 Study Coordination
 


* Coordinate closely with
 **Study Managers, Clinical Operations teams, and other stakeholders** 
 regarding participant recruitment and visit schedules.
* Provide regular updates on recruitment progress, participant status, and challenges.
* Coordinate participant visits with the study team and ensure timely communication of changes or cancellations.
* Escalate participant\-related issues or concerns to the appropriate study team.
* Support the study team in achieving recruitment and retention targets.



  





 Key Skills \& Competencies
 


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* **Fluency in Kannada is mandatory.**
* Strong interpersonal and persuasion skills.
* Excellent telephone communication and participant engagement skills.
* Strong people\-management and leadership abilities.
* Ability to motivate and manage a team.
* Good follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Target\-oriented and result\-driven approach.
* Ability to handle multiple participants and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong coordination and organizational skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced clinical research environment.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office/Google Workspace and basic reporting tools.



  





 Educational Qualification
 


* **MBA/PGDM graduates** 
 from HR, Marketing, Healthcare Management, Business Administration, or related disciplines are preferred.
* Candidates without an MBA may also be considered if they have strong, relevant experience in clinical study participant recruitment or participant engagement.



  





**Preferred Experience** 




 Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:
 


* Clinical trial / clinical study participant recruitment
* Patient recruitment or patient engagement
* Healthcare recruitment
* Telecalling / inside sales with strong conversion experience
* Clinical research coordination
* Team handling in recruitment, healthcare, or clinical research environments



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The ideal candidate is someone who can
 **personally drive participant recruitment while effectively managing a team** 
 . They should be confident speaking with participants, capable of explaining information in simple terms, comfortable with frequent follow\-ups, and able to motivate their team to achieve recruitment targets.
 



**Strong Kannada communication skills are essential for this role.**

title: Community Executive
description:
**POSITION DESCRIPTION** 




 We are looking for a Community Executive to manage and engage with our online community across social media, live chat, Google Business Profile (GMB), review platforms and other digital touchpoints. The role will be responsible for ensuring timely and meaningful responses to customers, automating online conversations and reviews, monitoring brand sentiment, supporting automated communication journeys, and preparing regular reports and insights to track community engagement and online reputation.

* Experience with Google Business Profile (GMB) and online review platforms.
* Experience handling live chat or other digital customer communication channels.
* Experience with automation tools/workflows is a must have.
* Strong reporting and analytical skills with the ability to work with different types of reports and dashboards.

title: Product Support Specialist, Education Team  (Full time, 1-year contract)
description:
**Join The Team Redefining How The World Experiences Design.**
 Hey, g'day, namaste, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Ready to make meaningful impact? You're in the right place.
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point. Every role supporting Canva contributes to something bigger. Here's what this contract opportunity involves and what we're looking for.
   

  

**Where And How You Can Work**
 This is a
 **12\-month** 
 independent contractor opportunity, where you'll provide services within a defined scope, with the flexibility to shape how you deliver your impact.
   

  

 Designed for a hybrid way of working, this opportunity is remote and open to candidates based anywhere in India, so you can align on key touchpoints with our internal team and our education partners across the country. While it'd be up to you to manage your time, the expected time commitment to deliver these services is approximately
 **40 hours per week.**
**About The Team**
 We're the Canva Education team in India, working to bring creativity, collaboration, and visual communication into classrooms across the country. We partner with state governments, national education bodies, and large school networks to make Canva a safe, inclusive platform for teaching and learning — from rural districts to city schools — always aligned with India's priorities like NEP 2020, foundational learning, and digital equity. AI is an accelerant to our mission to empower the world to design. We're embracing it as a powerful tool to help us move faster, spark ideas, streamline work, and unlock creativity.
   

  

 We're genuinely curious about how people are thinking about and experimenting with new technologies to amplify impact, so you can expect it to come up in conversation during the interview process.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you'll be working on**
 As Canva Education continues to grow, change is part of how we move forward. That means the services you'll provide may evolve, and we'd discuss that with you from time to time.
   

  

 Right now, most schools and school systems find the technical side of getting started harder than it should be — Single Sign\-On, domain verification, and connecting their Google or Microsoft backends can take far longer than anyone would like, and State partnerships often run across several different authentication pathways at once. You'll be the person who makes all of that smooth.
   

  

 You'll be engaged to provide services aimed at:
   

  

* Guiding school systems and Education Depts through SSO setup, domain verification, and account provisioning, so teachers and students can get into Canva Education quickly and securely.
* Supporting integration with Google Workspace and Microsoft (Entra ID / Microsoft 365\) backends, and troubleshooting authentication, provisioning, and directory\-sync issues end to end.
* Acting as the technical point of contact for State partnership rollouts that run across different authentication pathways, making sure each one lands cleanly.
* Diagnosing and resolving onboarding blockers alongside school IT admins, DIETs, and district teams, and escalating product issues to internal Canva teams (Partnerships, Product, Engineering) when needed.
* Creating clear, localized setup guides and self\-serve resources so schools can onboard with less hand\-holding over time.
* Tracking common support issues and integration patterns, and feeding them back internally to reduce friction at scale.
* Supporting training and enablement for administrators and master trainers on account setup, access management, and everyday troubleshooting.


**Qualifications**
**You're probably a match if**
* You've supported SSO, SAML/OAuth, or identity and access setups before, and you can explain how they work to non\-technical people without losing them.
* You know your way around Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 / Entra ID administration, including domain verification, provisioning, and directory sync.
* You've spent at least 3 years in technical support, implementation, or solutions roles — ideally supporting schools, government systems, or large organizations.
* You stay calm and methodical when an integration breaks, and you're happy owning a problem until it's genuinely fixed.
* You communicate clearly in English and Hindi, both in writing and on calls.
* You're comfortable juggling multiple school systems, timelines, and stakeholders at once, and you flag risks early with a plan to fix them.


**Additional Information**
 Other stuff to know
   

  

 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above \- we still want to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

title: IT Engineer
description:
**About Ema**
 Ema is building the world’s leading Agentic AI platform to transform enterprise productivity. We enable organizations to delegate repetitive tasks to Ema, the Universal AI Employee, delivering 10x gains in workforce efficiency, across functions. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
   

  

 We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production — we ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Ema scales, our corporate IT environment tools, access, devices, and compliance has outgrown an ownership\-by\-default model. We're hiring an IT Engineer to own it end to end.
   

  

 This is not a traditional helpdesk role. Ema is an agentic AI company, and we expect our own internal operations to reflect that. You'll run corporate IT while systematically automating it, using agentic tooling to remove the manual work rather than absorbing it. The measure of success in this role is how little of it remains manual after a year and every employee’s experience is great.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Agentic Workflows \& Automation: Treat every recurring manual task as an automation candidate, extending existing systems and leveraging AI coding tools to design autonomous workflows.
* Automated Identity \& Access: Shift JML lifecycles, including global employee onboarding, Okta/SCIM provisioning, and access reviews from ticket\-driven processes to policy\-driven automation.
* SaaS Lifecycle Automation: Programmatically maintain tool inventories, track utilization, and reclaim unused licenses automatically.
* Automated Endpoint Security: Manage fleet MDM while automating OS patching, encryption baselines, and continuous drift detection.
* Automated Compliance \& Security: Generate audit evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and AI governance frameworks as a continuous byproduct of automated operations.
* Operational Excellence: Standardize IT runbooks, manage integration registries, and deliver Tier 1/2 support with defined SLAs.
* Advise other functions: Act as the in\-house expert for Finance and HR when tool or subscription administration hits a snag \- from access and licensing to renewals and billing questions.


**What We're Looking For**
* Automation Instinct \& Agentic Tools: Strong drive to eliminate repetitive work using AI coding tools, Python/Bash scripting, and API integrations.
* IT \& Security Operations: 0–2 years of experience managing Cloud/SaaS infrastructure, Okta/IdP, Google Workspace, and MDM platforms.
* Security \& Process Discipline: Strict adherence to security protocols, precise documentation habits, and sound judgment when handling compliance risks.
* Communication \& Documentation: Exceptional clarity in technical writing and verbal communication, as you will be the primary interface for internal stakeholders and will need to maintain clear, concise documentation for all automated processes.


**Why Ema?**
* Pioneer agentic AI. Build at the absolute frontier of technology to drive tangible enterprise\-wide evolution.
* End\-to\-end platform ownership. Opportunity to contribute and scale the mission\-critical infrastructure that defines our core capabilities.
* High\-density engineering talent. Collaborate with a lean team of researchers and product builders focused on deep, rigorous execution.


 Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
   

  

 Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you’ll fit right in.

**The Role:**

You’ll bring together consumer research, brand tracking, competitive intelligence and data to help Snapmint better understand its consumers and make sharper brand and business decisions.

 Most internships have you fetching coffee or doing mindless data entry. This is not one of them. At Joveo, the Strategic Initiatives team operates like a startup within a scale\-up. We research, build, and scale new global supply channels and revenue streams from zero. We are looking for a

title: Growth Manager
description:
**BrandCrest Holdings** 
 is a diversified business group committed to building agile, high\-impact brands across India’s evolving business landscape. We operate through three key verticals:
 


* **AdCrest –** 
 Our ATL\-led integrated marketing agency, planning and owning large\-scale outdoor, transit, cinema, radio, and digital OOH campaigns, integrating BajuGali for BTL execution and TrendLabs for digital marketing.
* **FinCrest –** 
 Our niche CFO services firm for startups and SMEs, offering virtual CFO leadership, financial reporting, compliance, taxation, and business process automation.
* **DigitalSME –** 
 Our AI\-powered SaaS suite, building business automation and workflow software, including invoicing and payroll/HR tools, with more products on the way.



  





**About the Role:** 




 We're hiring a Growth Manager to own and scale user acquisition, activation, and revenue growth across DigitalSME's product portfolio. DigitalSME is BrandCrest's newest vertical, currently commercializing its invoicing and payroll/HR software, so this is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role for someone who has done this before in an early\-stage B2B SaaS environment — someone who can build a growth engine from the ground up, not just run campaigns inside an existing one. You will report directly to the founding team.
 



 You'll work closely with the founding team, product, and sales to turn DigitalSME's product suite into a predictable pipeline of qualified SME/professional\-services customers, across both live products and upcoming launches. In the first few months, the priority is building repeatable acquisition and activation for the live products, before scaling across the full portfolio.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own the growth strategy and roadmap across acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion for DigitalSME's SaaS products.
* Build and manage multi\-channel demand generation — SEO, paid (search/social), content, email/lifecycle, partnerships, and outbound — with a clear eye on CAC and payback period.
* Define and instrument the growth funnel (awareness → demo → trial/signup → activation → paid → expansion), and own the metrics that matter: MQL/SQL conversion, CAC, LTV, activation rate, churn.
* Run structured, high\-velocity experimentation (A/B tests, landing pages, messaging, pricing/packaging) to find and scale what works.
* Partner with Product to improve onboarding and activation flows, using product\-led growth tactics where relevant.
* Work with Sales to ensure smooth handoff of qualified leads and tighten the marketing\-to\-sales loop.
* Build positioning and messaging for DigitalSME's live product lines (Invoice, Payroll \& HR), tailored to their specific buyer personas, and extend this to new lines (Advertising ERP, CA/Accounting ERP, Fraud Detection) as they launch.
* Set up and own growth reporting/dashboards; report results and learnings to leadership regularly.
* Manage growth budget and any external agencies/freelancers/tools.



  





**Specification:** 



* 2–3 years in a growth, performance marketing, or demand generation role, with a significant portion spent at a B2B SaaS company (early\-to\-growth stage strongly preferred).
* Proven track record of owning a growth funnel end\-to\-end and moving core metrics — CAC, activation, conversion, retention — with numbers to show for it.
* Strong hands\-on experience with paid acquisition, SEO, lifecycle/email marketing, and marketing/growth analytics tools (e.g., GA4, HubSpot/Zoho, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Meta/Google Ads).
* Comfortable with both strategy and execution — you're equally happy building a quarterly growth plan and personally shipping a landing page or campaign.
* Data\-driven and experiment\-led: you form hypotheses, test fast, and kill what doesn't work.
* Understanding of SME and professional\-services buyer behavior is a strong plus (agencies, accounting firms, consultancies).
* Excellent written communication — you'll be shaping positioning and messaging directly.
* Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and building processes rather than inheriting them.



  





**Qualification:** 



* Experience growing a product from early stage to a defined GTM motion.
* Exposure to product\-led growth (PLG) models alongside sales\-assisted motions.
* Familiarity with vertical SaaS or workflow/operations software for SMEs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under tight deadlines.

* Mentorship

title: GTM Generalist
description:
**Company Overview:** 





 ITILITE
 
 is a leading global brand in the Business Travel, Expense \& Cards Management space.
 



 Our mission is to help companies simplify their travel and expense processes, making it an enjoyable experience for employees. We operate on a B2B SaaS model, with a strong presence in the US and India, serving over 500 customers.
 



 We are a Series C funded company, having raised over $45 million from Global Tier 1 VCs like Tiger Global, Z47, Greenoaks and Dharana Capital.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Work from office \- Bangalore
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 1\-2 Years
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a sharp, analytical marketer to own our inbound and performance marketing channels end\-to\-end. This isn't a "run the ads and report the numbers" role. You'll be the one diagnosing
 *why* 
 a metric moved, tracing it back through the funnel, and fixing it before it becomes a bigger problem.
 



 You'll work across website, SEO platforms, Google Search Ads and Meta Ads, constantly asking "why" at every drop\-off point in the funnel, and using AI tools to speed up how fast you can find and fix issues. You'll also partner with our design team to iterate on creative (headlines, ad copy, content) based on what the data tells you, and pick up the connected systems: CRM, ad platforms, analytics; quickly enough to see how a change in one shows up in another.
 



 Alongside this, you'll contribute to a growing area of the role: improving how often we're mentioned by AI/LLM tools (AU mention rate) and growing organic/inbound traffic \- identifying the right initiatives, building repeatable playbooks, and supporting SEO and content efforts.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Performance Channel Ownership:** 
 Run Google Search Ads and Meta Ads day\-to\-day, driving the funnel consistently against pipeline/lead targets.
* **Root Cause Analysis:** 
 For every dip or spike in a campaign metric, dig into
 *why* 
 it happened. Don't just report the number, explain and act on it.
* **AI\-Leveraged Optimization:** 
 Use AI tools to surface issues across campaigns faster (underperforming ad sets, budget leaks, audience fatigue, etc.) and fix them on an ongoing basis to maximize ROI.
* **Creative Problem\-Solving:** 
 Diagnose when creative (headlines, ad copy, landing content) is the bottleneck, brief the design team clearly, and see changes through to accurate implementation.
* **Systems Thinking:** 
 Understand how performance channels connect to the CRM and other tools in the stack, so you can trace a lead from ad click to conversion and troubleshoot across the whole chain, not just one platform.
* **LLM Visibility \& Organic Growth:** 
 Identify and prioritize initiatives that improve our visibility in AI/LLM\-driven search and recommendations; support efficiency playbooks and SEO/content efforts that grow organic traffic and conversions.



  





**Requirements** 



* **Experience:** 
 1\-2 years in a high\-pace environment: startups or similarly demanding settings / teams. Prior performance marketing experience is a plus but not mandatory if the problem\-solving chops are strong.
* **Education:** 
 Graduate from a top\-tier college; IIT/NIT strongly preferred.



  





**Core Qualities We're Looking For** 



* **Analytical Ability:** 
 You rely on data, not opinions, to make decisions.
* **Problem\-Solving:** 
 When a metric drops, you don't just report it \- you find out why and fix it.
* **First\-Principles Thinking:** 
 You figure things out from the basics instead of copying what worked elsewhere.
* **Fast Learner:** 
 You can pick up a new tool or platform on your own, without much guidance.
* **Systems Thinking:** 
 You understand how the CRM, ad platforms, and analytics connect, so you can trace an issue back to its source.



  





**Nice\-to\-Haves (Bonus Points)** 



* Prior exposure to SEO fundamentals or content strategy.
* Experience building or improving marketing playbooks/SOPs.
* Familiarity with LLM/AI\-search visibility as an emerging marketing lever.



  





**Soft Skills** 



* **Ownership:** 
 You treat the channels like they're your own budget. You will be required to coordinate with design/web/content teams, but the buck stops at you; you need to do whatever it takes to get the job done
* **Communicator:** 
 You can explain a technical or data\-driven decision to non\-marketing stakeholders in plain English.

title: Demand Generation and Growth Manager
description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.
 


  


 Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help companies increase efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences in industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world's leading provider of AI\-powered automation software within the next five years.
 


  


 We work with leading companies such as SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali and others to improve customer interactions and automate business processes using our state\-of\-the\-art Conversational AI technology.
 


  


 Our global team comprises more than 70 highly qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds.
 


  


 We foster an open, progressive company culture with state\-of\-the\-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun.
 


  

 Tasks
   


 Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, and sells it to large enterprises in deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement scrutiny and real compliance requirements.
 


  


 Our growth constraint is not awareness. It is qualified, sales\-ready pipeline in the accounts we actually want. This role owns that pipeline. You will design, run and optimise the programmes that generate and convert demand across Europe, and you will be measured on pipeline and revenue contribution rather than on lead volume.
 


  


**What you'll own:** 



  


**Pipeline generation** 



  

  
* Own the demand generation strategy and quarterly pipeline targets by region and segment
  
* Design and run integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, content syndication, SEO, email and webinars
  
* Build and run account\-based marketing programmes against a defined target account list, in tight coordination with sales
  
* Develop the outbound support layer: sequences, content and intent\-based targeting that make SDR and AE outreach land
  


  


**Funnel ownership and conversion** 



  

  
* Own the funnel end to end, from traffic and conversion through MQL, SQL, opportunity and closed\-won, and diagnose where it leaks
  
* Build and maintain lead scoring, routing and nurture flows so that sales receives genuinely qualified handoffs
  
* Run structured experimentation on landing pages, offers, messaging and channel mix
  
* Improve conversion rates on existing traffic before spending to increase it
  


  


**Marketing operations and measurement** 



  

  
* Own the marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot), including workflows, lifecycle stages, data hygiene and attribution
  
* Build reporting that connects spend to pipeline to revenue, and report it honestly to leadership
  
* Manage the demand generation budget with clear accountability for cost per opportunity and pipeline ROI
  


  


**Website ownership** 



  

  
* You own the website as a platform and as a conversion asset. Product Marketing owns the messaging on
  
* core product and solution pages, and Content owns localisation into market languages.
  
* Own the website platform and CMS, including the publishing workflow, page templates, governance and release process
  
* Own technical SEO and site performance, including site structure, page speed, indexation, structured data and Core Web Vitals
  
* Own site analytics and tracking, including tag management, event tracking, consent management and the attribution model
  
* Build and optimise landing pages and campaign pages, and run continuous conversion rate optimisation across the site
  
* Implement the information architecture and site narrative proposed by Product Marketing, and challenge it where it conflicts with conversion or search performance
  
* Coordinate with Content on the rollout and technical implementation of localised pages, including hreflang and market\-level site structure
  
* Manage external web development or agency resource where required
  


  


**Programmes and partners** 



  

  
* Run the webinar and event programme, including field and industry events across Europe and India
  
* Build co\-marketing programmes with integrators, BPOs and technology partners
  
* Work with Product Marketing so that campaign messaging reflects current positioning rather than drifting from it
  
* Support product and platform launches with the demand side of the launch plan
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* 5\+ years in demand generation, growth or performance marketing within B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software
  
* Track record generating pipeline for enterprise deals with long, complex sales cycles, rather than SMB or self\-serve motions
  
* Hands\-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM, ideally HubSpot. You build the workflows yourself
  
* Hands\-on website ownership experience, including working directly in a CMS, and practical technical SEO capability rather than oversight of someone else doing it
  
* Working knowledge of web analytics and tag management implementation, including event tracking and consent requirements under GDPR
  
* Strong analytical capability across funnel diagnostics, attribution, and cohort and channel analysis
  
* Demonstrated ABM experience against named enterprise accounts
  
* Paid media management experience with real budget accountability
  
* Strong written English
  
* Comfort operating with European working hours for part of the day
  


  


**Strongly preferred** 



  

  
* Experience marketing to European enterprise buyers, particularly in financial services or insurance
  
* Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre or enterprise automation categories
  
* Experience running multilingual campaigns across European markets, and managing a multilingual website structure
  
* SQL or advanced analytics capability
  
* Experience in a company scaling from founder\-led sales toward a repeatable marketing engine
  


  


**How we’ll know you are the right fit** 



  

  
* You talk in pipeline and revenue, not impressions and MQLs
  
* You can point to specific programmes you built and the pipeline they produced
  
* You have killed a channel that was not working, and can explain how you knew
  


  


**First 90 days** 



  

  
* **Days 1 to 30:** 
 Full funnel audit complete. Baseline metrics established by channel and region. Website technical SEO and tracking audit complete, with gaps identified.
  
* **Days 31 to 60:** 
 Target account list agreed with sales. First ABM programme live. The two or three highest\-potential channels prioritised and resourced.
  
* **Days 61 to 90:** 
 Repeatable campaign cadence running. Pipeline reporting live and trusted by sales leadership. A clear view of cost per opportunity by channel.

title: Creative Strategist - YouTube
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016\. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life\-till\-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android\-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
   

  

 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 About The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a Creative Strategist dedicated to our YouTube channels. You are the creative brain who determines what we actually build before a single camera rolls. Your job is to take complex financial topics, market trends, and platform data, then turn them into high\-performing video concepts, hooks, and content formats. You operate with a channel specialist mindset, understanding YouTube packaging, audience retention mechanics, and narrative pacing better than anyone else.
   

  

 Focus Area 1: Format Development \& Strategy
   

  

* Topic Selection: Research trending financial conversations, platform algorithms, and audience demand to select high\-potential video angles.
* Format Ownership: Design and test distinct video formats, determining whether a subject works best as a deep\-dive breakdown, a story\-driven narrative, or a visual experiment.
* Hook \& Packaging Strategy: Define the title, thumbnail concept, and first 30 seconds of every video before writing begins, ensuring high click\-through rates and early retention.
* Feedback Loops: Analyze video retention graphs and engagement metrics alongside performance data to double down on winning concepts and drop what fails.


 Focus Area 2: Narrative \& Concept Frameworks
   

  

* Concept Outlining: Write core narrative structures, detailed concept briefs, and key story beats for scriptwriters and production teams.
* Platform Logic: Apply platform psychology to every video structure, ensuring complex financial topics remain clear, engaging, and simple for the viewer.
* Speed to Execution: Identify breaking financial trends and translate them into ready\-to\-produce video concepts within hours.


**Qualifications**
 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* YouTube Platform Mastery: Deep understanding of YouTube mechanics, retention dynamics, packaging, and thumbnail design principles.
* Analytical Creativity: Ability to look at audience retention drop\-offs and CTR data, translating raw numbers into creative fixes.
* Finance / Market Interest: Strong curiosity about markets, personal finance, trading, or economics, with an instinct for what retail audiences care about.


 Mindset To Succeed
   

  

* High Agency: You treat the channel like your own product, proactively finding content gaps and filling them without waiting for briefs.
* Comfort with Ambiguity: You adapt quickly when platform trends shift, moving seamlessly between different formats and angles.
* Idea Engine: You generate a high volume of strong concepts consistently, with no friction around killing ideas that do not perform.


**Additional Information**
 PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
   

  

 Insurance Benefits \- Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program \- Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support \- Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day\-care Support Program Mobility Benefits \- Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits \- Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits \- Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy
   

  

 Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. PhonePe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. **Love football (soccer) and have an entrepreneurial mindset?
   

  

 Stranger Soccer is expanding across key cities worldwide and is seeking a License Owner to launch and grow the Stranger Soccer operation in Bangalore.**
**This is not a salaried management role—it's an opportunity for an entrepreneurial individual to build and operate something of their own while making football more accessible in their local community. We're looking for someone ambitious, community\-driven, and passionate about the game.**
**Does This Sound Like You?**
 Visit
 **www.strangersoccer.com**

 **"Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City"**

* Launch and grow the Stranger Soccer brand in Bangalore

* Drive marketing and customer growth through digital and local initiatives
* Oversee game operations while delivering an outstanding player experience

**About Stranger Soccer**
 Football is loved by billions, yet many still struggle to play regularly. Stranger Soccer makes playing football as easy and convenient as going for a jog or visiting the gym.
   

  

 Our app lets players discover nearby games, book a spot, and simply turn up to play.

**Our Mission**
 To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.
   

  

**Ready to be part of the journey?**
 We'd love to hear from you.

description:
**About The Role**
 Billing infrastructure is revenue infrastructure. In a business running an enterprise sales\-led motion and a product\-led self\-serve motion in parallel, the configuration quality of that stack directly determines what Finance can close cleanly, what customers are billed accurately, and how much revenue is recovered when payments fail. We’re hiring a systems administrator who treats it that way.
   

  

 We are seeking a Systems Administrator, Billing Systems to serve as the senior platform expert across our billing stack and a trusted operational partner to Finance, RevOps, and Product Engineering. This role will own day\-to\-day administration of and production support across the billing systems landscape in a scaled, dual\-motion SaaS environment.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Billing Systems Administration
   

  

* Own multiple billing platform administration for both our PLG self\-serve motion and enterprise\-grade invoicing and billing, including: payment methods, product and pricing catalog, subscription lifecycle, webhook monitoring, and dispute handling
* Maintain pricing configurations, billing templates, and subscription structures as directed by Finance and RevOps. When the price book changes, Billing Systems reflects it cleanly
* Own dunning and revenue recovery configuration: retry schedules, smart retry settings, grace period logic, and dunning email sequences. Monitor recovery rates and optimize the sequence over time
* Monitor platform health proactively. Identify processing failures, data integrity issues, and configuration gaps before they surface in Finance reporting or customer invoices
* Serve as the primary Stripe and BillingPlatform platform contact for Finance, RevOps, and the billing engineering team
* Execute configuration changes following change management controls: documented, tested, and deployed cleanly


 Quote\-to\-Cash Integrations
   

  

* Maintain the integration between Selling/Quoting systems and Billing Systems so quote\-to\-cash data flows are intact and deals land correctly in relevant billing systems
* Support CPQ\-related billing configurations in partnership with the CPQ Lead: price book alignment, quote output formats, and contract\-to\-subscription linkages
* Configure and test PLG self\-serve billing flows for new product launches, pricing changes, free trial conversion logic, and self\-serve subscription management


 Provisioning Connectivity
   

  

* Partner with Product Engineering on the billing\-to\-provisioning handoff across both PLG self\-serve and SLG enterprise motions.
* Maintain the billing\-side integration touchpoints that connect Stripe and BillingPlatform to provisioning workflows, ensuring subscription and order events carry the right data for downstream customer access
* Monitor the billing\-to\-provisioning handoff and escalate with context when subscription or order events fail to propagate cleanly into customer access
* Support provisioning impact assessment when pricing, packaging, or tier structures change on the billing side


 Data Quality \& Reconciliation
   

  

* Run regular data quality checks across billing systems: subscriber data, payment records, invoice history, and subscription states across SLG and PLG customers
* Support billing reconciliation across BillingPlatform, Stripe, Avalara, and NetSuite
* Support month\-end and quarter\-end close with clean, complete, defensible data for Finance reporting
* Maintain runbooks and escalation documentation for common billing data issues


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in billing systems administration, revenue operations, or SaaS billing in environments serving both enterprise and self\-serve customers
* Deep hands\-on experience with Stripe: subscription management, payment processing, webhook configuration, dunning configuration, and PLG billing flows
* Hands\-on experience with an enterprise subscription billing platform such as BillingPlatform, Revenue Cloud, Zuora, or Chargebee
* Development skills in building automation workflows in billing systems via API, webhooks, and other workflow configurations
* Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ: quote\-to\-cash process, price book structure, and integration touchpoints with billing systems
* Familiarity with billing\-to\-provisioning integration patterns and partnership with product engineering teams on subscription event propagation
* Experience supporting billing reconciliation with Finance through NetSuite or equivalent ERP
* Experience in B2B SaaS environments with both sales\-led and product\-led revenue motions


**Preferred**
* Stripe certification such as Stripe Associate
* Experience with usage\-based pricing models, including metered billing, freemium conversion, and monthly self\-serve
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification or hands\-on CPQ experience


**How We Think About AI**
 At Quickbase, we view AI as a tool to accelerate how work gets done — not replace it. We encourage thoughtful use of AI to improve speed, quality, and decision\-making, while maintaining strong judgment, accountability, and data integrity.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
 Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

  

* Senior Technical Editor AI Software Architecture and Enterprise Technology
* Infosys Knowledge Institute IKI is the thought leadership and research arm of Infosys
* It develops original evidence based perspectives that help business and technology leaders understand emerging trends make informed decisions and translate technology developments into enterprise value
* Through the Infosys Technology Review and other IKI publications we publish applied research deep technology perspectives enterprise architecture papers technology playbooks and executive strategy articles
* Our work combines the expertise of Infosys practitioners and technology leaders with rigorous research strong editorial judgment and clear implications for enterprises
* About the role
* We are looking for an accomplished Senior Technical Editor to strengthen the quality credibility and executive relevance of its technology thought leadership
* This is a substantive editorial role that extends well beyond copyediting
* The editor will critically assess whether a manuscript presents an original and defensible point of view whether its technical claims architecture and supporting evidence are sound and whether the argument is relevant and accessible to senior enterprise decision makers
* The editor will work across topics such as artificial intelligence generative and agentic AI software and enterprise architecture cloud data engineering cybersecurity digital platforms engineering practices and emerging technologies
* Publications may include
* Research and applied innovation papers
* Frontier technology and architecture perspectives
* Tech Navigator reports and implementation playbooks
* Executive technology strategy articles
* Multi article series and thematic research programs
* Working closely with authors subject matter experts IKI producers researchers designers and publishing teams the editor will serve as a critical editorial quality gate from manuscript development through final publication

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  

* Provide substantive and developmental editing
* Evaluate the central thesis originality relevance and strength of each manuscript
* Determine whether the article addresses a meaningful enterprise problem and delivers a clear differentiated point of view
* Assess the logical progression of the argument and restructure manuscripts where required to improve coherence clarity and impact
* Identify unsupported assertions reasoning gaps contradictions excessive generalization and conclusions that extend beyond the available evidence
* Challenge manuscripts that merely describe a technology and help authors develop a stronger perspective on what it means for enterprises
* Ensure that introductions establish the problem and purpose clearly sections advance the argument and conclusions translate the analysis into meaningful implications or actions
* Preserve the author s expertise and voice while raising the manuscript to IKI s publication standards

  

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

  

* Primary skills Process Technical Writer User Manual Documentation Product Specification Documentation

  

**Additional Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------

  

* Review technical concepts terminology frameworks architectural patterns and implementation claims for accuracy and internal consistency
* Test whether technical explanations are complete logically sound and appropriate for the intended audience
* Identify claims that require validation by a specialist and coordinate with relevant subject matter experts to resolve technical questions
* Ensure that distinctions between concepts technologies system layers and operating models are precise and consistently maintained
* Review descriptions of AI models agents data pipelines software systems security controls evaluation methods and enterprise architectures for conceptual accuracy
* Detect overstatement technology hype unsubstantiated performance claims and language that may weaken the credibility of the publication
* Maintain consistency across interconnected articles particularly where multiple authors contribute to a common framework or publication series

  

**Preferred Skills:**
---------------------


Foundational\-\>SDLC\-\>Technical Writing

title: Head of Growth
description:
**Job Description \- Head of Growth** 




  





**About Us** 




 Zylu is a fast\-growing SaaS startup helping salons and beauty businesses simplify appointments, customer engagement, marketing, and business operations through technology.
 



 With a growing presence across India and expanding traction in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Southeast Asia, we're building the operating system for the beauty and wellness industry.
 



 If you're excited about building growth engines, scaling businesses, and working closely with founders, Zylu offers a high\-impact opportunity to make a real difference.
 



  





**Job Role:** 
 Head of Growth
 



**Experience Level:** 
 3 to 6 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore (Work From Office)
 



**Qualification:** 
 Graduation is a must.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on growth marketing manager who has experience contributing to the growth of a SaaS company from approximately
 **$100K ARR to $3M ARR** 
 .
 



 You will own the growth funnel across customer acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion while working directly with leadership to build scalable growth systems.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who combines strategy with execution and is comfortable working across multiple growth channels.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  




* Own and drive growth across the entire customer journey from lead generation to retention and expansion.
* Build and optimise conversion funnels across website visitors, leads, demos, trials, and customers.
* Plan and execute growth experiments across landing pages, email campaigns, ads, onboarding, and product messaging.
* Scale customer acquisition through channels such as SEO, content, paid marketing, partnerships, referrals, webinars, and communities.
* Work closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Success teams to improve activation and retention metrics.
* Track and improve key SaaS metrics, including CAC, LTV, conversion rates, retention, and ARR growth.
* Build dashboards and reports to measure marketing performance and growth initiatives.
* Identify new growth opportunities and launch initiatives to improve revenue efficiency.
* Collaborate with founders and leadership on go\-to\-market strategy and expansion plans.
* Support hiring and scaling of the future growth team as the company grows.



  





**Role Requirements** 




  




* 3\-6 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or revenue marketing roles within B2B SaaS companies.
* Experience working in a startup environment with high ownership and fast execution cycles.
* Experience contributing to the growth of a SaaS company from approximately
 **$100K ARR to $3M\-$5M ARR** 
 is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of SaaS metrics, including ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV, churn, retention, and payback period.
* Proven experience running growth experiments and improving conversion funnels.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and attribution tools.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to make data\-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in vertical SaaS, SMB SaaS, or multi\-location businesses is a plus.
* Experience in beauty, wellness, healthcare, or similar industries is an added advantage.



  





**Hiring Process** 




  




* Initial discussion with the hiring team.
* Growth strategy or case study discussion.
* Leadership interview focused on growth achievements and business impact.
* Final discussion with founders and leadership team.

**Overview**
 The Future of Scalable Software Engineering (FoSSE) team in CoreAI, Microsoft, invites applications for postdoctoral researcher positions. FoSSE is an applied research team focused on solving real\-world software engineering (SE) problems for large codebases, including code migration, code translation, and static analysis, using AI and formal methods. Our postdoc program provides an opportunity to work on practical research problems while collaborating closely with Microsoft researchers and product groups. Postdocs spend 1\-2 years with us and receive ongoing guidance and mentoring from experienced colleagues. We work at the intersection of programming language design, formal methods, static analysis, and AI.

**PL track:** 
 Strong background in programming languages, compilers, or related areas, and an interest in combining AI with these techniques to solve SE problems at scale and with high quality.

 Strong background in LLM post\-training (e.g., RLHF, instruction tuning, alignment, evaluation) and an interest in applying these techniques to SE.

description:
Who Are We?
   

  

 RZR is an AI\-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full\-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose\-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
   

  

 We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
   

  

 RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M\&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 As Creative Strategist at RZR, you will translate audience insights, performance data, and campaign objectives into actionable content strategies and creative concepts that drive measurable results across mobile advertising platforms.
   

  

 This role sits within the Creative Growth pod as an individual contributor — owning research, audience analysis, creative hypotheses, and copy development for assigned accounts. You will work closely with the Creative Strategy Manager, Creative Designers, and Analytics to ensure strategic intent flows through from brief to final execution.
   

  

 This is not a generalist content or social media role. This is a performance\-focused, insight\-driven strategy role in a mobile advertising environment.
   

  

 The right person for this role is analytically curious and creatively sharp — someone who can read a performance signal, build a hypothesis around it, write the copy to test it, and document what they learned. You will operate with real ownership across your accounts from day one.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Conduct independent market, competitive, and audience research for assigned accounts
* Develop content strategies aligned to campaign goals and client KPIs
* Tailor creative concepts to specific audience segments using behavioural and psychographic data
* Generate new creative concepts based on performance insights and research findings
* Write and develop copy for ad creatives — headlines, CTAs, and messaging frameworks
* Synthesise performance signals into actionable hypotheses for creative testing
* Identify A/B testing opportunities from campaign data and propose structured test frameworks
* Maintain audience profiles, user personas, and competitor insight documents
* Support QBR preparation with research, insights, and audience\-specific recommendations
* Monitor performance reports and flag emerging trends or declining signals
* Document all hypotheses, test results, and learnings in the shared knowledge base
* Coordinate with Creative Designers on concept visualisation and storyboarding
* Interface with Analytics for performance data pulls and reporting inputs


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* 3–5 years of experience in content strategy, creative strategy, or a performance creative role in a digital or mobile advertising environment
* Demonstrated ability to develop content strategies and creative concepts grounded in audience data and performance insights
* Strong copywriting skills — able to craft compelling ad headlines, CTAs, and messaging frameworks
* Familiarity with mobile advertising platforms and performance metrics (CTR, IPM, ROAS, CPI)
* Experience synthesising research and data into clear, actionable recommendations
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and workstreams simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard for output quality
* Collaborative working style with clear, structured communication


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Exposure to creative A/B testing frameworks and hypothesis\-led thinking
* Familiarity with platform\-specific creative best practices (Meta, TikTok, Google UAC, DSPs)
* Experience in ad tech, programmatic, or mobile\-first marketing environments
* Experience contributing to QBR preparation or client\-facing strategy documentation


 Work Setup
   

  

 This is a hybrid role requiring regular onsite attendance for collaboration, creative reviews, and team activities. Creative team members may occasionally work onsite more frequently depending on project demands. Fully remote candidates will not be considered.
   

  

 Why Join RZR in Manila / Bangalore?
   

  

* Embedded strategy with direct influence on performance — you are not producing content in a vacuum. Your hypotheses get tested, your copy runs in live campaigns, and you see the results. The feedback loop is real and fast.
* Work across a diverse portfolio of mobile advertising accounts — no two accounts are the same. You will build genuine depth across different verticals, audiences, and creative formats.
* Close collaboration with Creative Leadership and cross\-functional partners — you will work directly alongside the Creative Strategy Manager and interface regularly with Analytics and Revenue. Your work is seen and valued.
* High\-ownership environment — your ideas matter here. If you have a hypothesis, you can propose it, test it, and own the outcome.
* Clear progression path — the natural next step from this role is Senior Creative Strategist, with a well\-defined track within the Creative Growth pod.


 RZR Behaviors
   

  

 RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership
   

  

* Move Fast
* Drive for Excellence
* Proactive Communication
* Courage
* Curiosity
* Deliver Results
* Manage Ambiguity

description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
   

  

  

* Role type: Full time
* Location: Remote
* Working with: CEO and Cofounder


 Weekday is an AI\-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a growth role, not a strategy role. You will sit next to the CEO and own one number: revenue growth for one of our core product lines. Everything you do — every piece of content, every cold email, every demo call — either moves that number or it doesn't.
   

  

 You won't be handed a playbook, a team, or a warmed\-up pipeline. You'll build the GTM engine yourself: figure out which channels work, build them, and scale the ones that do. Some weeks that means writing content and tuning SEO/AEO so buyers find us. Other weeks it means running demo calls back\-to\-back and following up aggressively until deals close. If you think of yourself as either "a marketer" or "a salesperson" but not both, this isn't for you.
   

  

 What you'll actually do
   

  

 On any given day you might be:
   

  

  

* Running the full inside\-sales motion — taking demo calls, handling objections, following up relentlessly, and closing
* Building content that actually converts: landing pages, comparison pages, blog posts, and material designed to rank on search and get picked up by AI answer engines (AEO)
* Setting up and running outbound systems — cold email, cold calls, LinkedIn, or whatever channel gets us in front of the right buyers
* Writing scripts and light automations to scale yourself — scraping lead lists, wiring up email sequences, building dashboards so you know what's working
* Testing a new growth channel, killing it fast if it doesn't work, and doubling down if it does
* Reporting your numbers honestly to the founders, including the ugly ones


 You'll be measured on revenue — pipeline created and deals closed. Not on activity, not on slides.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

  

* You can sell. You're sharp on calls, you can run a demo that lands, and you follow up like the deal depends on it — because it does
* You know your way around code and tech. You can write a script, wire up an API, or build your own tooling instead of waiting for an engineer
* You've done growth before — content, SEO, cold email, cold calling, or any sales system you built and ran yourself — and you can show what it produced
* You take ownership. When the number is yours, it moves — no follow\-ups needed
* You work hard and sweat the details. Conscientiousness isn't optional here; the follow\-up you skip is the deal you lose
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. No playbook, no hand\-holding, no fully\-defined role. The role is what you make it


 What you get
   

  

  

* Full ownership of a revenue line — you're not a cog in a GTM machine, you are the GTM machine
* A daily working relationship with the CEO and Cofounder, and a front\-row seat to how a profitable, venture\-backed startup grows
* The freedom to pick your channels and build your own systems — and the accountability that comes with it
* The kind of zero\-to\-one growth experience that's worth far more than the title

description:
**Associate – Front Office** 




 Loop by Zolo
 



**Be the first smile. Be the calm in the chaos. Be the reason guests return.** 




  





**Company Name:** 
 ZoloStays
 



**Business Unit:** 
 Loop by Zolo
 



**Designation:** 
 Front Office Associate
 



**CTC Offered:** 
 3\.63 LPA (30,000 inhand)
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 At Loop by Zolo, the front office is not just a function — it is the first and last impression of the brand. Every guest interaction, from pre\-arrival to checkout, shapes how the hotel is perceived and whether the guest returns or recommends us.
 



 While product and infrastructure create the base, it is the front office that brings the experience to life.
 



 This role exists to ensure that every guest interaction is handled with clarity, warmth, and discipline — resulting in seamless stays and consistent 5\-star ratings.
 



 If the Front Office is strong, guests feel welcomed, supported, and delighted. If the Front Office is weak, even a good product feels broken.
 



  





**Your mandate is clear** 



* Own the guest journey end\-to\-end — from pre\-arrival to checkout
* Deliver smooth, fast, and warm check\-in and check\-out experiences
* Handle all guest interactions with clarity and professionalism
* Ensure all service requests and issues are resolved quickly
* Drive 5\-star reviews through consistent guest engagement
* Represent the brand with energy and hospitality



 This is not a desk role. It is active ownership of guest experience and satisfaction.
 



  





**About Zolo** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.
 



 People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
 



 Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.
 



 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.
 



 Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.
 



 Loop by Zolo is designed for the new\-age traveler seeking vibrant, social, and dependable stays.
 



 We combine hospitality, comfort, and community to create experiences that feel welcoming, energetic, and effortless.
 



 Backed by Zolo’s operational expertise and hospitality standards, Loop focuses on creating spaces where guests feel connected, comfortable, and cared for.
 



 As we scale across locations, guest experience consistency becomes critical — and the front office team plays the biggest role in making that happen.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 




 1\. Manage Pre\-Arrival Guest Experience
 


* Call guests before arrival to confirm booking and expectations
* Provide clear directions, check\-in details, and support
* Set the tone for a smooth arrival experience



 2\. Deliver Seamless Check\-in \& Check\-out
 


* Ensure fast, smooth, and error\-free check\-in
* Welcome guests with warmth and professionalism
* Handle check\-out efficiently with proper closure
* Ensure no delays or confusion for guests



 3\. Handle Guest Interaction \& Service Requests
 


* Be the primary point of contact for all guest queries
* Respond promptly and politely to all requests
* Coordinate with housekeeping and other teams for service delivery
* Ensure every request is closed properly



 4\. Manage Guest Complaints \& Escalations
 


* Handle guest concerns calmly and professionally
* Take ownership of issues and drive resolution
* Escalate when required and follow through till closure
* Ensure guest leaves satisfied



 5\. Drive Guest Engagement \& Reviews
 


* Proactively interact with guests during their stay
* Identify happy guests and encourage 5\-star reviews
* Ensure guest feedback is captured and acted upon
* Build a positive and memorable experience



 6\. Ensure Process Discipline \& Accuracy
 


* Follow all front office SOPs consistently
* Maintain accuracy in guest details and records
* Ensure coordination across teams is smooth
* Adhere to daily routines and checklists



  





**What success looks like after 6–12 months** 



* Consistently high guest ratings (4\.7\+ / 5\-star focus)
* Smooth and fast check\-in/check\-out experience
* Positive guest feedback on staff behavior and support
* No missed service requests or unresolved complaints
* Strong contribution to hotel reputation and repeat guests



 The front office feels warm, efficient, and consistently reliable.
 



  





**Who this role is for** 




 You will likely thrive here if:
 


* You enjoy interacting with people and making them comfortable
* You take ownership of guest experience end\-to\-end
* You communicate clearly and confidently
* You are disciplined and do not miss processes
* You remain calm and professional under pressure
* You want to build a career in hospitality operations



  





**Experience we value** 



* Fresh graduates from hospitality institutes (preferred)
* Freshers from other backgrounds with strong communication
* 0–1 year experience in front office / guest handling roles (optional)
* Comfortable speaking in English \+ local language
* Basic comfort with systems and coordination



 Hospitality background is preferred but not mandatory. Communication, ownership, and discipline are critical.
 



  





**The impact you will have** 



* You directly shape guest experience and satisfaction
* You influence hotel ratings and online reputation
* You are the face of the brand for every guest
* You impact repeat business and referrals



  





**Why join now** 




 Loop by Zolo is scaling rapidly with a focus on consistent, high\-quality guest experience. Front office excellence will be a key differentiator in this journey.
 



 This role is the foundation for growth into larger hotel operations and leadership roles.
 



 If you believe in delivering great service with discipline and ownership — this is the right role.
